+import {
+  DAY_PERIODS,
+  SAVED_VIEW_LAYOUTS,
+  isPlainDate,
+  isTimestamp,
+  validateDue,
+  validateItem,
+  validateSchedule,
+  type Agenda,
+  type AgendaGroup,
+  type Due,
+  type Item,
+  type ItemKind,
+  type ItemLink,
+  type SavedView,
+  type SavedViewFilter,
+  type SavedViewPeriod,
+  type Schedule,
+  type Settings,
+  type Status,
+  type StatusGroup,
+  type SyncFields,
+  type Tag,
+  type Timestamp,
+} from '../core';
+import { isValidSettings } from './settings';
+
+export const BACKUP_FORMAT = 'unified-agenda-backup';
+export const BACKUP_VERSION = 1;
+
+export interface BackupData {
+  agendas: Agenda[];
+  agendaGroups: AgendaGroup[];
+  items: Item[];
+  tags: Tag[];
+  statusGroups: StatusGroup[];
+  statuses: Status[];
+  /** Missing in files from before saved views existed, which then count as having none. */
+  savedViews: SavedView[];
+}
+
+export interface BackupFile {
+  format: typeof BACKUP_FORMAT;
+  version: number;
+  exportedAt: Timestamp;
+  /** Null when the file carries no settings. */
+  settings: Settings | null;
+  data: BackupData;
+}
+
+export type ImportIssueCode =
+  | 'notJson'
+  | 'notBackup'
+  | 'unsupportedVersion'
+  | 'invalidField'
+  | 'invalidItem'
+  | 'duplicateId'
+  | 'danglingReference';
+
+/** What is wrong and where. The interface turns the code into a sentence in the right language. */
+export interface ImportIssue {
+  /** For example `data.items[3].title`. */
+  path: string;
+  code: ImportIssueCode;
+  detail?: string;
+}
+
+export type ParseResult = { ok: true; backup: BackupFile } | { ok: false; issues: ImportIssue[] };
+
+type Rec = Record<string, unknown>;
+
+function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Rec {
+  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function isOptionalString(value: unknown): value is string | undefined {
+  return value === undefined || typeof value === 'string';
+}
+
+/** Reads typed fields from one object and records an issue for each one that is wrong. */
+class Reader {
+  failed = false;
+  readonly rec: Rec;
+  readonly path: string;
+  private readonly issues: ImportIssue[];
+
+  constructor(rec: Rec, path: string, issues: ImportIssue[]) {
+    this.rec = rec;
+    this.path = path;
+    this.issues = issues;
+  }
+
+  fail(key: string, code: ImportIssueCode = 'invalidField', detail?: string): void {
+    this.failed = true;
+    this.issues.push({ path: `${this.path}.${key}`, code, ...(detail ? { detail } : {}) });
+  }
+
+  raw(key: string): unknown {
+    return this.rec[key];
+  }
+
+  string(key: string, required = false): string {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (typeof value === 'string' && (!required || value !== '')) return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  number(key: string): number {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return 0;
+  }
+
+  timestamp(key: string): Timestamp {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (isTimestamp(value)) return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  nullableTimestamp(key: string): Timestamp | null {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+    return this.timestamp(key);
+  }
+
+  nullableId(key: string): string | null {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+    return this.string(key, true);
+  }
+
+  nullableDate(key: string): string | null {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+    if (isPlainDate(value)) return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  stringList(key: string): string[] {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (Array.isArray(value) && value.every((v) => typeof v === 'string' && v !== '')) {
+      return [...(value as string[])];
+    }
+    this.fail(key);
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  /** A true or false that older backups do not have: a missing value takes the fallback. */
+  optionalBoolean(key: string, fallback: boolean): boolean {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (value === undefined) return fallback;
+    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return fallback;
+  }
+
+  /** A nested object. Returns null (and records the problem) when it is missing or not an object. */
+  child(key: string): Reader | null {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (isRecord(value)) return new Reader(value, `${this.path}.${key}`, this.issues);
+    this.fail(key);
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  /** A whole number of zero or more, or null. */
+  nullableCount(key: string): number | null {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (value === null) return null;
+    if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0) return value;
+    this.fail(key);
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  /** A list of names that must all be among the allowed ones. */
+  oneOfList<T extends string>(key: string, allowed: readonly T[]): T[] {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (
+      Array.isArray(value) &&
+      value.every((v) => typeof v === 'string' && (allowed as readonly string[]).includes(v))
+    ) {
+      return [...(value as T[])];
+    }
+    this.fail(key);
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  /** A list of ids, or null. A missing value is a problem. */
+  nullableStringList(key: string): string[] | null {
+    return this.rec[key] === null ? null : this.stringList(key);
+  }
+
+  oneOf<T extends string>(key: string, allowed: readonly T[], fallback: T): T {
+    const value = this.rec[key];
+    if (typeof value === 'string' && (allowed as readonly string[]).includes(value)) {
+      return value as T;
+    }
+    this.fail(key);
+    return fallback;
+  }
+}
+
+function readSync(rd: Reader): SyncFields {
+  return {
+    id: rd.string('id', true),
+    createdAt: rd.timestamp('createdAt'),
+    updatedAt: rd.timestamp('updatedAt'),
+    deletedAt: rd.nullableTimestamp('deletedAt'),
+  };
+}
+
+function readSchedule(rd: Reader): Schedule | null {
+  const value = rd.raw('schedule');
+  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+  if (!isRecord(value)) return (rd.fail('schedule'), null);
+
+  const { allDay, start, end, timeZone } = value;
+  if (typeof allDay !== 'boolean' || typeof start !== 'string') return (rd.fail('schedule'), null);
+  if (!isOptionalString(end) || !isOptionalString(timeZone)) return (rd.fail('schedule'), null);
+
+  const schedule: Schedule = allDay
+    ? { allDay: true, start, ...(end !== undefined ? { end } : {}) }
+    : {
+        allDay: false,
+        start,
+        ...(end !== undefined ? { end } : {}),
+        ...(timeZone !== undefined ? { timeZone } : {}),
+      };
+  if (validateSchedule(schedule).length > 0) return (rd.fail('schedule'), null);
+  return schedule;
+}
+
+function readDue(rd: Reader): Due | null {
+  const value = rd.raw('due');
+  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.allDay !== 'boolean') return (rd.fail('due'), null);
+
+  const { allDay, date, at, timeZone } = value;
+  let due: Due;
+  if (allDay) {
+    if (typeof date !== 'string') return (rd.fail('due'), null);
+    due = { allDay: true, date };
+  } else {
+    if (typeof at !== 'string' || !isOptionalString(timeZone)) return (rd.fail('due'), null);
+    due = { allDay: false, at, ...(timeZone !== undefined ? { timeZone } : {}) };
+  }
+  if (validateDue(due).length > 0) return (rd.fail('due'), null);
+  return due;
+}
+
+function readLinks(rd: Reader): ItemLink[] {
+  const value = rd.raw('links');
+  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return (rd.fail('links'), []);
+  const links: ItemLink[] = [];
+  for (const entry of value) {
+    if (!isRecord(entry) || typeof entry.label !== 'string' || typeof entry.url !== 'string') {
+      return (rd.fail('links'), []);
+    }
+    links.push({ label: entry.label, url: entry.url });
+  }
+  return links;
+}
+
+const parseAgenda = (rd: Reader): Agenda => ({
+  ...readSync(rd),
+  name: rd.string('name'),
+  color: rd.string('color'),
+  order: rd.number('order'),
+});
+
+const parseAgendaGroup = (rd: Reader): AgendaGroup => ({
+  ...readSync(rd),
+  name: rd.string('name'),
+  agendaIds: rd.stringList('agendaIds'),
+  order: rd.number('order'),
+});
+
+const parseTag = (rd: Reader): Tag => ({
+  ...readSync(rd),
+  name: rd.string('name'),
+  parentId: rd.nullableId('parentId'),
+  agendaIds: rd.stringList('agendaIds'),
+  color: rd.string('color'),
+});
+
+const parseStatusGroup = (rd: Reader): StatusGroup => ({
+  ...readSync(rd),
+  name: rd.string('name'),
+  role: rd.oneOf('role', ['planned', 'started', 'done'] as const, 'planned'),
+  order: rd.number('order'),
+});
+
+const parseStatus = (rd: Reader): Status => ({
+  ...readSync(rd),
+  name: rd.string('name'),
+  groupId: rd.string('groupId', true),
+  order: rd.number('order'),
+});
+
+const FILTER_KINDS: readonly ItemKind[] = ['event', 'task'];
+const FILTER_PERIODS: readonly SavedViewPeriod[] = [...DAY_PERIODS, 'untimed'];
+
+function readSavedFilter(rd: Reader): SavedViewFilter {
+  return {
+    tagIds: rd.stringList('tagIds'),
+    kinds: rd.oneOfList('kinds', FILTER_KINDS),
+    periods: rd.oneOfList('periods', FILTER_PERIODS),
+    text: rd.string('text'),
+    dueWithinDays: rd.nullableCount('dueWithinDays'),
+  };
+}
+
+function parseSavedView(rd: Reader): SavedView {
+  const view: SavedView = {
+    ...readSync(rd),
+    name: rd.string('name'),
+    order: rd.number('order'),
+    filter: { tagIds: [], kinds: [], periods: [], text: '', dueWithinDays: null },
+    agendaIds: rd.nullableStringList('agendaIds'),
+    layout: rd.oneOf('layout', SAVED_VIEW_LAYOUTS, 'mixed'),
+  };
+  const filterReader = rd.child('filter');
+  if (filterReader) {
+    view.filter = readSavedFilter(filterReader);
+    if (filterReader.failed) rd.failed = true;
+  }
+  return view;
+}
+
+function parseItem(rd: Reader): Item {
+  const item: Item = {
+    ...readSync(rd),
+    parentId: rd.nullableId('parentId'),
+    order: rd.number('order'),
+    kind: rd.oneOf('kind', ['event', 'task'] as const, 'event'),
+    title: rd.string('title'),
+    notes: rd.string('notes'),
+    schedule: readSchedule(rd),
+    from: rd.nullableDate('from'),
+    due: readDue(rd),
+    agendaId: rd.string('agendaId', true),
+    tagIds: rd.stringList('tagIds'),
+    inheritTags: rd.optionalBoolean('inheritTags', true),
+    statusId: rd.nullableId('statusId'),
+    location: rd.string('location'),
+    links: readLinks(rd),
+  };
+  if (!rd.failed) {
+    const problems = validateItem(item);
+    if (problems.length > 0) rd.fail('item', 'invalidItem', problems.join(','));
+  }
+  return item;
+}
+
+function parseList<T extends SyncFields>(
+  raw: unknown,
+  name: string,
+  issues: ImportIssue[],
+  parseOne: (rd: Reader) => T,
+): T[] {
+  if (raw === undefined) return [];
+  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
+    issues.push({ path: `data.${name}`, code: 'invalidField' });
+    return [];
+  }
+  const seen = new Set<string>();
+  const found: T[] = [];
+  raw.forEach((entry, index) => {
+    const path = `data.${name}[${index}]`;
+    if (!isRecord(entry)) {
+      issues.push({ path, code: 'invalidField' });
+      return;
+    }
+    const before = issues.length;
+    const entity = parseOne(new Reader(entry, path, issues));
+    if (issues.length > before) return;
+    if (seen.has(entity.id)) {
+      issues.push({ path: `${path}.id`, code: 'duplicateId' });
+      return;
+    }
+    seen.add(entity.id);
+    found.push(entity);
+  });
+  return found;
+}
+
+function parseSettings(raw: unknown, issues: ImportIssue[]): Settings | null {
+  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return null;
+  const rd = isRecord(raw) ? new Reader(raw, 'settings', issues) : null;
+  if (!rd) {
+    issues.push({ path: 'settings', code: 'invalidField' });
+    return null;
+  }
+  const bounds = rd.raw('periodBounds');
+  if (!isRecord(bounds)) {
+    rd.fail('periodBounds');
+    return null;
+  }
+  const boundsReader = new Reader(bounds, 'settings.periodBounds', issues);
+  const settings: Settings = {
+    displayTimeZone: rd.string('displayTimeZone', true),
+    periodBounds: {
+      morningStart: boundsReader.number('morningStart'),
+      afternoonStart: boundsReader.number('afternoonStart'),
+      eveningStart: boundsReader.number('eveningStart'),
+    },
+  };
+  if (rd.failed || boundsReader.failed) return null;
+  if (!isValidSettings(settings)) {
+    rd.fail('displayTimeZone');
+    return null;
+  }
+  return settings;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads the text of a backup file. Nothing is accepted halfway: if any part is wrong, the result
+ * lists every problem found and no data is returned. Unknown extra fields are dropped.
+ */
+export function parseBackup(text: string): ParseResult {
+  let raw: unknown;
+  try {
+    raw = JSON.parse(text);
+  } catch {
+    return { ok: false, issues: [{ path: '', code: 'notJson' }] };
+  }
+  if (!isRecord(raw) || raw.format !== BACKUP_FORMAT) {
+    return { ok: false, issues: [{ path: 'format', code: 'notBackup' }] };
+  }
+  const { version } = raw;
+  if (typeof version !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(version) || version < 1) {
+    return { ok: false, issues: [{ path: 'version', code: 'notBackup' }] };
+  }
+  if (version > BACKUP_VERSION) {
+    return { ok: false, issues: [{ path: 'version', code: 'unsupportedVersion' }] };
+  }
+
+  const issues: ImportIssue[] = [];
+  const exportedAt = isTimestamp(raw.exportedAt) ? raw.exportedAt : '';
+  if (exportedAt === '') issues.push({ path: 'exportedAt', code: 'invalidField' });
+
+  if (!isRecord(raw.data)) {
+    issues.push({ path: 'data', code: 'invalidField' });
+    return { ok: false, issues };
+  }
+  const data: BackupData = {
+    agendas: parseList(raw.data.agendas, 'agendas', issues, parseAgenda),
+    agendaGroups: parseList(raw.data.agendaGroups, 'agendaGroups', issues, parseAgendaGroup),
+    items: parseList(raw.data.items, 'items', issues, parseItem),
+    tags: parseList(raw.data.tags, 'tags', issues, parseTag),
+    statusGroups: parseList(raw.data.statusGroups, 'statusGroups', issues, parseStatusGroup),
+    statuses: parseList(raw.data.statuses, 'statuses', issues, parseStatus),
+    savedViews: parseList(raw.data.savedViews, 'savedViews', issues, parseSavedView),
+  };
+  const settings = parseSettings(raw.settings, issues);
+
+  if (issues.length > 0) return { ok: false, issues };
+  return { ok: true, backup: { format: BACKUP_FORMAT, version, exportedAt, settings, data } };
+}
+
+/**
+ * References that point to something missing from the file itself. Only meaningful when the file
+ * is meant to stand alone (replace mode). Deleted entities count as present, so a tombstone keeps
+ * the things that point to it valid.
+ */
+export function findDanglingReferences(data: BackupData): ImportIssue[] {
+  const issues: ImportIssue[] = [];
+  const ids = (list: readonly SyncFields[]) => new Set(list.map((entity) => entity.id));
+  const agendas = ids(data.agendas);
+  const items = ids(data.items);
+  const tags = ids(data.tags);
+  const statuses = ids(data.statuses);
+  const groups = ids(data.statusGroups);
+
+  const check = (known: Set<string>, id: string | null, path: string) => {
+    if (id !== null && !known.has(id)) issues.push({ path, code: 'danglingReference' });
+  };
+
+  data.items.forEach((item, i) => {
+    const base = `data.items[${i}]`;
+    check(agendas, item.agendaId, `${base}.agendaId`);
+    check(items, item.parentId, `${base}.parentId`);
+    check(statuses, item.statusId, `${base}.statusId`);
+    item.tagIds.forEach((id, t) => check(tags, id, `${base}.tagIds[${t}]`));
+  });
+  data.statuses.forEach((status, i) =>
+    check(groups, status.groupId, `data.statuses[${i}].groupId`),
+  );
+  data.tags.forEach((tag, i) => {
+    check(tags, tag.parentId, `data.tags[${i}].parentId`);
+    tag.agendaIds.forEach((id, a) => check(agendas, id, `data.tags[${i}].agendaIds[${a}]`));
+  });
+  data.agendaGroups.forEach((group, i) => {
+    group.agendaIds.forEach((id, a) =>
+      check(agendas, id, `data.agendaGroups[${i}].agendaIds[${a}]`),
+    );
+  });
+  data.savedViews.forEach((view, i) => {
+    const base = `data.savedViews[${i}]`;
+    view.agendaIds?.forEach((id, a) => check(agendas, id, `${base}.agendaIds[${a}]`));
+    view.filter.tagIds.forEach((id, t) => check(tags, id, `${base}.filter.tagIds[${t}]`));
+  });
+  return issues;
+}

+import {
+  defaultContext,
+  isActive,
+  softDelete,
+  updateEntity,
+  type Agenda,
+  type AgendaGroup,
+  type Context,
+  type Id,
+  type Item,
+  type SavedView,
+  type Status,
+  type StatusGroup,
+  type SyncFields,
+  type Tag,
+} from '../core';
+import type { AgendaDatabase } from './db';
+
+export interface ListOptions {
+  /** Deleted entities (tombstones) are hidden unless this is true. */
+  includeDeleted?: boolean;
+}
+
+/** The few table operations the repository needs. A Dexie table fits it. */
+interface EntityStore<T> {
+  get(id: Id): Promise<T | undefined>;
+  toArray(): Promise<T[]>;
+  put(entity: T): Promise<unknown>;
+  bulkPut(entities: T[]): Promise<unknown>;
+}
+
+/** Reads and writes one kind of entity. Deleting only marks `deletedAt`, as sync will need. */
+export class Repository<T extends SyncFields> {
+  private readonly table: EntityStore<T>;
+
+  constructor(table: EntityStore<T>) {
+    this.table = table;
+  }
+
+  get(id: Id): Promise<T | undefined> {
+    return this.table.get(id);
+  }
+
+  async list(options: ListOptions = {}): Promise<T[]> {
+    const all = await this.table.toArray();
+    return options.includeDeleted ? all : all.filter(isActive);
+  }
+
+  async put(entity: T): Promise<void> {
+    await this.table.put(entity);
+  }
+
+  async putMany(entities: readonly T[]): Promise<void> {
+    await this.table.bulkPut([...entities]);
+  }
+
+  /** Applies the changes and refreshes `updatedAt`. Returns undefined if the id does not exist. */
+  async update(
+    id: Id,
+    changes: Partial<Omit<T, keyof SyncFields>>,
+    ctx: Context = defaultContext,
+  ): Promise<T | undefined> {
+    const current = await this.table.get(id);
+    if (!current) return undefined;
+    const next = updateEntity(current, changes, ctx);
+    await this.table.put(next);
+    return next;
+  }
+
+  /** Marks the entity as deleted. The record stays, so the deletion can sync later. */
+  async remove(id: Id, ctx: Context = defaultContext): Promise<T | undefined> {
+    const current = await this.table.get(id);
+    if (!current) return undefined;
+    const next = softDelete(current, ctx);
+    if (next !== current) await this.table.put(next);
+    return next;
+  }
+}
+
+export interface Repositories {
+  agendas: Repository<Agenda>;
+  agendaGroups: Repository<AgendaGroup>;
+  items: Repository<Item>;
+  tags: Repository<Tag>;
+  savedViews: Repository<SavedView>;
+  statusGroups: Repository<StatusGroup>;
+  statuses: Repository<Status>;
+}
+
+export function createRepositories(db: AgendaDatabase): Repositories {
+  return {
+    agendas: new Repository<Agenda>(db.agendas),
+    agendaGroups: new Repository<AgendaGroup>(db.agendaGroups),
+    items: new Repository<Item>(db.items),
+    tags: new Repository<Tag>(db.tags),
+    savedViews: new Repository<SavedView>(db.savedViews),
+    statusGroups: new Repository<StatusGroup>(db.statusGroups),
+    statuses: new Repository<Status>(db.statuses),
+  };
+}
+
+/** True while the person has created nothing yet: no agendas, items or tags. */
+export async function isPristine(db: AgendaDatabase): Promise<boolean> {
+  const counts = await Promise.all([db.agendas.count(), db.items.count(), db.tags.count()]);
+  return counts.every((count) => count === 0);
+}

+import {
+  createDefaultStatuses,
+  defaultContext,
+  type Context,
+  type DefaultGroupKey,
+  type DefaultStatusKey,
+} from '../core';
+import type { AgendaDatabase } from './db';
+
+export const SEEDED_KEY = 'defaultsCreated';
+
+/**
+ * Creates the starting Kanban groups and columns the first time the app opens, and never again.
+ * The mark is stored apart from the data, so deleting every group on purpose does not bring the
+ * defaults back. Returns true when it created them.
+ */
+export function ensureDefaultStatuses(
+  db: AgendaDatabase,
+  label: (key: DefaultGroupKey | DefaultStatusKey) => string,
+  ctx: Context = defaultContext,
+): Promise<boolean> {
+  return db.transaction('rw', db.statusGroups, db.statuses, db.meta, async () => {
+    if (await db.meta.get(SEEDED_KEY)) return false;
+    const existing = await db.statusGroups.count();
+    if (existing === 0) {
+      const { groups, statuses } = createDefaultStatuses(label, ctx);
+      await db.statusGroups.bulkPut(groups);
+      await db.statuses.bulkPut(statuses);
+    }
+    await db.meta.put({ key: SEEDED_KEY, value: true });
+    return existing === 0;
+  });
+}

+import {
+  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  isValidPeriodBounds,
+  isValidTimeZone,
+  type PeriodBounds,
+  type Settings,
+} from '../core';
+import type { AgendaDatabase } from './db';
+
+const SETTINGS_KEY = 'settings';
+
+export function isValidSettings(settings: Settings): boolean {
+  return (
+    (settings.displayTimeZone === 'auto' || isValidTimeZone(settings.displayTimeZone)) &&
+    isValidPeriodBounds(settings.periodBounds)
+  );
+}
+
+function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+/** Builds usable settings from anything stored, replacing each bad part with its default. */
+export function normalizeSettings(raw: unknown): Settings {
+  if (!isRecord(raw))
+    return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, periodBounds: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.periodBounds } };
+
+  const zone = raw.displayTimeZone;
+  const displayTimeZone =
+    typeof zone === 'string' && (zone === 'auto' || isValidTimeZone(zone))
+      ? zone
+      : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.displayTimeZone;
+
+  const bounds = raw.periodBounds;
+  let periodBounds: PeriodBounds = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.periodBounds };
+  if (isRecord(bounds)) {
+    const candidate = {
+      morningStart: bounds.morningStart,
+      afternoonStart: bounds.afternoonStart,
+      eveningStart: bounds.eveningStart,
+    } as PeriodBounds;
+    if (isValidPeriodBounds(candidate)) periodBounds = candidate;
+  }
+  return { displayTimeZone, periodBounds };
+}
+
+export async function loadSettings(db: AgendaDatabase): Promise<Settings> {
+  const record = await db.meta.get(SETTINGS_KEY);
+  return normalizeSettings(record?.value);
+}
+
+/** Saves the settings. Throws a RangeError for a zone or period bounds that are not valid. */
+export async function saveSettings(db: AgendaDatabase, settings: Settings): Promise<void> {
+  if (!isValidSettings(settings)) throw new RangeError('Invalid settings');
+  await db.meta.put({ key: SETTINGS_KEY, value: settings });
+}
+
+export { SETTINGS_KEY };

+import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
+import type { Agenda, Id } from '../core';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+export interface AgendaGroupFormValues {
+  name: string;
+  agendaIds: Id[];
+}
+
+interface AgendaGroupFormProps {
+  /** Empty for a new group, filled when editing. */
+  initial?: AgendaGroupFormValues;
+  /** Every agenda, in the order they are shown. */
+  agendas: Agenda[];
+  onSubmit: (values: AgendaGroupFormValues) => Promise<void>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/** Name and member agendas of one group. */
+export function AgendaGroupForm({ initial, agendas, onSubmit, onCancel }: AgendaGroupFormProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const [name, setName] = useState(initial?.name ?? '');
+  const [agendaIds, setAgendaIds] = useState<Id[]>(initial?.agendaIds ?? []);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<'nameRequired' | 'saveFailed' | null>(null);
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+
+  function toggle(id: Id, checked: boolean) {
+    setAgendaIds((current) =>
+      checked ? [...current, id] : current.filter((existing) => existing !== id),
+    );
+  }
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const trimmed = name.trim();
+    if (trimmed === '') {
+      setError('nameRequired');
+      return;
+    }
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      // Saved in the order of the agendas, whatever order the boxes were ticked in
+      await onSubmit({
+        name: trimmed,
+        agendaIds: agendas.filter((agenda) => agendaIds.includes(agenda.id)).map((a) => a.id),
+      });
+    } catch {
+      setError('saveFailed');
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const title = initial ? t.groups.form.editTitle : t.groups.form.createTitle;
+
+  return (
+    <form className="panel" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label={title}>
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{title}</h3>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="group-name" className="field__label">
+          {t.groups.form.name}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="group-name"
+          className="field__input"
+          type="text"
+          value={name}
+          maxLength={80}
+          autoFocus
+          aria-invalid={error === 'nameRequired'}
+          aria-describedby={error === 'nameRequired' ? 'group-name-error' : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => {
+            setName(event.target.value);
+            if (error === 'nameRequired') setError(null);
+          }}
+        />
+        {error === 'nameRequired' && (
+          <p id="group-name-error" role="alert" className="field__error">
+            {t.groups.form.nameRequired}
+          </p>
+        )}
+      </div>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.groups.form.agendas}</legend>
+        {agendas.length === 0 ? (
+          <p className="field__hint">{t.groups.form.createAgendaFirst}</p>
+        ) : (
+          <>
+            <p className="field__hint">{t.groups.form.agendasHint}</p>
+            {agendas.map((agenda) => (
+              <label key={agenda.id} className="check">
+                <input
+                  type="checkbox"
+                  checked={agendaIds.includes(agenda.id)}
+                  onChange={(event) => toggle(agenda.id, event.target.checked)}
+                />
+                <span>{agenda.name}</span>
+              </label>
+            ))}
+          </>
+        )}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      {error === 'saveFailed' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.groups.form.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button type="submit" className="button button--primary" disabled={saving}>
+          {t.groups.form.save}
+        </button>
+        <button type="button" className="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={saving}>
+          {t.groups.form.cancel}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </form>
+  );
+}

+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { createAgendaGroup, isActive, moveStep, type AgendaGroup, type Id } from '../core';
+import { compareAgendas } from '../filters';
+import { AgendaGroupForm, type AgendaGroupFormValues } from './AgendaGroupForm';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { useAgendaGroups, useAgendas } from './data/useEntityList';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+type Mode =
+  | { kind: 'idle' }
+  | { kind: 'create' }
+  | { kind: 'edit'; group: AgendaGroup }
+  | { kind: 'delete'; group: AgendaGroup; failed: boolean };
+
+/**
+ * List, create, edit, reorder and delete agenda groups. A group is only a named list of agendas, so
+ * deleting one never touches the agendas or their items and needs no cascade.
+ */
+export function AgendaGroupsSection() {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { repos, notify } = useData();
+  const agendas = useAgendas();
+  const groups = useAgendaGroups();
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
+  const [orderFailed, setOrderFailed] = useState(false);
+
+  const sortedAgendas = [...agendas.data].sort(compareAgendas);
+  const sorted = [...groups.data].sort(
+    (a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale),
+  );
+
+  /** The names of the agendas of a group that still exist, in the order of the agendas. */
+  function memberNames(group: AgendaGroup): string[] {
+    return sortedAgendas
+      .filter((agenda) => isActive(agenda) && group.agendaIds.includes(agenda.id))
+      .map((agenda) => agenda.name);
+  }
+
+  async function save(values: AgendaGroupFormValues) {
+    if (mode.kind === 'edit') {
+      await repos.agendaGroups.update(mode.group.id, values);
+    } else {
+      const order = groups.data.reduce((max, group) => Math.max(max, group.order + 1), 0);
+      await repos.agendaGroups.put(createAgendaGroup({ ...values, order }));
+    }
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function move(id: Id, step: -1 | 1) {
+    setOrderFailed(false);
+    try {
+      const changes = moveStep(sorted, id, step);
+      await Promise.all(
+        changes.map((change) => repos.agendaGroups.update(change.id, { order: change.order })),
+      );
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setOrderFailed(true);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function confirmDelete(group: AgendaGroup) {
+    setDeleting(true);
+    try {
+      await repos.agendaGroups.remove(group.id);
+      notify();
+      setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    } catch {
+      setMode((current) => (current.kind === 'delete' ? { ...current, failed: true } : current));
+    } finally {
+      setDeleting(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {(groups.failed || agendas.failed) && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.groups.loadFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="button button--primary"
+          onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'create' })}
+        >
+          {t.groups.add}
+        </button>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && (
+        <AgendaGroupForm
+          agendas={sortedAgendas}
+          onSubmit={save}
+          onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+        />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'edit' && (
+        <AgendaGroupForm
+          key={mode.group.id}
+          agendas={sortedAgendas}
+          initial={{ name: mode.group.name, agendaIds: mode.group.agendaIds }}
+          onSubmit={save}
+          onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'delete' && (
+        <div role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="group-delete-text" className="panel panel--danger">
+          <p id="group-delete-text" className="panel__text">
+            {t.groups.confirm.replace('{name}', mode.group.name)}
+          </p>
+          {mode.failed && (
+            <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+              {t.groups.deleteFailed}
+            </p>
+          )}
+          <div className="actions">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button button--danger"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => confirmDelete(mode.group)}
+            >
+              {t.groups.confirmAction}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+            >
+              {t.groups.form.cancel}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {orderFailed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.groups.orderFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {!groups.loading && sorted.length === 0 && mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <p className="placeholder">{t.groups.empty}</p>
+      )}
+
+      {sorted.length > 0 && (
+        <ul className="list">
+          {sorted.map((group, index) => {
+            const names = memberNames(group);
+            return (
+              <li key={group.id} className="list__row">
+                <span className="list__main">
+                  <span className="list__name">{group.name}</span>
+                  <span className="list__meta">
+                    {names.length === 0 ? t.groups.noAgendas : names.join(', ')}
+                  </span>
+                </span>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  disabled={index === 0}
+                  aria-label={t.groups.moveUp.replace('{name}', group.name)}
+                  onClick={() => move(group.id, -1)}
+                >
+                  {t.groups.up}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  disabled={index === sorted.length - 1}
+                  aria-label={t.groups.moveDown.replace('{name}', group.name)}
+                  onClick={() => move(group.id, 1)}
+                >
+                  {t.groups.down}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'edit', group })}
+                >
+                  {t.groups.edit.replace('{name}', group.name)}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'delete', group, failed: false })}
+                >
+                  {t.groups.remove.replace('{name}', group.name)}
+                </button>
+              </li>
+            );
+          })}
+        </ul>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { createAgenda, moveStep, type Agenda, type Id } from '../core';
+import { countAgendaItems, removeAgendaCascade } from '../storage';
+import { AgendaForm, type AgendaFormValues } from './AgendaForm';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { useAgendas, useItems } from './data/useEntityList';
+import { formatCount } from './format';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+type Mode =
+  | { kind: 'idle' }
+  | { kind: 'create' }
+  | { kind: 'edit'; agenda: Agenda }
+  | { kind: 'delete'; agenda: Agenda; count: number; failed: boolean };
+
+/** List, create, edit and delete agendas. Deleting always goes through the cascade. */
+export function AgendasSection() {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { db, repos, notify } = useData();
+  const agendas = useAgendas();
+  const items = useItems();
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
+  const [orderFailed, setOrderFailed] = useState(false);
+
+  const sorted = [...agendas.data].sort(
+    (a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale),
+  );
+
+  async function save(values: AgendaFormValues) {
+    if (mode.kind === 'edit') {
+      await repos.agendas.update(mode.agenda.id, values);
+    } else {
+      const order = agendas.data.reduce((max, agenda) => Math.max(max, agenda.order + 1), 0);
+      await repos.agendas.put(createAgenda({ ...values, order }));
+    }
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function move(id: Id, step: -1 | 1) {
+    setOrderFailed(false);
+    try {
+      const changes = moveStep(sorted, id, step);
+      await Promise.all(
+        changes.map((change) => repos.agendas.update(change.id, { order: change.order })),
+      );
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setOrderFailed(true);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function askToDelete(agenda: Agenda) {
+    try {
+      const count = await countAgendaItems(db, agenda.id);
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', agenda, count, failed: false });
+    } catch {
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', agenda, count: 0, failed: true });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function confirmDelete(agenda: Agenda) {
+    setDeleting(true);
+    try {
+      await removeAgendaCascade(db, agenda.id);
+      notify();
+      setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    } catch {
+      setMode((current) => (current.kind === 'delete' ? { ...current, failed: true } : current));
+    } finally {
+      setDeleting(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {agendas.failed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.agendas.loadFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="button button--primary"
+          onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'create' })}
+        >
+          {t.agendas.add}
+        </button>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && (
+        <AgendaForm onSubmit={save} onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })} />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'edit' && (
+        <AgendaForm
+          key={mode.agenda.id}
+          initial={{ name: mode.agenda.name, color: mode.agenda.color }}
+          onSubmit={save}
+          onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'delete' && (
+        <div
+          role="alertdialog"
+          aria-labelledby="agenda-delete-text"
+          className="panel panel--danger"
+        >
+          <p id="agenda-delete-text" className="panel__text">
+            {formatCount(locale, mode.count, t.agendas.confirm).replace('{name}', mode.agenda.name)}
+          </p>
+          {mode.failed && (
+            <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+              {t.agendas.deleteFailed}
+            </p>
+          )}
+          <div className="actions">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button button--danger"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => confirmDelete(mode.agenda)}
+            >
+              {t.agendas.confirmAction}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+            >
+              {t.agendas.form.cancel}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {!agendas.loading && sorted.length === 0 && mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <p className="placeholder">{t.agendas.empty}</p>
+      )}
+
+      {orderFailed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.agendas.orderFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {sorted.length > 0 && (
+        <ul className="list">
+          {sorted.map((agenda, index) => {
+            const total = items.data.filter((item) => item.agendaId === agenda.id).length;
+            return (
+              <li key={agenda.id} className="list__row">
+                <span
+                  className="list__swatch"
+                  aria-hidden="true"
+                  style={{ background: agenda.color }}
+                />
+                <span className="list__main">
+                  <span className="list__name">{agenda.name}</span>
+                  <span className="list__meta">{formatCount(locale, total, t.counts.items)}</span>
+                </span>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  disabled={index === 0}
+                  aria-label={t.agendas.moveUp.replace('{name}', agenda.name)}
+                  onClick={() => move(agenda.id, -1)}
+                >
+                  {t.agendas.up}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  disabled={index === sorted.length - 1}
+                  aria-label={t.agendas.moveDown.replace('{name}', agenda.name)}
+                  onClick={() => move(agenda.id, 1)}
+                >
+                  {t.agendas.down}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'edit', agenda })}
+                >
+                  {t.agendas.edit.replace('{name}', agenda.name)}
+                </button>
+                <button type="button" className="button" onClick={() => askToDelete(agenda)}>
+                  {t.agendas.remove.replace('{name}', agenda.name)}
+                </button>
+              </li>
+            );
+          })}
+        </ul>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );

+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { LanguageSelect } from './LanguageSelect';
+import { ManageScreen } from './ManageScreen';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle';
+import { INITIAL_TIMELINE_MEMORY } from './timelineMemory';
+import { TimelineView } from './TimelineView';
+import { useThemeMode } from './useThemeMode';
+
+const VIEWS = ['timeline', 'calendar', 'kanban'] as const;
+type View = (typeof VIEWS)[number];
+
+export function AppShell() {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { mode, setMode } = useThemeMode();
+  const [view, setView] = useState<View>('timeline');
+  const [managing, setManaging] = useState(false);
+  // Kept here so the Timeline filters survive a trip to another tab or to Manage
+  const [timelineMemory, setTimelineMemory] = useState(INITIAL_TIMELINE_MEMORY);
+
+  return (
+    <div className="shell">
+      <header className="shell__header">
+        <h1 className="shell__title">{t.appName}</h1>
+        <div className="shell__controls">
+          <button
+            type="button"
+            className="manage-button"
+            aria-pressed={managing}
+            onClick={() => setManaging((current) => !current)}
+          >
+            {t.manage.open}
+          </button>
+          <LanguageSelect />
+          <ThemeToggle mode={mode} onChange={setMode} />
+        </div>
+      </header>
+
+      {managing ? (
+        <main className="shell__main">
+          <ManageScreen />
+        </main>
+      ) : (
+        <main
+          className="shell__main"
+          id={`panel-${view}`}
+          role="tabpanel"
+          aria-labelledby={`tab-${view}`}
+        >
+          {view === 'timeline' ? (
+            <TimelineView memory={timelineMemory} onMemoryChange={setTimelineMemory} />
+          ) : (
+            <p className="placeholder">{t.placeholder[view]}</p>
+          )}
+        </main>
+      )}
+
+      <nav className="shell__nav" aria-label={t.nav.label}>
+        <div role="tablist" className="tabs">
+          {VIEWS.map((item) => (
+            <button
+              key={item}
+              id={`tab-${item}`}
+              type="button"
+              role="tab"
+              aria-selected={!managing && view === item}
+              aria-controls={`panel-${item}`}
+              className="tabs__tab"
+              onClick={() => {
+                setView(item);
+                setManaging(false);
+              }}
+            >
+              {t.nav[item]}
+            </button>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+      </nav>
+    </div>
+  );

+import { useState, type ChangeEvent } from 'react';
+import {
+  backupFileName,
+  exportBackup,
+  importBackup,
+  isPristine,
+  parseBackup,
+  serializeBackup,
+  type BackupFile,
+  type ImportIssue,
+  type ImportMode,
+  type ImportSummary,
+} from '../storage';
+import {
+  downloadText,
+  formatIssue,
+  MAX_ISSUES_SHOWN,
+  readFileText,
+  totalSummary,
+} from './backupValues';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { formatCount, formatDate } from './format';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+type Stage =
+  | { kind: 'idle' }
+  | { kind: 'issues'; fileName: string; issues: ImportIssue[] }
+  | { kind: 'ready'; fileName: string; backup: BackupFile; pristine: boolean }
+  | { kind: 'done'; summary: ImportSummary };
+
+type Notice =
+  | { kind: 'exported'; name: string }
+  | { kind: 'error'; key: 'exportFailed' | 'readFailed' | 'importFailed' };
+
+/** Saves everything to a file and brings it back, merging or replacing. */
+export function BackupSection() {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { db, notify } = useData();
+  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice | null>(null);
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ImportMode>('merge');
+  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+
+  async function handleExport() {
+    setNotice(null);
+    try {
+      const backup = await exportBackup(db);
+      const name = backupFileName(backup.exportedAt);
+      downloadText(name, serializeBackup(backup));
+      setNotice({ kind: 'exported', name });
+    } catch {
+      setNotice({ kind: 'error', key: 'exportFailed' });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function handleFile(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
+    const input = event.currentTarget;
+    const file = input.files?.[0];
+    // Clear the field so choosing the same file again still counts as a change
+    input.value = '';
+    if (!file) return;
+    setNotice(null);
+    setConfirming(false);
+
+    let text: string;
+    try {
+      text = await readFileText(file);
+    } catch {
+      setStage({ kind: 'idle' });
+      setNotice({ kind: 'error', key: 'readFailed' });
+      return;
+    }
+    const parsed = parseBackup(text);
+    if (!parsed.ok) {
+      setStage({ kind: 'issues', fileName: file.name, issues: parsed.issues });
+      return;
+    }
+    const pristine = await isPristine(db).catch(() => false);
+    setMode(pristine ? 'replace' : 'merge');
+    setStage({ kind: 'ready', fileName: file.name, backup: parsed.backup, pristine });
+  }
+
+  async function runImport(current: Extract<Stage, { kind: 'ready' }>) {
+    setBusy(true);
+    setNotice(null);
+    try {
+      const result = await importBackup(db, current.backup, mode);
+      if (result.ok) {
+        setStage({ kind: 'done', summary: result.summary });
+        notify();
+      } else {
+        setStage({ kind: 'issues', fileName: current.fileName, issues: result.issues });
+      }
+      setConfirming(false);
+    } catch {
+      setNotice({ kind: 'error', key: 'importFailed' });
+    }
+    setBusy(false);
+  }
+
+  function handleImportClick(current: Extract<Stage, { kind: 'ready' }>) {
+    if (mode === 'replace' && !current.pristine) setConfirming(true);
+    else void runImport(current);
+  }
+
+  const noticeText =
+    notice === null
+      ? null
+      : notice.kind === 'exported'
+        ? t.backup.exported.replace('{name}', notice.name)
+        : t.backup[notice.key];
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="backup-export-title">
+        <h3 id="backup-export-title" className="panel__title">
+          {t.backup.exportTitle}
+        </h3>
+        <p className="panel__text">{t.backup.exportHint}</p>
+        <div className="actions">
+          <button type="button" className="button button--primary" onClick={handleExport}>
+            {t.backup.exportAction}
+          </button>
+        </div>
+      </section>
+
+      <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="backup-import-title">
+        <h3 id="backup-import-title" className="panel__title">
+          {t.backup.importTitle}
+        </h3>
+        <p className="panel__text">{t.backup.importHint}</p>
+        <div className="field">
+          <label htmlFor="backup-file" className="field__label">
+            {t.backup.fileLabel}
+          </label>
+          <input
+            id="backup-file"
+            className="field__input"
+            type="file"
+            accept=".json,application/json"
+            onChange={handleFile}
+          />
+        </div>
+
+        {stage.kind === 'issues' && (
+          <div role="alert">
+            <p className="field__error">
+              {t.backup.problemsTitle.replace('{name}', stage.fileName)}
+            </p>
+            <ul className="issue-list">
+              {stage.issues.slice(0, MAX_ISSUES_SHOWN).map((issue, index) => (
+                <li key={`${issue.path}-${index}`}>{formatIssue(issue, t)}</li>
+              ))}
+            </ul>
+            {stage.issues.length > MAX_ISSUES_SHOWN && (
+              <p className="field__hint">
+                {formatCount(locale, stage.issues.length - MAX_ISSUES_SHOWN, t.backup.moreProblems)}
+              </p>
+            )}
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {stage.kind === 'ready' && (
+          <ReadyPanel
+            stage={stage}
+            mode={mode}
+            busy={busy}
+            onMode={(next) => {
+              setMode(next);
+              setConfirming(false);
+            }}
+            onImport={() => handleImportClick(stage)}
+          />
+        )}
+
+        {stage.kind === 'ready' && confirming && (
+          <div
+            role="alertdialog"
+            aria-labelledby="backup-confirm-text"
+            className="panel panel--danger"
+          >
+            <p id="backup-confirm-text" className="panel__text">
+              {t.backup.confirmReplace}
+            </p>
+            <div className="actions">
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button button--danger"
+                disabled={busy}
+                onClick={() => void runImport(stage)}
+              >
+                {t.backup.confirmReplaceAction}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                disabled={busy}
+                onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}
+              >
+                {t.backup.cancel}
+              </button>
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {stage.kind === 'done' && <DonePanel summary={stage.summary} />}
+      </section>
+
+      {noticeText && (
+        <p
+          role={notice?.kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}
+          className={notice?.kind === 'error' ? 'field__error' : 'field__status'}
+        >
+          {noticeText}
+        </p>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+function ReadyPanel(props: {
+  stage: Extract<Stage, { kind: 'ready' }>;
+  mode: ImportMode;
+  busy: boolean;
+  onMode: (mode: ImportMode) => void;
+  onImport: () => void;
+}) {
+  const { stage, mode, busy, onMode, onImport } = props;
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { backup } = stage;
+  const agendas = backup.data.agendas.filter((agenda) => agenda.deletedAt === null).length;
+  const items = backup.data.items.filter((item) => item.deletedAt === null).length;
+  const summary = t.backup.fileSummary
+    .replace('{date}', formatDate(locale, backup.exportedAt.slice(0, 10)))
+    .replace('{agendas}', formatCount(locale, agendas, t.counts.agendas))
+    .replace('{items}', formatCount(locale, items, t.counts.items));
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <p className="panel__text">{summary}</p>
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.backup.modeLegend}</legend>
+        <div className="choices">
+          {(['merge', 'replace'] as const).map((option) => (
+            <label key={option} className="choice">
+              <input
+                type="radio"
+                name="import-mode"
+                checked={mode === option}
+                onChange={() => onMode(option)}
+              />
+              {t.backup.modes[option]}
+            </label>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+        <p className="field__hint">{t.backup.modeHints[mode]}</p>
+        {stage.pristine && <p className="field__hint">{t.backup.emptySuggestion}</p>}
+      </fieldset>
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button type="button" className="button button--primary" disabled={busy} onClick={onImport}>
+          {t.backup.importAction}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+function DonePanel({ summary }: { summary: ImportSummary }) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const total = totalSummary(summary);
+  const format = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString(locale);

+          .replace('{added}', format(total.added))
+          .replace('{updated}', format(total.updated))
+          .replace('{skipped}', format(total.skipped))}
+      </p>
+      {summary.settingsApplied && <p className="field__status">{t.backup.settingsApplied}</p>}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';

+  emptyEventValues,
+  knownTimeZones,

+  type FieldKey,

+const MODES: ScheduleMode[] = ['none', 'allDay', 'timed'];
+
+interface EventFormProps {
+  /** Empty for a new event, filled when editing. */
+  initial?: EventFormValues;
+  /** Overrides the title of the form, for example for a work block. */
+  heading?: string;
+  /** The zone dates are shown in, used to explain what an empty time zone means. */
+  displayTimeZone: string;
+  /** Where the tags and the inheritance switch come from. Without it the form has no tags. */
+  tagContext?: TagContext;
+  /** Returns the problems to show, or null when the event was saved. */
+  onSubmit: (values: EventFormValues) => Promise<FieldErrors | null>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/** Create or edit one event: title, when, place, notes and links. */
+export function EventForm({
+  initial,
+  heading,
+  displayTimeZone,
+  tagContext,
+  onSubmit,
+  onCancel,
+}: EventFormProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const [values, setValues] = useState<EventFormValues>(initial ?? emptyEventValues());
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>({});
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+  const zones = useMemo(() => knownTimeZones(), []);
+
+  const title = heading ?? (initial ? t.items.form.editTitle : t.items.form.createTitle);
+
+  function change(changes: Partial<EventFormValues>, clear: FieldKey[] = []) {
+    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, ...changes }));
+    if (clear.length > 0) {
+      setErrors((current) => {
+        const next = { ...current };
+        for (const key of clear) delete next[key];
+        return next;
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      const problems = await onSubmit(values);
+      if (problems) {
+        setErrors(problems);
+        setSaving(false);
+      }
+    } catch {
+      setErrors({ form: 'saveFailed' });
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function message(key: FieldKey): string | null {
+    const issue = errors[key];
+    if (!issue) return null;
+    return t.items.issues[issue];
+  }
+
+  function fieldError(key: FieldKey, id: string) {
+    const text = message(key);
+    return text ? (
+      <p id={id} role="alert" className="field__error">
+        {text}
+      </p>
+    ) : null;
+  }
+
+  const timed = values.mode === 'timed';
+  const scheduled = values.mode !== 'none';
+
+  return (
+    <form className="panel" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label={title}>
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{title}</h3>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="event-title" className="field__label">
+          {t.items.form.title}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="event-title"
+          className="field__input"
+          type="text"
+          value={values.title}
+          maxLength={200}
+          autoFocus
+          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.title)}
+          aria-describedby={errors.title ? 'event-title-error' : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => change({ title: event.target.value }, ['title'])}
+        />
+        {fieldError('title', 'event-title-error')}
+      </div>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.items.form.when}</legend>
+        <div className="choices">
+          {MODES.map((mode) => (
+            <label key={mode} className="choice">
+              <input
+                type="radio"
+                name="event-mode"
+                value={mode}
+                checked={values.mode === mode}
+                onChange={() => change({ mode }, ['start', 'end', 'timeZone'])}
+              />
+              {t.items.form.modes[mode]}
+            </label>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+      </fieldset>
+
+      {scheduled && (
+        <>
+          <div className="field-pair">
+            <div className="field">
+              <label htmlFor="event-start-date" className="field__label">
+                {t.items.form.startDate}
+              </label>
+              <input
+                id="event-start-date"
+                className="field__input"
+                type="date"
+                value={values.startDate}
+                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.start)}
+                aria-describedby={errors.start ? 'event-start-error' : undefined}
+                onChange={(event) => change({ startDate: event.target.value }, ['start', 'end'])}
+              />
+            </div>
+            {timed && (
+              <div className="field">
+                <label htmlFor="event-start-time" className="field__label">
+                  {t.items.form.startTime}
+                </label>
+                <input
+                  id="event-start-time"
+                  className="field__input"
+                  type="time"
+                  value={values.startTime}
+                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.start)}
+                  aria-describedby={errors.start ? 'event-start-error' : undefined}
+                  onChange={(event) => change({ startTime: event.target.value }, ['start', 'end'])}
+                />
+              </div>
+            )}
+          </div>
+          {fieldError('start', 'event-start-error')}
+
+          <div className="field-pair">
+            <div className="field">
+              <label htmlFor="event-end-date" className="field__label">
+                {t.items.form.endDate}
+              </label>
+              <input
+                id="event-end-date"
+                className="field__input"
+                type="date"
+                value={values.endDate}
+                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.end)}
+                aria-describedby={errors.end ? 'event-end-error' : undefined}
+                onChange={(event) => change({ endDate: event.target.value }, ['end'])}
+              />
+            </div>
+            {timed && (

+                </label>
+                <input
+                  id="event-end-time"
+                  className="field__input"
+                  type="time"
+                  value={values.endTime}
+                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.end)}
+                  aria-describedby={errors.end ? 'event-end-error' : undefined}
+                  onChange={(event) => change({ endTime: event.target.value }, ['end'])}
+                />
+              </div>
+            )}
+          </div>
+          {fieldError('end', 'event-end-error')}
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {timed && (
+        <div className="field">
+          <label htmlFor="event-zone" className="field__label">
+            {t.items.form.timeZone}

+          <input

+            className="field__input"
+            type="text"
+            list="event-zone-list"
+            value={values.timeZone}
+            autoCapitalize="off"
+            autoComplete="off"
+            spellCheck={false}

+import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
+import type { Id, Item, Progress, Tag } from '../core';
+import { formatDate, formatDue, formatPercent, formatSchedule } from './format';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+/** What every row of the tree needs. Built once by the section and shared down the tree. */
+export interface ItemTreeShared {
+  /** The active children of an item, already in order. */
+  childrenOf: (id: Id) => Item[];
+  progress: ReadonlyMap<Id, Progress>;
+  statusNames: ReadonlyMap<Id, string>;
+  /** The tags of an item: its own and the inherited ones, each with the item it comes from. */
+  tagsOf: (item: Item) => { own: Tag[]; inherited: { tag: Tag; from: Item }[] };
+  /** The items whose children are showing. Everything starts folded. */
+  expanded: ReadonlySet<Id>;
+  zone: string;
+  onToggle: (item: Item) => void;
+  onEdit: (item: Item) => void;
+  onAddTask: (parent: Item) => void;
+  onAddBlock: (parent: Item) => void;
+  onMove: (item: Item) => void;
+  onDelete: (item: Item) => void;
+}
+
+interface ItemTreeProps {
+  items: Item[];
+  depth?: number;
+  shared: ItemTreeShared;
+}
+
+/**
+ * One level of the tree and, below each open item, the next level. A folded item draws none of
+ * its children, so a big tree stays cheap to show. The depth only moves the row to the right.
+ */
+export function ItemTree({ items, depth = 0, shared }: ItemTreeProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+
+  function meta(item: Item): string {
+    const parts: string[] = [t.items.kind[item.kind]];
+
+    if (item.kind === 'task') {
+      parts.push(
+        item.statusId !== null
+          ? (shared.statusNames.get(item.statusId) ?? t.items.noStatus)
+          : t.items.noStatus,
+      );
+      if (item.from !== null) {
+        parts.push(t.items.from.replace('{date}', formatDate(locale, item.from)));
+      }
+      parts.push(
+        item.due
+          ? t.items.due.replace('{when}', formatDue(locale, item.due, shared.zone))
+          : t.items.noDue,
+      );
+    } else {
+      parts.push(
+        item.schedule
+          ? `${formatSchedule(locale, item.schedule, shared.zone, t.items.range)}${
+              item.schedule.allDay ? ` (${t.items.allDay})` : ''
+            }`
+          : t.items.noSchedule,
+      );
+    }
+    if (item.location !== '') parts.push(item.location);
+    return parts.join(' · ');
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <ul className={depth === 0 ? 'list' : 'list list--nested'}>
+      {items.map((item) => {
+        const kids = shared.childrenOf(item.id);
+        const open = shared.expanded.has(item.id);
+        // Only an item with a counted child shows progress. A task with just work blocks below it
+        // is still a leaf for the count, and a bare leaf has nothing worth a bar.
+        const hasCounted = kids.some((kid) => shared.progress.has(kid.id));
+        const progress = hasCounted ? shared.progress.get(item.id) : undefined;
+        const name = item.title;
+
+        return (
+          <li key={item.id}>
+            <div className="list__row tree-row" style={{ '--depth': depth } as CSSProperties}>
+              {kids.length > 0 ? (
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button tree-row__toggle"
+                  aria-expanded={open}
+                  aria-label={(open ? t.items.hideInside : t.items.showInside).replace(
+                    '{name}',
+                    name,
+                  )}
+                  onClick={() => shared.onToggle(item)}
+                >
+                  <span aria-hidden="true">{open ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
+                </button>
+              ) : (
+                <span className="tree-row__spacer" aria-hidden="true" />
+              )}
+
+              <span className="list__main">
+                <span className="list__name">{name}</span>
+                <span className="list__meta">{meta(item)}</span>
+                <ItemTags item={item} shared={shared} />
+                {progress && (
+                  <span className="list__meta tree-row__progress">
+                    <progress value={progress.completed} max={progress.total} aria-hidden="true" />
+                    {t.items.progress
+                      .replace('{completed}', String(progress.completed))
+                      .replace('{total}', String(progress.total))
+                      .replace('{percent}', formatPercent(locale, progress.ratio))}
+                  </span>
+                )}
+              </span>
+
+              <span className="actions tree-row__actions">
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  aria-label={t.items.edit.replace('{name}', name)}
+                  onClick={() => shared.onEdit(item)}
+                >
+                  {t.items.short.edit}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  aria-label={t.items.addSubtask.replace('{name}', name)}
+                  onClick={() => shared.onAddTask(item)}
+                >
+                  {t.items.short.addSubtask}
+                </button>
+                {item.kind === 'task' && (
+                  <button
+                    type="button"
+                    className="button"
+                    aria-label={t.items.addBlock.replace('{name}', name)}
+                    onClick={() => shared.onAddBlock(item)}
+                  >
+                    {t.items.short.addBlock}
+                  </button>
+                )}
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  aria-label={t.items.move.replace('{name}', name)}
+                  onClick={() => shared.onMove(item)}
+                >
+                  {t.items.short.move}
+                </button>
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  aria-label={t.items.remove.replace('{name}', name)}
+                  onClick={() => shared.onDelete(item)}
+                >
+                  {t.items.short.remove}
+                </button>
+              </span>
+            </div>
+
+            {open && kids.length > 0 && <ItemTree items={kids} depth={depth + 1} shared={shared} />}
+          </li>
+        );
+      })}
+    </ul>
+  );
+}
+
+/** The tags of a row: own ones in full color, inherited ones dimmed and saying where from. */
+function ItemTags({ item, shared }: { item: Item; shared: ItemTreeShared }) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { own, inherited } = shared.tagsOf(item);
+  if (own.length === 0 && inherited.length === 0) return null;
+  return (
+    <ul className="chips" aria-label={t.items.tagsField.legend}>
+      {own.map((tag) => (
+        <li key={tag.id} className="chip">
+          <span className="chip__dot" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: tag.color }} />
+          {tag.name}
+        </li>
+      ))}
+      {inherited.map(({ tag, from }) => (
+        <li key={`inherited-${tag.id}`} className="chip chip--inherited">
+          <span className="chip__dot" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: tag.color }} />
+          {t.items.tagChip.inherited.replace('{tag}', tag.name).replace('{item}', from.title)}
+        </li>
+      ))}
+    </ul>
+  );
+}

+import { useState } from 'react';

+import { EventForm } from './EventForm';

+  buildEventFields,

+} from './eventValues';

+
+type Mode =
+  | { kind: 'idle' }
+  /** `parent` is the item the new one goes inside, or null for the top level of the agenda. */
+  | { kind: 'create'; what: 'event' | 'task' | 'block'; parent: Item | null }
+  | { kind: 'edit'; item: Item }
+  | { kind: 'move'; item: Item }
+  | { kind: 'delete'; item: Item; count: number; failed: boolean };
+
+/**
+ * The items of one agenda, one agenda at a time, as a tree. Events and tasks can be created,
+ * edited, moved and deleted. A task can hold sub-items and work blocks, and shows its progress.
+ */
+export function ItemsSection() {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { db, repos, notify } = useData();
+  const agendas = useAgendas();
+  const items = useItems();
+  const statuses = useStatuses();
+  const statusGroups = useStatusGroups();
+  const tags = useTags();
+  const zone = useDisplayTimeZone();
+  const [chosenId, setChosenId] = useState<Id | null>(null);
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
+  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<ReadonlySet<Id>>(new Set());
+
+  // The zone is read from the settings first, so a time is never shown in the wrong zone
+  if (zone === null || agendas.loading) return null;
+
+  const sortedAgendas = [...agendas.data].sort(
+    (a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale),
+  );
+  // If the chosen agenda was deleted, fall back to the first one
+  const agenda = sortedAgendas.find((candidate) => candidate.id === chosenId) ?? sortedAgendas[0];
+
+  if (!agenda) {
+    return (
+      <>
+        {agendas.failed && (
+          <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+            {t.agendas.loadFailed}
+          </p>
+        )}
+        <p className="placeholder">{t.items.noAgendas}</p>
+      </>
+    );
+  }
+
+  const agendaItems = items.data.filter((item) => item.agendaId === agenda.id);
+  const byOrder = (a: Item, b: Item) => a.order - b.order || a.title.localeCompare(b.title, locale);
+  const children = childrenIndex(agendaItems);
+  for (const list of children.values()) list.sort(byOrder);
+  const topLevel = agendaItems.filter((item) => item.parentId === null).sort(byOrder);
+  const childrenOf = (id: Id): Item[] => children.get(id) ?? [];
+
+  const progress = computeProgress(agendaItems, doneStatusIds(statuses.data, statusGroups.data));
+
+  // The statuses in the order of the board: groups by order, columns by order inside each group
+  const statusChoices: StatusChoice[] = [...statusGroups.data]
+    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)
+    .map((group) => ({
+      group,
+      statuses: statuses.data
+        .filter((s) => s.groupId === group.id)
+        .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order),
+    }))
+    .filter((choice) => choice.statuses.length > 0);
+  const plannedFirst = statusChoices.find((choice) => choice.group.role === 'planned');
+  const defaultStatusId = (plannedFirst ?? statusChoices[0])?.statuses[0]?.id ?? '';
+  const statusNames = new Map(statuses.data.map((status) => [status.id, status.name]));
+
+  const itemById = indexById(agendaItems);
+  const tagById = new Map(tags.data.map((tag) => [tag.id, tag]));
+  /** The tags a row shows: its own, and the ones it inherits with the item they come from. */
+  function tagsOf(item: Item) {
+    const own = item.tagIds.flatMap((id) => tagById.get(id) ?? []);
+    const inherited = inheritedTags(item, itemById).flatMap((entry) => {
+      const tag = tagById.get(entry.tagId);
+      const from = itemById.get(entry.fromItemId);
+      return tag && from ? [{ tag, from }] : [];
+    });
+    return { own, inherited };
+  }
+
+  /** What the tags field of a form needs. A new item is a blank draft inside its parent. */
+  function tagContext(parent: Item | null, existing?: Item) {
+    const base =
+      existing ??
+      createItem({ kind: 'task', title: '', agendaId: agenda!.id, parentId: parent?.id ?? null });
+    return { tags: tags.data, items: agendaItems, base };
+  }
+
+  /** The next free position among the children of a parent (or of the top level). */
+  function nextOrder(parentId: Id | null, ignoreId?: Id): number {
+    return agendaItems
+      .filter((item) => item.parentId === parentId && item.id !== ignoreId)
+      .reduce((max, item) => Math.max(max, item.order + 1), 0);
+  }
+
+  /** Opens an item and everything above it, so a new or moved item is not hidden in a fold. */
+  function reveal(id: Id | null) {
+    if (id === null) return;
+    const path = pathFromRoot(id, indexById(agendaItems)).map((step) => step.id);
+    setExpanded((current) => new Set([...current, ...path]));
+  }
+
+  function pickAgenda(id: Id) {
+    setChosenId(id);
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  function toggle(item: Item) {
+    setExpanded((current) => {
+      const next = new Set(current);
+      if (next.has(item.id)) next.delete(item.id);
+      else next.add(item.id);
+      return next;
+    });
+  }
+
+  async function saveEvent(values: EventFormValues) {
+    const existing = mode.kind === 'edit' ? mode.item : undefined;
+    const parent = mode.kind === 'create' ? mode.parent : null;
+    const result = buildEventFields(values, zone!, { agendaId: agenda!.id, existing });
+    if (!result.fields) return result.errors;
+
+    if (existing) {
+      await repos.items.update(existing.id, result.fields);
+    } else {
+      const parentId = parent?.id ?? null;
+      await repos.items.put(
+        createItem({
+          kind: 'event',
+          agendaId: agenda!.id,
+          parentId,
+          order: nextOrder(parentId),
+          ...result.fields,
+        }),
+      );
+      reveal(parentId);
+    }
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  async function saveTask(values: TaskFormValues) {
+    const existing = mode.kind === 'edit' ? mode.item : undefined;
+    const parent = mode.kind === 'create' ? mode.parent : null;
+    const result = buildTaskFields(values, zone!, {
+      agendaId: agenda!.id,
+      parentId: parent?.id ?? null,
+      existing,
+    });
+    if (!result.fields) return result.errors;
+
+    if (existing) {
+      await repos.items.update(existing.id, result.fields);
+    } else {
+      const parentId = parent?.id ?? null;
+      await repos.items.put(
+        createItem({
+          kind: 'task',
+          agendaId: agenda!.id,
+          parentId,
+          order: nextOrder(parentId),
+          ...result.fields,
+        }),
+      );
+      reveal(parentId);
+    }
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  async function move(item: Item, parentId: Id | null) {
+    await repos.items.update(item.id, { parentId, order: nextOrder(parentId, item.id) });
+    reveal(parentId);
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function askToDelete(item: Item) {
+    try {
+      const count = await countItemSubtree(db, item.id);
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', item, count, failed: false });
+    } catch {
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', item, count: 1, failed: true });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function confirmDelete(item: Item) {
+    setDeleting(true);
+    try {
+      await removeItemCascade(db, item.id);
+      notify();
+      setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    } catch {
+      setMode((current) => (current.kind === 'delete' ? { ...current, failed: true } : current));
+    } finally {
+      setDeleting(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const shared: ItemTreeShared = {
+    childrenOf,
+    progress,
+    statusNames,
+    tagsOf,
+    expanded,
+    zone,
+    onToggle: toggle,
+    onEdit: (item) => setMode({ kind: 'edit', item }),
+    onAddTask: (parent) => setMode({ kind: 'create', what: 'task', parent }),
+    onAddBlock: (parent) => setMode({ kind: 'create', what: 'block', parent }),
+    onMove: (item) => setMode({ kind: 'move', item }),
+    onDelete: askToDelete,
+  };
+
+  const cancel = () => setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const parentOfCreate = mode.kind === 'create' ? mode.parent : null;
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {(agendas.failed || items.failed) && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {items.failed ? t.items.loadFailed : t.agendas.loadFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="items-agenda" className="field__label">
+          {t.items.agendaLabel}
+        </label>
+        <select
+          id="items-agenda"
+          className="field__input"
+          value={agenda.id}
+          onChange={(event) => pickAgenda(event.target.value)}
+        >
+          {sortedAgendas.map((candidate) => (
+            <option key={candidate.id} value={candidate.id}>
+              {candidate.name}
+            </option>
+          ))}
+        </select>
+      </div>
+
+      {mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <div className="actions">
+          <button
+            type="button"
+            className="button button--primary"
+            onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'create', what: 'event', parent: null })}
+          >
+            {t.items.addEvent}
+          </button>
+          <button
+            type="button"
+            className="button button--primary"
+            onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'create', what: 'task', parent: null })}
+          >
+            {t.items.addTask}
+          </button>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && parentOfCreate && (
+        <p className="field__hint">{t.items.insideOf.replace('{name}', parentOfCreate.title)}</p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && mode.what === 'event' && (
+        <EventForm
+          displayTimeZone={zone}
+          tagContext={tagContext(parentOfCreate)}
+          onSubmit={saveEvent}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && mode.what === 'block' && (
+        <EventForm
+          initial={{ ...emptyEventValues(), mode: 'timed' }}
+          heading={t.items.form.blockTitle}
+          displayTimeZone={zone}
+          tagContext={tagContext(parentOfCreate)}
+          onSubmit={saveEvent}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && mode.what === 'task' && (
+        <TaskForm
+          defaultStatusId={defaultStatusId}
+          statusChoices={statusChoices}
+          displayTimeZone={zone}
+          tagContext={tagContext(parentOfCreate)}
+          onSubmit={saveTask}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'edit' && mode.item.kind === 'event' && (
+        <EventForm
+          key={mode.item.id}
+          initial={valuesFromItem(mode.item, zone)}
+          displayTimeZone={zone}
+          tagContext={tagContext(null, mode.item)}
+          onSubmit={saveEvent}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'edit' && mode.item.kind === 'task' && (
+        <TaskForm
+          key={mode.item.id}
+          initial={valuesFromTask(mode.item, zone)}
+          defaultStatusId={defaultStatusId}
+          statusChoices={statusChoices}
+          displayTimeZone={zone}
+          tagContext={tagContext(null, mode.item)}
+          onSubmit={saveTask}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'move' && (
+        <MovePanel
+          key={mode.item.id}
+          item={mode.item}
+          items={agendaItems}
+          onMove={(parentId) => move(mode.item, parentId)}
+          onCancel={cancel}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'delete' && (
+        <div role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="item-delete-text" className="panel panel--danger">
+          <p id="item-delete-text" className="panel__text">
+            {formatCount(locale, mode.count, t.items.confirm).replace('{name}', mode.item.title)}
+          </p>
+          {mode.failed && (
+            <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+              {t.items.deleteFailed}
+            </p>
+          )}
+          <div className="actions">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button button--danger"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => confirmDelete(mode.item)}
+            >
+              {t.items.confirmAction}
+            </button>
+            <button type="button" className="button" disabled={deleting} onClick={cancel}>
+              {t.items.form.cancel}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {!items.loading && topLevel.length === 0 && mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <p className="placeholder">{t.items.empty}</p>
+      )}
+
+      {topLevel.length > 0 && <ItemTree items={topLevel} shared={shared} />}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
