+import type { LinkValues } from './eventValues';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+interface LinksFieldProps {
+  /** Prefix for the ids, so two forms never share an id. */
+  idPrefix: string;
+  links: LinkValues[];
+  /** The message to show, or null. */
+  error: string | null;
+  onChange: (links: LinkValues[]) => void;
+}
+
+/** The list of links (name and address) of an item. Shared by the event and task forms. */
+export function LinksField({ idPrefix, links, error, onChange }: LinksFieldProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+
+  function change(index: number, changes: Partial<LinkValues>) {
+    onChange(links.map((link, i) => (i === index ? { ...link, ...changes } : link)));
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <fieldset className="field field--group">
+      <legend className="field__label">{t.items.form.links}</legend>
+      {links.map((link, index) => {
+        const number = String(index + 1);
+        return (
+          <div key={index} className="link-row">
+            <input
+              className="field__input"
+              type="text"
+              value={link.label}
+              aria-label={t.items.form.linkName.replace('{n}', number)}
+              onChange={(event) => change(index, { label: event.target.value })}
+            />
+            <input
+              className="field__input"
+              type="url"
+              inputMode="url"
+              autoCapitalize="off"
+              spellCheck={false}
+              value={link.url}
+              aria-label={t.items.form.linkAddress.replace('{n}', number)}
+              aria-invalid={error !== null}
+              onChange={(event) => change(index, { url: event.target.value })}
+            />
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              onClick={() => onChange(links.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
+            >
+              {t.items.form.removeLink.replace('{n}', number)}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        );
+      })}
+      {error && (
+        <p id={`${idPrefix}-links-error`} role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {error}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="button"
+          onClick={() => onChange([...links, { label: '', url: '' }])}
+        >
+          {t.items.form.addLink}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </fieldset>
+  );
+}

+import { useState } from 'react';

+        {section === 'agendas' && <AgendasSection />}

+import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+import { indexById, pathFromRoot, wouldCreateCycle, type Id, type Item } from '../core';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+interface MovePanelProps {
+  /** The item to move. */
+  item: Item;
+  /** Every active item of the same agenda. */
+  items: Item[];
+  /** Resolves when the move is saved. A rejection shows the failure message. */
+  onMove: (parentId: Id | null) => Promise<void>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The touch alternative to dragging: choose the new parent from a list. The item itself and
+ * everything inside it are not offered, because an item cannot go inside its own subtree.
+ */
+export function MovePanel({ item, items, onMove, onCancel }: MovePanelProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const [target, setTarget] = useState<string>(item.parentId ?? '');
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
+
+  const options = useMemo(() => {
+    const byId = indexById(items);
+    return items
+      .filter((candidate) => !wouldCreateCycle(item.id, candidate.id, items))
+      .map((candidate) => ({
+        id: candidate.id,
+        label: pathFromRoot(candidate.id, byId)
+          .map((step) => step.title)
+          .join(' / '),
+      }))
+      .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label, locale));
+  }, [item.id, items, locale]);
+
+  async function submit() {
+    setSaving(true);
+    setFailed(false);
+    try {
+      await onMove(target === '' ? null : target);
+    } catch {
+      setFailed(true);
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const unchanged = target === (item.parentId ?? '');
+
+  return (
+    <div role="group" aria-label={t.items.movePanel.title} className="panel">
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{t.items.movePanel.title.replace('{name}', item.title)}</h3>
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="move-target" className="field__label">
+          {t.items.movePanel.target}
+        </label>
+        <select
+          id="move-target"
+          className="field__input"
+          value={target}
+          onChange={(event) => setTarget(event.target.value)}
+        >
+          <option value="">{t.items.movePanel.topLevel}</option>
+          {options.map((option) => (
+            <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>
+              {option.label}
+            </option>
+          ))}
+        </select>
+      </div>
+      {failed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.items.movePanel.failed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="button button--primary"
+          disabled={saving || unchanged}
+          onClick={submit}
+        >
+          {t.items.movePanel.action}
+        </button>
+        <button type="button" className="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onCancel}>
+          {t.items.form.cancel}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
+import { deviceTimeZone, type Settings } from '../core';
+import { loadSettings, saveSettings } from '../storage';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { knownTimeZones } from './eventValues';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import {
+  buildSettings,
+  settingsToValues,
+  type SettingsErrors,
+  type SettingsFormValues,
+} from './settingsValues';
+
+type Loaded =
+  { status: 'loading' } | { status: 'failed' } | { status: 'ready'; settings: Settings };
+
+const HOUR_FIELDS = ['morningStart', 'afternoonStart', 'eveningStart'] as const;
+
+/** Display time zone and the three hours that split the day into periods. */
+export function SettingsSection() {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { db } = useData();
+  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded>({ status: 'loading' });
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    loadSettings(db)
+      .then((settings) => {
+        if (!cancelled) setLoaded({ status: 'ready', settings });
+      })
+      .catch(() => {
+        if (!cancelled) setLoaded({ status: 'failed' });
+      });
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+    };
+  }, [db]);
+
+  if (loaded.status === 'loading') return null;
+  if (loaded.status === 'failed') {
+    return (
+      <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+        {t.settings.loadFailed}
+      </p>
+    );
+  }
+  // Read once per open: this form is the only place that writes settings. Another section that
+  // changes them (the backup import) is a different tab, so this one opens again afterwards.
+  return <SettingsForm settings={loaded.settings} />;
+}
+
+function SettingsForm({ settings }: { settings: Settings }) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const { db, notify } = useData();
+  const [values, setValues] = useState<SettingsFormValues>(() => settingsToValues(settings));
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<SettingsErrors>({});
+  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'saved' | 'failed'>('idle');
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+
+  function change(patch: Partial<SettingsFormValues>) {
+    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }));
+    setErrors({});
+    setStatus('idle');
+  }
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const result = buildSettings(values);
+    if (!result.ok) {
+      setErrors(result.errors);
+      setStatus('idle');
+      return;
+    }
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      await saveSettings(db, result.settings);
+      setStatus('saved');
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setStatus('failed');
+    }
+    setSaving(false);
+  }
+
+  const zoneError = errors.timeZone ? t.settings.issues[errors.timeZone] : null;
+  const periodsError = errors.periods ? t.settings.issues[errors.periods] : null;
+
+  return (
+    <form className="panel" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label={t.settings.title}>
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.settings.zoneLegend}</legend>
+        <div className="choices">
+          {(['auto', 'custom'] as const).map((mode) => (
+            <label key={mode} className="choice">
+              <input
+                type="radio"
+                name="zone-mode"
+                checked={values.zoneMode === mode}
+                onChange={() => change({ zoneMode: mode })}
+              />
+              {t.settings.zoneModes[mode]}
+            </label>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+        {values.zoneMode === 'auto' ? (
+          <p className="field__hint">{t.settings.autoHint.replace('{zone}', deviceTimeZone())}</p>
+        ) : (
+          <>
+            <label htmlFor="settings-zone" className="field__label">
+              {t.settings.zoneLabel}
+            </label>
+            <input
+              id="settings-zone"
+              className="field__input"
+              type="text"
+              list="settings-zone-list"
+              value={values.timeZone}
+              autoComplete="off"
+              autoCapitalize="off"
+              spellCheck={false}
+              aria-invalid={Boolean(zoneError)}
+              aria-describedby={`settings-zone-hint${zoneError ? ' settings-zone-error' : ''}`}
+              onChange={(event) => change({ timeZone: event.target.value })}
+            />
+            <datalist id="settings-zone-list">
+              {knownTimeZones().map((zone) => (
+                <option key={zone} value={zone} />
+              ))}
+            </datalist>
+            <p id="settings-zone-hint" className="field__hint">
+              {t.settings.zoneHint}
+            </p>
+            {zoneError && (
+              <p id="settings-zone-error" role="alert" className="field__error">
+                {zoneError}
+              </p>
+            )}
+          </>
+        )}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.settings.periodsLegend}</legend>
+        <p className="field__hint">{t.settings.periodsHint}</p>
+        <div className="field-pair">
+          {HOUR_FIELDS.map((field) => {
+            const message = errors[field] ? t.settings.issues[errors[field]] : null;
+            return (
+              <div key={field} className="field">
+                <label htmlFor={`settings-${field}`} className="field__label">
+                  {t.settings[field]}
+                </label>
+                <input
+                  id={`settings-${field}`}
+                  className="field__input"
+                  type="text"
+                  inputMode="numeric"
+                  maxLength={2}
+                  value={values[field]}
+                  aria-invalid={Boolean(message || periodsError)}
+                  aria-describedby={message ? `settings-${field}-error` : undefined}
+                  onChange={(event) => change({ [field]: event.target.value })}
+                />
+                {message && (
+                  <p id={`settings-${field}-error`} role="alert" className="field__error">
+                    {message}
+                  </p>
+                )}
+              </div>
+            );
+          })}
+        </div>
+        {periodsError && (
+          <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+            {periodsError}
+          </p>
+        )}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      {status === 'failed' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.settings.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      {status === 'saved' && (
+        <p role="status" className="field__status">
+          {t.settings.saved}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button type="submit" className="button button--primary" disabled={saving}>
+          {t.settings.save}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </form>
+  );
+}

+import { useId, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
+import { effectiveScope, indexById, isActive, type Agenda, type Id, type Tag } from '../core';
+import { COLOR_PRESETS } from './colorPresets';
+import { ColorField } from './ColorField';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { flattenTagTree, possibleParents } from './tagValues';
+
+export interface TagFormValues {
+  name: string;
+  color: string;
+  parentId: Id | null;
+  /** Empty means global. */
+  agendaIds: Id[];
+}
+
+interface TagFormProps {
+  /** The tag being edited, or null for a new one. */
+  editing: Tag | null;
+  tags: readonly Tag[];
+  agendas: readonly Agenda[];
+  onSubmit: (values: TagFormValues) => Promise<void>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/** Name, color, parent and the agendas where one tag is valid. */
+export function TagForm({ editing, tags, agendas, onSubmit, onCancel }: TagFormProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const uid = useId();
+  const [name, setName] = useState(editing?.name ?? '');
+  const [color, setColor] = useState(editing?.color ?? COLOR_PRESETS[0].hex);
+  const [parentId, setParentId] = useState<Id | null>(editing?.parentId ?? null);
+  const [agendaIds, setAgendaIds] = useState<Id[]>(editing?.agendaIds ?? []);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<'nameRequired' | 'saveFailed' | null>(null);
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+
+  const active = tags.filter(isActive);
+  const parentRows = flattenTagTree(possibleParents(editing, active), locale);
+  const parentScope = parentId === null ? null : effectiveScope(parentId, indexById(active));
+  const nameErrorId = `${uid}-name-error`;
+
+  function toggle(id: Id, checked: boolean) {
+    setAgendaIds((current) =>
+      checked ? [...current, id] : current.filter((existing) => existing !== id),
+    );
+  }
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const trimmed = name.trim();
+    if (trimmed === '') {
+      setError('nameRequired');
+      return;
+    }
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      // Keep the order of the agenda list, so the same choice always saves the same way
+      const ordered = agendas.map((agenda) => agenda.id).filter((id) => agendaIds.includes(id));
+      await onSubmit({ name: trimmed, color, parentId, agendaIds: ordered });
+    } catch {
+      setError('saveFailed');
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const title = editing ? t.tags.form.editTitle : t.tags.form.createTitle;
+
+  return (
+    <form className="panel" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label={title}>
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{title}</h3>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor={`${uid}-name`} className="field__label">
+          {t.tags.form.name}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id={`${uid}-name`}
+          className="field__input"
+          type="text"
+          value={name}
+          maxLength={80}
+          autoFocus
+          aria-invalid={error === 'nameRequired'}
+          aria-describedby={error === 'nameRequired' ? nameErrorId : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => {
+            setName(event.target.value);
+            if (error === 'nameRequired') setError(null);
+          }}
+        />
+        {error === 'nameRequired' && (
+          <p id={nameErrorId} role="alert" className="field__error">
+            {t.tags.form.nameRequired}
+          </p>
+        )}
+      </div>
+
+      <ColorField
+        idPrefix={uid}
+        label={t.tags.form.color}
+        customLabel={t.tags.form.customColor}
+        value={color}
+        onChange={setColor}
+      />
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor={`${uid}-parent`} className="field__label">
+          {t.tags.form.parent}
+        </label>
+        <select
+          id={`${uid}-parent`}
+          className="field__input"
+          value={parentId ?? ''}
+          onChange={(event) => setParentId(event.target.value === '' ? null : event.target.value)}
+        >
+          <option value="">{t.tags.form.noParent}</option>
+          {parentRows.map(({ tag, depth }) => (
+            <option key={tag.id} value={tag.id}>
+              {'  '.repeat(depth) + tag.name}
+            </option>
+          ))}
+        </select>
+      </div>
+
+      {agendas.length > 0 && (
+        <fieldset className="field field--group">
+          <legend className="field__label">{t.tags.form.scope}</legend>
+          <p className="field__hint">
+            {parentScope === null ? t.tags.form.scopeHint : t.tags.form.scopeParentHint}
+          </p>
+          {agendas.map((agenda) => {
+            const outside = parentScope !== null && !parentScope.includes(agenda.id);
+            return (
+              <label key={agenda.id} className="check">
+                <input
+                  type="checkbox"
+                  checked={agendaIds.includes(agenda.id)}
+                  disabled={outside}
+                  onChange={(event) => toggle(agenda.id, event.target.checked)}
+                />
+                <span>{agenda.name}</span>
+              </label>
+            );
+          })}
+        </fieldset>
+      )}
+
+      {error === 'saveFailed' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.tags.form.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button type="submit" className="button button--primary" disabled={saving}>
+          {t.tags.form.save}
+        </button>
+        <button type="button" className="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={saving}>
+          {t.tags.form.cancel}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </form>
+  );
+}

+import { useMemo } from 'react';
+import {
+  indexById,
+  inheritedTags,
+  isActive,
+  isTagValidInAgenda,
+  type Id,
+  type Item,
+  type Tag,
+} from '../core';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { flattenTagTree } from './tagValues';
+
+/** What the item forms need to offer tags: all the tags, the agenda's items and the item itself. */
+export interface TagContext {
+  /** Every active tag. The field keeps the ones valid in the item's agenda. */
+  tags: readonly Tag[];
+  /** The active items of the same agenda, where the parents are found. */
+  items: readonly Item[];
+  /** The item being edited, or a blank draft that already has its agenda and parent. */
+  base: Item;
+}
+
+interface TagsFieldProps {
+  idPrefix: string;
+  context: TagContext;
+  tagIds: Id[];
+  inheritTags: boolean;
+  onChange: (changes: { tagIds?: Id[]; inheritTags?: boolean }) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The tags of one item. A checkbox per tag that is valid in the item's agenda (plus any tag the
+ * item already carries that stopped being valid, so it can be taken off). For an item inside
+ * another, a switch decides whether it also counts as having its parent's tags, and the inherited
+ * ones are listed dimmed with where they come from, so nobody wonders why the item shows up.
+ */
+export function TagsField({ idPrefix, context, tagIds, inheritTags, onChange }: TagsFieldProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { tags, items, base } = context;
+
+  const byItem = useMemo(() => indexById(items.filter(isActive)), [items]);
+  const byTag = useMemo(() => indexById(tags.filter(isActive)), [tags]);
+  const parent = base.parentId === null ? undefined : byItem.get(base.parentId);
+
+  const rows = useMemo(() => {
+    const options = [...byTag.values()].filter(
+      (tag) => tagIds.includes(tag.id) || isTagValidInAgenda(tag.id, base.agendaId, byTag),
+    );
+    return flattenTagTree(options, locale);
+  }, [byTag, tagIds, base.agendaId, locale]);
+
+  const inherited = inheritedTags({ ...base, tagIds, inheritTags }, byItem).flatMap((entry) => {
+    const tag = byTag.get(entry.tagId);
+    const from = byItem.get(entry.fromItemId);
+    return tag && from ? [{ tag, from }] : [];
+  });
+
+  function toggle(id: Id, checked: boolean) {
+    onChange({ tagIds: checked ? [...tagIds, id] : tagIds.filter((existing) => existing !== id) });
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.items.tagsField.legend}</legend>
+        {rows.length === 0 && <p className="field__hint">{t.items.tagsField.none}</p>}
+        {rows.map(({ tag, depth }) => (
+          <label
+            key={tag.id}
+            className="check"
+            style={{ paddingInlineStart: `calc(${depth} * var(--space-4))` }}
+          >
+            <input
+              type="checkbox"
+              checked={tagIds.includes(tag.id)}
+              onChange={(event) => toggle(tag.id, event.target.checked)}
+            />
+            <span className="chip__dot" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: tag.color }} />
+            <span>
+              {tag.name}
+              {!isTagValidInAgenda(tag.id, base.agendaId, byTag) && (
+                <span className="field__hint"> {t.items.tagsField.outsideScope}</span>
+              )}
+            </span>
+          </label>
+        ))}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      {parent && (
+        <div className="field">
+          <label className="check" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-inherit`}>
+            <input
+              id={`${idPrefix}-inherit`}
+              type="checkbox"
+              role="switch"
+              checked={inheritTags}
+              aria-describedby={`${idPrefix}-inherit-hint`}
+              onChange={(event) => onChange({ inheritTags: event.target.checked })}
+            />
+            <span>{t.items.tagsField.inherit.replace('{name}', parent.title)}</span>
+          </label>
+          <p id={`${idPrefix}-inherit-hint`} className="field__hint">
+            {t.items.tagsField.inheritHint}
+          </p>
+          {inheritTags && (
+            <ul className="chips" aria-label={t.items.tagsField.inheritedList}>
+              {inherited.length === 0 && (
+                <li className="field__hint">{t.items.tagsField.nothingToInherit}</li>
+              )}
+              {inherited.map(({ tag, from }) => (
+                <li key={tag.id} className="chip chip--inherited">
+                  <span
+                    className="chip__dot"
+                    aria-hidden="true"
+                    style={{ background: tag.color }}
+                  />
+                  {t.items.tagChip.inherited
+                    .replace('{tag}', tag.name)
+                    .replace('{item}', from.title)}
+                </li>
+              ))}
+            </ul>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      )}
+    </>
+  );
+}

+import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+import {
+  createTag,
+  effectiveScope,
+  indexById,
+  normalizeTagScopes,
+  shouldOfferGlobal,
+  type Tag,
+} from '../core';
+import { countTagUsage, removeTagCascade, type TagUsage } from '../storage';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { useAgendas, useTags } from './data/useEntityList';
+import { formatCount } from './format';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { TagForm, type TagFormValues } from './TagForm';
+import { flattenTagTree } from './tagValues';
+
+type Mode =
+  | { kind: 'idle' }
+  | { kind: 'create' }
+  | { kind: 'edit'; tag: Tag }
+  | { kind: 'delete'; tag: Tag; usage: TagUsage; failed: boolean };
+
+/** The tag tree: create, edit, move, restrict to agendas and delete. */
+export function TagsSection() {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { db, repos, notify } = useData();
+  const tags = useTags();
+  const agendas = useAgendas();
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
+  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [actionFailed, setActionFailed] = useState(false);
+
+  const sortedAgendas = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      [...agendas.data].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale)),
+    [agendas.data, locale],
+  );
+  const rows = useMemo(() => flattenTagTree(tags.data, locale), [tags.data, locale]);
+  const byId = useMemo(() => indexById(tags.data), [tags.data]);
+  const agendaName = useMemo(
+    () => new Map(agendas.data.map((agenda) => [agenda.id, agenda.name])),
+    [agendas.data],
+  );
+  const allAgendaIds = agendas.data.map((agenda) => agenda.id);
+
+  async function save(values: TagFormValues) {
+    let savedId: string;
+    if (mode.kind === 'edit') {
+      await repos.tags.update(mode.tag.id, values);
+      savedId = mode.tag.id;
+    } else {
+      const tag = createTag(values);
+      await repos.tags.put(tag);
+      savedId = tag.id;
+    }
+
+    // A child can never be wider than its parent, so fix whatever this save broke
+    const { changed, changes } = normalizeTagScopes(await repos.tags.list());
+    if (changed.length > 0) await repos.tags.putMany(changed);
+    const names = changes.map((change) =>
+      change.tagId === savedId ? values.name : (byId.get(change.tagId)?.name ?? ''),
+    );
+    setNotice(
+      changes.length > 0
+        ? t.tags.scopeAdjusted.replace('{names}', names.filter(Boolean).join(', '))
+        : null,
+    );
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function makeGlobal(tag: Tag) {
+    setActionFailed(false);
+    try {
+      await repos.tags.update(tag.id, { agendaIds: [] });
+      setNotice(null);
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setActionFailed(true);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function askToDelete(tag: Tag) {
+    setNotice(null);
+    try {
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', tag, usage: await countTagUsage(db, tag.id), failed: false });
+    } catch {
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', tag, usage: { subTags: 0, items: 0 }, failed: true });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function confirmDelete(tag: Tag) {
+    setDeleting(true);
+    try {
+      await removeTagCascade(db, tag.id);
+      notify();
+      setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    } catch {
+      setMode((current) => (current.kind === 'delete' ? { ...current, failed: true } : current));
+    } finally {
+      setDeleting(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function scopeText(tag: Tag): string {
+    const scope = effectiveScope(tag.id, byId);
+    if (scope === null) return t.tags.scopeAll;
+    const names = scope.map((id) => agendaName.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
+    return t.tags.scopeSome.replace('{agendas}', names.join(', '));
+  }
+
+  const formProps = {
+    tags: tags.data,
+    agendas: sortedAgendas,
+    onSubmit: save,
+    onCancel: () => setMode({ kind: 'idle' }),
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <div>
+      {tags.failed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.tags.loadFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      {actionFailed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {t.tags.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="button button--primary"
+          onClick={() => {
+            setNotice(null);
+            setMode({ kind: 'create' });
+          }}
+        >
+          {t.tags.add}
+        </button>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && <TagForm editing={null} {...formProps} />}
+      {mode.kind === 'edit' && <TagForm key={mode.tag.id} editing={mode.tag} {...formProps} />}
+
+      {notice !== null && (
+        <p role="status" className="manage__notice">
+          {notice}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'delete' && (
+        <div role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="tag-delete-text" className="panel panel--danger">
+          <p id="tag-delete-text" className="panel__text">
+            {formatCount(locale, mode.usage.items, t.tags.confirm).replace('{name}', mode.tag.name)}
+            {mode.usage.subTags > 0 &&
+              ` ${formatCount(locale, mode.usage.subTags, t.tags.confirmChildren)}`}
+          </p>
+          {mode.failed && (
+            <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+              {t.tags.deleteFailed}
+            </p>
+          )}
+          <div className="actions">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button button--danger"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => confirmDelete(mode.tag)}
+            >
+              {t.tags.confirmAction}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              disabled={deleting}
+              onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+            >
+              {t.tags.form.cancel}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {!tags.loading && rows.length === 0 && mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <p className="placeholder">{t.tags.empty}</p>
+      )}
+
+      {rows.length > 0 && (
+        <ul className="list">
+          {rows.map(({ tag, depth }) => (
+            <li
+              key={tag.id}
+              className="list__row tree-row"
+              style={{ '--depth': depth } as React.CSSProperties}
+            >
+              <span className="list__swatch" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: tag.color }} />
+              <span className="list__main">
+                <span className="list__name">{tag.name}</span>
+                <span className="list__meta">{scopeText(tag)}</span>
+              </span>
+              {shouldOfferGlobal(tag, tags.data, allAgendaIds) && (
+                <button
+                  type="button"
+                  className="button"
+                  aria-label={t.tags.makeGlobal.replace('{name}', tag.name)}
+                  onClick={() => makeGlobal(tag)}
+                >
+                  {t.tags.short.makeGlobal}
+                </button>
+              )}
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                aria-label={t.tags.edit.replace('{name}', tag.name)}
+                onClick={() => {
+                  setNotice(null);
+                  setMode({ kind: 'edit', tag });
+                }}
+              >
+                {t.tags.short.edit}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                aria-label={t.tags.remove.replace('{name}', tag.name)}
+                onClick={() => askToDelete(tag)}
+              >
+                {t.tags.short.remove}
+              </button>
+            </li>
+          ))}
+        </ul>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );

+import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
+import type { Status, StatusGroup } from '../core';
+import { knownTimeZones } from './eventValues';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { LinksField } from './LinksField';
+import { TagsField, type TagContext } from './TagsField';
+import {
+  emptyTaskValues,
+  type DueMode,
+  type TaskFieldErrors,
+  type TaskFieldKey,
+  type TaskFormValues,
+} from './taskValues';
+
+const DUE_MODES: DueMode[] = ['none', 'allDay', 'timed'];
+
+/** The statuses to choose from, in their groups, in the order of the Kanban board. */
+export interface StatusChoice {
+  group: StatusGroup;
+  statuses: Status[];
+}
+
+interface TaskFormProps {
+  /** Empty for a new task, filled when editing. */
+  initial?: TaskFormValues;
+  /** The status chosen for a new task. */
+  defaultStatusId: string;
+  statusChoices: StatusChoice[];
+  /** The zone dates are shown in, used to explain what an empty time zone means. */
+  displayTimeZone: string;
+  /** Where the tags and the inheritance switch come from. Without it the form has no tags. */
+  tagContext?: TagContext;
+  /** Returns the problems to show, or null when the task was saved. */
+  onSubmit: (values: TaskFormValues) => Promise<TaskFieldErrors | null>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/** Create or edit one task: title, status, the window (start day and delivery), place and notes. */
+export function TaskForm({
+  initial,
+  defaultStatusId,
+  statusChoices,
+  displayTimeZone,
+  tagContext,
+  onSubmit,
+  onCancel,
+}: TaskFormProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const [values, setValues] = useState<TaskFormValues>(initial ?? emptyTaskValues(defaultStatusId));
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<TaskFieldErrors>({});
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+  // A new task starts on the default status, even when the statuses finish loading after the
+  // form opened. Once the person chooses (or clears) the status, their choice is kept.
+  const [statusTouched, setStatusTouched] = useState(false);
+  const statusId = initial || statusTouched ? values.statusId : defaultStatusId;
+  const zones = useMemo(() => knownTimeZones(), []);
+
+  const title = initial ? t.items.taskForm.editTitle : t.items.taskForm.createTitle;
+
+  function change(changes: Partial<TaskFormValues>, clear: TaskFieldKey[] = []) {
+    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, ...changes }));
+    if (clear.length > 0) {
+      setErrors((current) => {
+        const next = { ...current };
+        for (const key of clear) delete next[key];
+        return next;
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      const problems = await onSubmit({ ...values, statusId });
+      if (problems) {
+        setErrors(problems);
+        setSaving(false);
+      }
+    } catch {
+      setErrors({ form: 'saveFailed' });
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function message(key: TaskFieldKey): string | null {
+    const issue = errors[key];
+    return issue ? t.items.issues[issue] : null;
+  }
+
+  function fieldError(key: TaskFieldKey, id: string) {
+    const text = message(key);
+    return text ? (
+      <p id={id} role="alert" className="field__error">
+        {text}
+      </p>
+    ) : null;
+  }
+
+  const hasDue = values.dueMode !== 'none';
+  const timed = values.dueMode === 'timed';
+
+  return (
+    <form className="panel" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label={title}>
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{title}</h3>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="task-title" className="field__label">
+          {t.items.form.title}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="task-title"
+          className="field__input"
+          type="text"
+          value={values.title}
+          maxLength={200}
+          autoFocus
+          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.title)}
+          aria-describedby={errors.title ? 'task-title-error' : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => change({ title: event.target.value }, ['title'])}
+        />
+        {fieldError('title', 'task-title-error')}
+      </div>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="task-status" className="field__label">
+          {t.items.taskForm.status}
+        </label>
+        <select
+          id="task-status"
+          className="field__input"
+          value={statusId}
+          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.status)}
+          aria-describedby={errors.status ? 'task-status-error' : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => {
+            setStatusTouched(true);
+            change({ statusId: event.target.value }, ['status']);
+          }}
+        >
+          <option value="">{t.items.taskForm.chooseStatus}</option>
+          {statusChoices.map((choice) => (
+            <optgroup key={choice.group.id} label={choice.group.name}>
+              {choice.statuses.map((status) => (
+                <option key={status.id} value={status.id}>
+                  {status.name}
+                </option>
+              ))}
+            </optgroup>
+          ))}
+        </select>
+        {fieldError('status', 'task-status-error')}
+      </div>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{t.items.taskForm.dueLegend}</legend>
+        <div className="choices">
+          {DUE_MODES.map((mode) => (
+            <label key={mode} className="choice">
+              <input
+                type="radio"
+                name="task-due-mode"
+                value={mode}
+                checked={values.dueMode === mode}
+                onChange={() => change({ dueMode: mode }, ['due', 'from', 'timeZone'])}
+              />
+              {t.items.taskForm.dueModes[mode]}
+            </label>
+          ))}
+        </div>
+      </fieldset>
+
+      {hasDue && (
+        <>
+          <div className="field-pair">
+            <div className="field">
+              <label htmlFor="task-due-date" className="field__label">
+                {t.items.taskForm.dueDate}
+              </label>
+              <input
+                id="task-due-date"
+                className="field__input"
+                type="date"
+                value={values.dueDate}
+                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.due)}
+                aria-describedby={errors.due ? 'task-due-error' : undefined}
+                onChange={(event) => change({ dueDate: event.target.value }, ['due', 'from'])}
+              />
+            </div>
+            {timed && (
+              <div className="field">
+                <label htmlFor="task-due-time" className="field__label">
+                  {t.items.taskForm.dueTime}
+                </label>
+                <input
+                  id="task-due-time"
+                  className="field__input"
+                  type="time"
+                  value={values.dueTime}
+                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.due)}
+                  aria-describedby={errors.due ? 'task-due-error' : undefined}
+                  onChange={(event) => change({ dueTime: event.target.value }, ['due', 'from'])}
+                />
+              </div>
+            )}
+          </div>
+          {fieldError('due', 'task-due-error')}
+        </>
+      )}
+
+      {timed && (
+        <div className="field">
+          <label htmlFor="task-zone" className="field__label">
+            {t.items.form.timeZone}
+          </label>
+          <input
+            id="task-zone"
+            className="field__input"
+            type="text"
+            list="task-zone-list"
+            value={values.timeZone}
+            autoCapitalize="off"
+            autoComplete="off"
+            spellCheck={false}
+            aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.timeZone)}
+            aria-describedby={`task-zone-hint${errors.timeZone ? ' task-zone-error' : ''}`}
+            onChange={(event) => change({ timeZone: event.target.value }, ['timeZone'])}
+          />
+          <datalist id="task-zone-list">

+          </datalist>
+          <p id="task-zone-hint" className="field__hint">

+import { THEME_MODES, type ThemeMode } from './theme';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+type Props = {
+  mode: ThemeMode;
+  onChange: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
+};
+
+export function ThemeToggle({ mode, onChange }: Props) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+
+  return (
+    <div className="segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label={t.theme.label}>
+      {THEME_MODES.map((option) => (

+          key={option}
+          type="button"
+          role="radio"
+          aria-checked={mode === option}
+          className="segmented__option"
+          onClick={() => onChange(option)}
+        >
+          {t.theme[option]}
+        </button>
+      ))}
+    </div>
+  );

diff --git a/src/ui/TimelineDayBlock.tsx b/src/ui/TimelineDayBlock.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8ef6919
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ui/TimelineDayBlock.tsx

+import { Fragment } from 'react';
+import type {
+  Agenda,
+  AgendaGroup,
+  Id,
+  Item,
+  OpenTask,
+  OverdueEntry,
+  TimelineDay,
+  TimelineEntry,
+} from '../core';
+import { arrangeDayWithOverdue, type CombinedSection, type LayoutPlan } from '../filters';
+import { formatCount, formatDate, formatDayHeading, formatTime } from './format';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { entryTimeText, openTaskDueText } from './timelineValues';
+
+/** What every day block needs. Built once by the view and shared by all the days. */
+export interface TimelineShared {
+  agendas: ReadonlyMap<Id, Agenda>;
+  groups: ReadonlyMap<Id, AgendaGroup>;
+  itemsById: ReadonlyMap<Id, Item>;
+  statusNames: ReadonlyMap<Id, string>;
+  zone: string;
+  /** Marks a task as done. Absent when there is no done status, so no button is drawn. */
+  onDone?: (item: Item) => void;
+}
+
+interface TimelineDayBlockProps {
+  day: TimelineDay;
+  /** 0 for today, 1 for tomorrow, anything else shows no badge. */
+  offset: number;
+  /** The overdue strip. Only today's block receives it. */
+  overdue?: OverdueEntry[];
+  /** How the day is dealt into sections (one list, one per agenda or one per group). */
+  plan: LayoutPlan;
+  shared: TimelineShared;
+}
+
+/** The agenda of an item: a small color dot and the name. The color is the user's own data. */
+function AgendaLabel({ item, shared }: { item: Item; shared: TimelineShared }) {
+  const agenda = shared.agendas.get(item.agendaId);
+  if (!agenda) return null;
+  return (
+    <span className="entry__agenda">
+      <span
+        className="entry__swatch"
+        style={{ backgroundColor: agenda.color }}
+        aria-hidden="true"
+      />
+      {agenda.name}
+    </span>
+  );
+}
+
+function Row({
+  time,
+  title,
+  meta,
+  marks = [],
+  emphasis = false,
+  danger = false,
+  action,
+}: {
+  time: string;
+  title: string;
+  meta: React.ReactNode;
+  marks?: string[];
+  emphasis?: boolean;
+  danger?: boolean;
+  action?: React.ReactNode;
+}) {
+  const classes = ['entry'];
+  if (emphasis) classes.push('entry--emphasis');
+  if (danger) classes.push('entry--danger');
+  return (
+    <li className={classes.join(' ')}>
+      <span className="entry__time">{time}</span>
+      <div className="entry__main">
+        <span className="entry__title">{title}</span>
+        <span className="entry__meta">{meta}</span>
+        {marks.map((mark) => (
+          <span key={mark} className="entry__mark">
+            {mark}
+          </span>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+      {action}
+    </li>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * One page of the paper planner: the heading, the strip of overdue tasks (today only), the strip
+ * of open tasks, then the whole-day items and the timed items in time order.
+ */
+export function TimelineDayBlock({
+  day,
+  offset,
+  overdue = [],
+  plan,
+  shared,
+}: TimelineDayBlockProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const headingId = `timeline-day-${day.date}`;
+
+  /** What goes under the title: where it is inside, its place and its agenda. */
+  function entryMeta(entry: TimelineEntry) {
+    const parent = entry.item.parentId ? shared.itemsById.get(entry.item.parentId) : undefined;
+    const parts: string[] = [];
+    if (parent) parts.push(t.items.insideOf.replace('{name}', parent.title));
+    if (entry.item.location) parts.push(entry.item.location);
+    return (
+      <>
+        <AgendaLabel item={entry.item} shared={shared} />
+        {parts.length > 0 && <span>{parts.join(' · ')}</span>}
+      </>
+    );
+  }
+
+  function entryMarks(entry: TimelineEntry): string[] {
+    const marks: string[] = [];
+    if (entry.continuesFromPrevious) marks.push(t.timeline.continuesFrom);
+    if (entry.continuesToNext) marks.push(t.timeline.continuesTo);
+    return marks;
+  }
+
+  function openMeta(open: OpenTask) {
+    const status =
+      open.item.statusId !== null
+        ? (shared.statusNames.get(open.item.statusId) ?? t.items.noStatus)
+        : t.items.noStatus;
+    return (
+      <>
+        <AgendaLabel item={open.item} shared={shared} />
+        <span>{status}</span>
+      </>
+    );
+  }
+
+  /** The left text of an overdue row: the delivery day, or the hour when it was due today. */
+  function overdueTimeText(entry: OverdueEntry): string {
+    const due = entry.item.due;
+    if (entry.daysLate === 0 && due && !due.allDay) {
+      return t.timeline.dueAt.replace('{time}', formatTime(locale, due.at, shared.zone));
+    }
+    return t.timeline.dueOn.replace('{date}', formatDate(locale, entry.dueDate));
+  }
+
+  /** The "Done" button of a task row (open and overdue strips). Events have none. */
+  function doneButton(item: Item) {
+    if (!shared.onDone) return undefined;
+    const onDone = shared.onDone;
+    return (
+      <button
+        type="button"
+        className="button entry__action"
+        aria-label={t.timeline.markDoneNamed.replace('{name}', item.title)}
+        onClick={() => onDone(item)}
+      >
+        {t.timeline.markDone}
+      </button>
+    );
+  }
+
+  /** The title of a section: the agenda (with its dot), the group, or "No group". */
+  function sectionTitle(section: CombinedSection) {
+    const { kind, agendaId, groupId } = section.info;
+    if (kind === 'agenda') {
+      const agenda = agendaId ? shared.agendas.get(agendaId) : undefined;
+      return (
+        <>
+          {agenda && (
+            <span
+              className="entry__swatch"
+              style={{ backgroundColor: agenda.color }}
+              aria-hidden="true"
+            />
+          )}
+          {agenda?.name ?? t.timeline.ungrouped}
+        </>
+      );
+    }
+    if (kind === 'group') return shared.groups.get(groupId ?? '')?.name ?? t.timeline.ungrouped;
+    return t.timeline.ungrouped;
+  }
+
+  /** The strips and lists of one section. `Strip` is the heading level under the section title. */
+  function sectionBody(section: CombinedSection, Strip: 'h3' | 'h4') {
+    const part = section.day;
+    // A task already in the overdue strip is not listed again as open in today's block
+    const overdueIds = new Set(section.overdue.map((entry) => entry.item.id));
+    const openTasks = part.open.filter((open) => !overdueIds.has(open.item.id));
+    return (
+      <>
+        {section.overdue.length > 0 && (
+          <div className="strip strip--overdue">
+            <Strip className="strip__title">{t.timeline.overdue}</Strip>
+            <ul className="entries">
+              {section.overdue.map((entry) => (
+                <Row
+                  key={entry.item.id}
+                  danger
+                  time={overdueTimeText(entry)}
+                  title={entry.item.title}
+                  meta={
+                    <>
+                      <AgendaLabel item={entry.item} shared={shared} />
+                      <span>
+                        {entry.daysLate === 0
+                          ? t.timeline.lateToday
+                          : formatCount(locale, entry.daysLate, t.timeline.lateDays)}
+                      </span>
+                    </>
+                  }
+                  action={doneButton(entry.item)}
+                />
+              ))}
+            </ul>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {openTasks.length > 0 && (
+          <div className="strip">
+            <Strip className="strip__title">{t.timeline.open}</Strip>
+            <ul className="entries">
+              {openTasks.map((open) => (
+                <Row
+                  key={open.item.id}
+                  emphasis={open.isDueDay}
+                  time={openTaskDueText(locale, open, shared.zone, t.timeline)}
+                  title={open.item.title}
+                  meta={openMeta(open)}
+                  action={doneButton(open.item)}
+                />
+              ))}
+            </ul>
+          </div>
+        )}
+
+        {(part.allDay.length > 0 || part.timed.length > 0) && (
+          <ul className="entries">
+            {part.allDay.map((entry) => (
+              <Row
+                key={entry.item.id}
+                time={entryTimeText(locale, entry, shared.zone, t.timeline, t.items.range)}
+                title={entry.item.title}
+                meta={entryMeta(entry)}
+                marks={entryMarks(entry)}
+              />
+            ))}
+            {part.timed.map((entry) => (
+              <Row
+                key={entry.item.id}
+                time={entryTimeText(locale, entry, shared.zone, t.timeline, t.items.range)}
+                title={entry.item.title}
+                meta={entryMeta(entry)}
+                marks={entryMarks(entry)}
+              />
+            ))}
+          </ul>
+        )}
+      </>
+    );
+  }
+
+  const sections = arrangeDayWithOverdue(day, overdue, plan);
+  const sectioned = plan.layout !== 'mixed';
+
+  const badge = offset === 0 ? t.timeline.today : offset === 1 ? t.timeline.tomorrow : null;
+
+  return (
+    <section
+      className={offset === 0 ? 'day day--today' : 'day'}
+      id={`timeline-block-${day.date}`}
+      aria-labelledby={headingId}
+    >
+      <header className="day__header">
+        <h2 id={headingId} className="day__heading">
+          {formatDayHeading(locale, day.date)}
+        </h2>
+        {badge && <span className="day__badge">{badge}</span>}
+      </header>
+
+      {sections.map((section) => {
+        if (!sectioned) {
+          return <Fragment key={section.info.key}>{sectionBody(section, 'h3')}</Fragment>;
+        }
+        const titleId = `timeline-section-${day.date}-${section.info.key}`;
+        return (
+          <div
+            key={section.info.key}
+            className="day__section"
+            role="group"
+            aria-labelledby={titleId}
+          >
+            <h3 id={titleId} className="day__section-title">
+              {sectionTitle(section)}
+            </h3>
+            {sectionBody(section, 'h4')}
+          </div>
+        );
+      })}
+
+      {sections.length === 0 && <p className="day__empty">{t.timeline.nothing}</p>}
+    </section>
+  );
+}

+import { useMemo, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import type { Agenda, AgendaGroup, Id, ItemKind, SavedView, Tag } from '../core';
+import {
+  AGENDA_LAYOUTS,
+  groupState,

+  toggleAgenda,
+  toggleGroup,
+  visibleAgendaIds,
+  type AgendaLayout,
+  type AgendaSelection,
+  type ItemFilter,
+  type PeriodFilter,
+} from '../filters';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';

+interface TimelineFiltersProps {

+  agendas: readonly Agenda[];
+  groups: readonly AgendaGroup[];
+  /** Which agendas are shown. */
+  selection: AgendaSelection;
+  /** How each day is arranged. It hides nothing, so it never counts as a filter. */
+  layout: AgendaLayout;
+  /** The saved views, and the one the controls came from (null for none). */
+  savedViews: readonly SavedView[];
+  activeViewId: Id | null;
+  /** Names of the tags that were just taken out of the filter because their agenda was hidden. */
+  droppedTagNames: readonly string[];
+  /** How many sieves are on, the agenda selection included. Zero turns "Clear filters" off. */
+  activeCount: number;
+  onChange: (next: ItemFilter) => void;
+  onSelectionChange: (next: AgendaSelection) => void;
+  onLayoutChange: (next: AgendaLayout) => void;
+  /** Sets every control to the view and makes it the active one. */
+  onApplyView: (view: SavedView) => void;
+  /** Changes which view is active without touching the controls. */
+  onActiveViewChange: (id: Id | null) => void;
+  /** Turns every sieve off, the agenda selection included. */
+  onClear: () => void;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}
+
+const KINDS: readonly ItemKind[] = ['event', 'task'];
+
+/**
+ * The filter panel of the Timeline. Analogy: the sieves from `src/filters` with a switch each. On
+ * a phone it is a sheet over the whole screen (with a Close button), on a wide screen a card
+ * under the bar. It only edits the `ItemFilter` it is given: the screen above applies it.
+ */
+export function TimelineFilters({
+  filter,
+  tags,
+  agendas,
+  groups,
+  selection,
+  layout,
+  savedViews,
+  activeViewId,
+  droppedTagNames,
+  activeCount,
+  onChange,
+  onSelectionChange,
+  onLayoutChange,
+  onApplyView,
+  onActiveViewChange,
+  onClear,
+  onClose,
+}: TimelineFiltersProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const text = t.timeline.filters;
+  // Only the tags that are valid in the shown agendas, the ones valid in just some marked
+  const offered = useMemo(
+    () => tagsForSelection(tags, selection, agendas),
+    [tags, selection, agendas],
+  );
+  const rows = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      flattenTagTree(
+        offered.map((entry) => entry.tag),
+        locale,
+      ),
+    [offered, locale],
+  );
+  const partialIds = useMemo(
+    () => new Set<Id>(offered.filter((entry) => entry.partial).map((entry) => entry.tag.id)),
+    [offered],
+  );
+  const shownAgendaIds = useMemo(
+    () => new Set(visibleAgendaIds(selection, agendas)),
+    [selection, agendas],
+  );
+  const orderedAgendas = useMemo(
+    () => [...agendas].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale)),
+    [agendas, locale],
+  );
+  const orderedGroups = useMemo(
+    () => [...groups].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale)),
+    [groups, locale],
+  );
+  // The number is kept as typed, so a half written value does not jump around
+  const [dueText, setDueText] = useState(() => String(filter.dueWithinDays ?? ''));
+
+  // The text is shown as typed while it still means the same limit as the filter. When the filter
+  // changes from outside ("Clear filters"), the field follows it instead of keeping old text.
+  const dueShown =
+    parseDueWithin(dueText) === filter.dueWithinDays ? dueText : String(filter.dueWithinDays ?? '');
+
+  const update = (patch: Partial<ItemFilter>) => onChange({ ...filter, ...patch });
+
+  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
+    if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose();
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div
+      id="timeline-filters"
+      className="timeline__filters"
+      role="group"
+      aria-label={text.panelLabel}
+      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+    >
+      <div className="timeline__filters-head">
+        <h2 className="timeline__filters-title">{text.toggle}</h2>
+        <div className="timeline__filters-actions">
+          <button type="button" className="button" disabled={activeCount === 0} onClick={onClear}>
+            {text.clear}
+          </button>
+          <button type="button" className="button button--primary" onClick={onClose}>
+            {text.close}
+          </button>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+
+      <TimelineViews
+        views={savedViews}
+        activeId={activeViewId}
+        controls={{ filter, selection, layout }}
+        agendas={agendas}
+        onApply={onApplyView}
+        onActiveChange={onActiveViewChange}
+      />
+
+      {orderedAgendas.length > 1 && (
+        <fieldset className="field field--group">
+          <legend className="field__label">{text.agendasLegend}</legend>
+          <p className="field__hint">{text.agendasHint}</p>
+          {orderedGroups.map((group) => {
+            const state = groupState(group, selection, agendas);
+            return (
+              <label key={group.id} className="check">
+                <input
+                  type="checkbox"
+                  checked={state === 'all'}
+                  ref={(input) => {
+                    if (input) input.indeterminate = state === 'some';
+                  }}
+                  aria-label={text.groupLabel.replace('{name}', group.name)}
+                  onChange={() => onSelectionChange(toggleGroup(selection, group, agendas))}
+                />
+                <span>
+                  <strong>{group.name}</strong>
+                </span>
+              </label>
+            );
+          })}
+          {orderedAgendas.map((agenda) => (
+            <label key={agenda.id} className="check">
+              <input
+                type="checkbox"
+                checked={shownAgendaIds.has(agenda.id)}
+                onChange={() => onSelectionChange(toggleAgenda(selection, agenda.id, agendas))}
+              />
+              <span className="chip__dot" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: agenda.color }} />
+              <span>{agenda.name}</span>
+            </label>
+          ))}
+          {droppedTagNames.length > 0 && (
+            <p role="status" className="field__hint">
+              {text.tagsDropped.replace('{names}', droppedTagNames.join(', '))}
+            </p>
+          )}
+        </fieldset>
+      )}
+
+      {orderedAgendas.length > 1 && (
+        <fieldset className="field field--group">
+          <legend className="field__label">{text.layoutLegend}</legend>
+          <p className="field__hint">{text.layoutHint}</p>
+          {AGENDA_LAYOUTS.map((option) => (
+            <label key={option} className="check">
+              <input
+                type="radio"
+                name="timeline-layout"
+                checked={layout === option}
+                onChange={() => onLayoutChange(option)}
+              />
+              <span>{text.layouts[option]}</span>
+            </label>
+          ))}
+        </fieldset>
+      )}
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label className="field__label" htmlFor="timeline-filter-text">
+          {text.textLabel}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="timeline-filter-text"
+          type="search"
+          className="field__input"
+          value={filter.text}
+          aria-describedby="timeline-filter-text-hint"
+          onChange={(event) => update({ text: event.target.value })}
+        />
+        <p id="timeline-filter-text-hint" className="field__hint">
+          {text.textHint}
+        </p>
+      </div>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group field--inline">
+        <legend className="field__label">{text.kindsLegend}</legend>
+        {KINDS.map((kind) => (
+          <label key={kind} className="check">
+            <input
+              type="checkbox"
+              checked={filter.kinds.includes(kind)}
+              onChange={(event) =>
+                update({ kinds: toggleValue(filter.kinds, kind, event.target.checked) })
+              }
+            />
+            <span>{t.items.kind[kind]}</span>
+          </label>
+        ))}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group field--inline">
+        <legend className="field__label">{text.periodsLegend}</legend>
+        <p className="field__hint">{text.periodsHint}</p>
+        {PERIOD_CHIPS.map((chip: PeriodFilter) => (
+          <label key={chip} className="check">
+            <input
+              type="checkbox"
+              checked={filter.periods.includes(chip)}
+              onChange={(event) =>
+                update({ periods: toggleValue(filter.periods, chip, event.target.checked) })
+              }
+            />
+            <span>{text.periods[chip]}</span>
+          </label>
+        ))}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      <fieldset className="field field--group">
+        <legend className="field__label">{text.tagsLegend}</legend>
+        {rows.length === 0 ? (
+          <p className="field__hint">{text.tagsNone}</p>
+        ) : (
+          <p className="field__hint">{text.tagsHint}</p>
+        )}
+        {rows.map(({ tag, depth }) => (
+          <label
+            key={tag.id}
+            className="check"
+            style={{ paddingInlineStart: `calc(${depth} * var(--space-4))` }}
+          >
+            <input
+              type="checkbox"
+              checked={filter.tagIds.includes(tag.id)}
+              onChange={(event) =>
+                update({ tagIds: toggleValue(filter.tagIds, tag.id, event.target.checked) })
+              }
+            />
+            <span className="chip__dot" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: tag.color }} />
+            <span>{tag.name}</span>
+            {partialIds.has(tag.id) && <span className="field__hint">({text.tagPartial})</span>}
+          </label>
+        ))}
+      </fieldset>
+
+      <div className="field">
+        <label className="field__label" htmlFor="timeline-filter-due">
+          {text.dueLabel}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="timeline-filter-due"
+          type="number"
+          inputMode="numeric"
+          min={0}
+          step={1}
+          className="field__input"
+          value={dueShown}
+          aria-describedby="timeline-filter-due-hint"
+          onChange={(event) => {
+            setDueText(event.target.value);
+            update({ dueWithinDays: parseDueWithin(event.target.value) });
+          }}
+        />
+        <p id="timeline-filter-due-hint" className="field__hint">
+          {text.dueHint}
+        </p>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+/** Days around today when the screen opens, and how many more each load adds on one side. */
+const DAYS_BEFORE = 7;
+const DAYS_AFTER = 20;
+const STEP = 14;
+/** How close to an end of the page (in pixels) the scroll has to get before more days load. */
+const EDGE = 600;
+/** The "back to top" button appears once the page is scrolled this many pixels. */
+const TOP_BUTTON_AFTER = 300;
+/**
+ * On opening, the page only scrolls to today when today starts lower than this (in pixels from
+ * the top of the page). Closer than that, scrolling would only hide the header and the folded
+ * earlier days to put today a few pixels higher, so the page stays at the top.
+ */
+const OPEN_SCROLL_MIN = 400;
+/** How long the "marked as done" message (with Undo) stays on screen, in milliseconds. */
+const UNDO_VISIBLE_MS = 8000;
+/** The date picker accepts only this span, so a typo can not ask for thousands of days. */
+const MIN_DATE = '1970-01-01';
+const MAX_DATE = '2100-12-31';
+
+interface TimelineScrollerProps {
+  items: Item[];
+  agendas: Agenda[];
+  /** The agenda groups, for the agenda selection. */
+  agendaGroups: AgendaGroup[];
+  statuses: Status[];
+  statusGroups: StatusGroup[];
+  /** Every active tag, for the tag filter. */
+  tags: Tag[];
+  /** The saved views, for the filter panel. */
+  savedViews: SavedView[];
+  /**
+   * The filters, the agenda selection, the layout and the active view. They belong to the shell
+   * above, so they are still there after a trip to another tab.
+   */
+  memory: TimelineMemory;
+  onMemoryChange: Dispatch<SetStateAction<TimelineMemory>>;
+  /** Where the day periods start, for the period filter. */
+  bounds: PeriodBounds;
+  zone: string;
+  /** The current instant, read once when the screen opened. */
+  nowMs: number;
+  today: PlainDate;
+}
+
+/** A piece of the list: a day with content (or today), or several empty days in a row. */
+type Segment = { kind: 'day'; day: TimelineDay } | { kind: 'run'; days: TimelineDay[] };
+
+/** Groups consecutive empty days (never today) into one folded run. */
+function toSegments(days: TimelineDay[], today: PlainDate): Segment[] {
+  const segments: Segment[] = [];
+  for (const day of days) {
+    const foldable = day.empty && day.date !== today;
+    const last = segments[segments.length - 1];
+    if (foldable && last?.kind === 'run') last.days.push(day);
+    else if (foldable) segments.push({ kind: 'run', days: [day] });
+    else segments.push({ kind: 'day', day });
+  }
+  return segments;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The scrolling Timeline. It starts a week before today and three weeks ahead, and adds 14 days
+ * on one side when the page scroll gets near that end (or when the person taps the button at the
+ * end). Empty days in a row fold into one line. No list virtualization: the page scrolls as a
+ * whole, blocks have different heights, and folding keeps the number of blocks small.
+ *
+ * Adding days above would push everything down and make the page jump. Analogy: adding pages to
+ * the front of a notebook while you are reading, so the screen keeps your page by adding the
+ * height that was inserted back to the scroll position.
+ */
+export function TimelineScroller({
+  items,
+  agendas,
+  agendaGroups,
+  statuses,
+  statusGroups,
+  tags,
+  savedViews,
+  memory,
+  onMemoryChange,
+  bounds,
+  zone,
+  nowMs,
+  today,
+}: TimelineScrollerProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const { repos, notify } = useData();
+  const [range, setRange] = useState(() => ({
+    from: addDays(today, -DAYS_BEFORE),
+    to: addDays(today, DAYS_AFTER),
+  }));
+  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<ReadonlySet<PlainDate>>(new Set());
+  // Page height and scroll position before days were added above, to keep the screen in place
+  const anchor = useRef<{ height: number; top: number } | null>(null);
+  // Set when this screen moved the scroll itself, so that move does not count as the person's
+  const ignoreScroll = useRef(false);
+  // The day to bring into view once it is on the page. Opens on today.
+  const pendingTarget = useRef<PlainDate | null>(today);
+  const opening = useRef(true);
+  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
+  // The last task marked as done, kept for a moment so a stray tap can be undone
+  const [justDone, setJustDone] = useState<{
+    id: Id;
+    title: string;
+    previousStatusId: Id | null;
+  } | null>(null);
+  const [saveFailed, setSaveFailed] = useState(false);
+  // The sieves, the shown agendas (null is all) and the layout (how each day is dealt into
+  // sections, which hides nothing, so it is not a filter and not counted) come from the shell
+  const { filter, selection, layout } = memory.controls;
+  // The tags the last change took out of the filter, shown once in the panel
+  const [droppedTagNames, setDroppedTagNames] = useState<string[]>([]);
+  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
+  const filtersButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+
+  const doneIds = useMemo(() => doneStatusIds(statuses, statusGroups), [statuses, statusGroups]);
+  const activeView = useMemo(
+    () => sortSavedViews(savedViews).find((view) => view.id === memory.viewId) ?? null,
+    [savedViews, memory.viewId],
+  );
+  const viewChanged = activeView !== null && !isViewCurrent(activeView, memory.controls, agendas);
+  const agendasOn = isAgendaSelectionActive(selection, agendas);
+  const filterOn = isFilterActive(filter) || agendasOn;
+  const filterCount = activeFilterCount(filter, agendasOn);
+  // Tag, type and text sieves cut the items first (the whole list is passed, so inherited tags
+  // find their parents). The period and "due within" sieves then cut each built day.
+  const shown = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      filterByAgendas(
+        isFilterActive(filter) ? filterItems(items, filter, tags) : items,
+        selection,
+        agendas,
+      ),
+    [items, filter, tags, selection, agendas],
+  );
+  const days = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      buildTimelineRange(shown, range.from, range.to, zone, doneIds).map((day) =>
+        applyDayFilters(day, filter, zone, bounds),
+      ),
+    [shown, range, zone, doneIds, filter, bounds],
+  );
+  const overdue = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      applyOverdueFilter(
+        buildOverdueStrip(shown, msToTimestamp(nowMs), today, zone, doneIds),
+        filter,
+      ),
+    [shown, nowMs, today, zone, doneIds, filter],
+  );
+  const plan = useMemo(
+    () => createLayoutPlan(layout, agendas, agendaGroups),
+    [layout, agendas, agendaGroups],
+  );
+  const nothingMatches = filterOn && overdue.length === 0 && days.every((day) => day.empty);
+  const segments = useMemo(() => toSegments(days, today), [days, today]);
+  const doneStatusId = useMemo(
+    () => defaultDoneStatusId(statuses, statusGroups),
+    [statuses, statusGroups],
+  );
+
+  /** Changes some of the controls. The active view stays, and shows as changed. */
+  function changeControls(patch: Partial<TimelineMemory['controls']>) {
+    onMemoryChange((current) => ({ ...current, controls: { ...current.controls, ...patch } }));
+  }
+
+  /** Changes the shown agendas and takes out of the tag filter the tags that no longer apply. */
+  function changeSelection(next: AgendaSelection) {
+    const result = dropUnavailableTags(filter, tags, next, agendas);
+    changeControls({ selection: next, filter: result.filter });
+    setDroppedTagNames(result.dropped.map((tag) => tag.name));
+  }
+
+  function clearFilters() {
+    changeControls({ filter: EMPTY_FILTER, selection: ALL_AGENDAS });
+    setDroppedTagNames([]);
+  }
+
+  /** Sets every control to the view's and makes it the active one. */
+  function applyView(view: SavedView) {
+    onMemoryChange({ controls: controlsFromView(view), viewId: view.id });
+    setDroppedTagNames([]);
+  }
+
+  /** Gives the task the done status. It leaves the strips on the next read, and Undo can bring it back. */
+  const markDone = useCallback(
+    async (item: Item) => {
+      if (doneStatusId === null) return;
+      setSaveFailed(false);
+      try {
+        await repos.items.update(item.id, { statusId: doneStatusId });
+        notify();
+        setJustDone({ id: item.id, title: item.title, previousStatusId: item.statusId });
+      } catch {
+        setSaveFailed(true);
+      }
+    },
+    [doneStatusId, repos, notify],
+  );
+
+  async function undoDone() {
+    if (!justDone) return;
+    setSaveFailed(false);
+    try {
+      await repos.items.update(justDone.id, { statusId: justDone.previousStatusId });
+      notify();
+      setJustDone(null);
+    } catch {
+      setSaveFailed(true);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // The message goes away by itself, and a newer "done" restarts the count
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!justDone) return;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => setJustDone(null), UNDO_VISIBLE_MS);
+    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
+  }, [justDone]);
+
+  const shared: TimelineShared = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      agendas: new Map(agendas.map((agenda) => [agenda.id, agenda])),
+      groups: new Map(agendaGroups.map((group) => [group.id, group])),
+      itemsById: new Map(items.map((item) => [item.id, item])),
+      statusNames: new Map(statuses.map((status) => [status.id, status.name])),
+      zone,
+      onDone: doneStatusId === null ? undefined : markDone,
+    }),
+    [agendas, agendaGroups, items, statuses, zone, doneStatusId, markDone],
+  );
+
+  const scrollToElement = useCallback((element: HTMLElement) => {
+    const before = window.scrollY;
+    element.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' });
+    if (window.scrollY !== before) ignoreScroll.current = true;
+  }, []);
+
+  /**
+   * Brings a day to the top of the screen. A day already on the page is scrolled to right away.
+   * Otherwise the day is asked for and reached after the next draw: a day inside the loaded range
+   * but folded is opened (its run opens, because the run is open when any of its days is), and a
+   * day outside the range replaces the range with the days around it. Replacing, not stretching,
+   * keeps a jump to a far date cheap.
+   */
+  const goTo = useCallback(
+    (date: PlainDate) => {
+      const element = document.getElementById(`timeline-block-${date}`);
+      if (element) {
+        scrollToElement(element);
+        return;
+      }
+      pendingTarget.current = date;
+      setExpanded((current) => (current.has(date) ? current : new Set(current).add(date)));
+      setRange((current) =>
+        comparePlainDates(date, current.from) >= 0 && comparePlainDates(date, current.to) <= 0
+          ? current
+          : { from: addDays(date, -DAYS_BEFORE), to: addDays(date, DAYS_AFTER) },
+      );
+    },
+    [scrollToElement],
+  );
+
+  // Brings the asked-for day into view (and opens on today the first time, when it is far down)
+  useLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const target = pendingTarget.current;
+    if (!target) return;
+    const element = document.getElementById(`timeline-block-${target}`);
+    if (!element) return;
+    pendingTarget.current = null;
+    // The first time (opening the screen), stay at the top when today is already near it
+    const isOpening = opening.current;
+    opening.current = false;
+    if (isOpening && element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY < OPEN_SCROLL_MIN) return;
+    scrollToElement(element);
+  }, [range, expanded, scrollToElement]);
+
+  function closeFilters() {
+    setFiltersOpen(false);
+    filtersButton.current?.focus();
+  }
+
+  function backToTop() {
+    const before = window.scrollY;
+    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
+    if (before !== 0) ignoreScroll.current = true;
+  }
+
+  function pickDate(value: string) {
+    // An unfinished or out of span date (typed by hand) is ignored
+    if (isPlainDate(value) && value >= MIN_DATE && value <= MAX_DATE) goTo(value);
+  }
+
+  const extend = useCallback((side: 'before' | 'after') => {
+    if (side === 'before') {
+      anchor.current = {
+        height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
+        top: window.scrollY,
+      };
+    }
+    setRange((current) =>
+      side === 'before'
+        ? { ...current, from: addDays(current.from, -STEP) }
+        : { ...current, to: addDays(current.to, STEP) },
+    );
+  }, []);
+
+  // After days were added above, put the page back where the person was
+  useLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const saved = anchor.current;
+    if (!saved) return;
+    anchor.current = null;
+    const added = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - saved.height;
+    if (added !== 0) {
+      ignoreScroll.current = true;
+      window.scrollTo(0, saved.top + added);
+    }
+  }, [range.from]);
+
+  // Near an end of the page: load more. Only a real scroll loads, so a short page (everything
+  // folded) does not keep loading by itself, and the two buttons cover that case.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    function onScroll() {
+      setScrolled(window.scrollY > TOP_BUTTON_AFTER);
+      if (ignoreScroll.current) {
+        ignoreScroll.current = false;
+        return;
+      }
+      const page = document.documentElement;
+      if (window.scrollY < EDGE) extend('before');
+      if (page.scrollHeight - window.scrollY - window.innerHeight < EDGE) extend('after');
+    }
+    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
+    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
+  }, [extend]);
+
+  function toggleRun(run: TimelineDay[], open: boolean) {
+    setExpanded((current) => {
+      const next = new Set(current);
+      for (const day of run) {
+        if (open) next.add(day.date);
+        else next.delete(day.date);
+      }
+      return next;
+    });
+  }
+
+  function runLabel(run: TimelineDay[]): string {
+    const first = formatDate(locale, run[0]!.date);
+    const last = formatDate(locale, run[run.length - 1]!.date);
+    return run.length === 1
+      ? first
+      : t.items.range.replace('{start}', first).replace('{end}', last);
+  }
+
+  function block(day: TimelineDay) {
+    const offset = daysBetween(today, day.date);
+    return (
+      <TimelineDayBlock
+        key={day.date}
+        day={day}
+        offset={offset}
+        overdue={offset === 0 ? overdue : undefined}
+        plan={plan}
+        shared={shared}
+      />
+    );
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <div className="timeline">
+      <div className="timeline__bar">
+        <input
+          type="date"
+          className="timeline__date"
+          aria-label={t.timeline.goToDate}
+          min={MIN_DATE}
+          max={MAX_DATE}
+          onChange={(event) => pickDate(event.target.value)}
+        />
+        <button
+          ref={filtersButton}
+          type="button"
+          className="button"
+          aria-expanded={filtersOpen}
+          aria-controls="timeline-filters"
+          onClick={() => setFiltersOpen((open) => !open)}
+        >
+          {filterOn ? `${t.timeline.filters.toggle} (${filterCount})` : t.timeline.filters.toggle}
+        </button>
+        <button type="button" className="button" onClick={() => goTo(today)}>
+          {t.timeline.goToToday}
+        </button>
+        {scrolled && (
+          <button type="button" className="button" onClick={backToTop}>
+            {t.timeline.backToTop}
+          </button>
+        )}
+        {filtersOpen && (
+          <TimelineFilters
+            filter={filter}
+            tags={tags}
+            agendas={agendas}
+            groups={agendaGroups}
+            selection={selection}
+            layout={layout}
+            savedViews={savedViews}
+            activeViewId={memory.viewId}
+            droppedTagNames={droppedTagNames}
+            activeCount={filterCount}
+            onChange={(next) => {
+              changeControls({ filter: next });
+              setDroppedTagNames([]);
+            }}
+            onSelectionChange={changeSelection}
+            onLayoutChange={(next: AgendaLayout) => changeControls({ layout: next })}
+            onApplyView={applyView}
+            onActiveViewChange={(id) => onMemoryChange((current) => ({ ...current, viewId: id }))}
+            onClear={clearFilters}
+            onClose={closeFilters}
+          />
+        )}
+      </div>
+
+      {activeView && (
+        <p className="timeline__filter-state">
+          <span role="status">
+            {t.timeline.filters.views.state.replace('{name}', activeView.name)}
+            {viewChanged && ` (${t.timeline.filters.views.changed})`}
+          </span>
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {filterOn && (
+        <p className="timeline__filter-state">
+          <span role="status">
+            {nothingMatches ? t.timeline.filters.noMatch : t.timeline.filters.activeNotice}
+          </span>
+          <button type="button" className="button" onClick={clearFilters}>
+            {t.timeline.filters.clear}
+          </button>
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {/* A toast above the tab bar, always in the page so a screen reader announces its text */}
+      <div className="timeline__notice" role="status">
+        {justDone && (
+          <>
+            <span>{t.timeline.markedDone.replace('{name}', justDone.title)}</span>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              aria-label={t.timeline.undoNamed.replace('{name}', justDone.title)}
+              onClick={() => void undoDone()}
+            >
+              {t.timeline.undo}
+            </button>
+          </>
+        )}
+      </div>
+      {saveFailed && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error timeline__notice">
+          {t.timeline.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      <button type="button" className="button timeline__more" onClick={() => extend('before')}>
+        {t.timeline.earlier}
+      </button>
+
+      {segments.map((segment) => {
+        if (segment.kind === 'day') return block(segment.day);
+        const open = segment.days.some((day) => expanded.has(day.date));
+        const label = runLabel(segment.days);
+        return (
+          <div key={`run-${segment.days[0]!.date}`} className="timeline__run">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="timeline__fold"
+              aria-expanded={open}
+              onClick={() => toggleRun(segment.days, !open)}
+            >
+              {open
+                ? t.timeline.hideRun.replace('{range}', label)
+                : `${label} · ${formatCount(locale, segment.days.length, t.timeline.emptyDays)}`}
+            </button>
+            {open && segment.days.map((day) => block(day))}
+          </div>
+        );
+      })}
+
+      <button type="button" className="button timeline__more" onClick={() => extend('after')}>
+        {t.timeline.later}
+      </button>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
