+import { useState, type Dispatch, type SetStateAction } from 'react';
+import { localDate } from '../core';
+import {
+  useAgendaGroups,
+  useAgendas,
+  useItems,
+  useSavedViews,
+  useStatusGroups,
+  useStatuses,
+  useTags,
+} from './data/useEntityList';
+import { useDisplayTimeZone } from './data/useDisplayTimeZone';
+import { usePeriodBounds } from './data/usePeriodBounds';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+import { TimelineScroller } from './TimelineScroller';
+import { INITIAL_TIMELINE_MEMORY, type TimelineMemory } from './timelineMemory';
+
+interface TimelineViewProps {
+  /** The current instant in milliseconds. Only tests pass it, to fix the clock. */
+  now?: number;
+  /**
+   * The filters, agenda selection, layout and active saved view. The shell passes them so they
+   * outlive this screen. Without them (tests) the screen keeps its own.
+   */
+  memory?: TimelineMemory;
+  onMemoryChange?: Dispatch<SetStateAction<TimelineMemory>>;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The Timeline screen: reads the data and waits until everything is loaded, then hands it to the
+ * scrolling list. The day logic comes from the `core`, so this screen only reads and draws.
+ */
+export function TimelineView({ now, memory, onMemoryChange }: TimelineViewProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const agendas = useAgendas();
+  const agendaGroups = useAgendaGroups();
+  const items = useItems();
+  const statuses = useStatuses();
+  const statusGroups = useStatusGroups();
+  const tags = useTags();
+  const savedViews = useSavedViews();
+  const zone = useDisplayTimeZone();
+  const bounds = usePeriodBounds();
+  // The clock is read once, when the screen opens. Today is fixed until the screen opens again.
+  const [openedAt] = useState(() => Date.now());
+  const [ownMemory, setOwnMemory] = useState(INITIAL_TIMELINE_MEMORY);
+
+  const lists = [agendas, agendaGroups, items, statuses, statusGroups, tags, savedViews];
+  // The zone and the period hours are read first, so a day is never cut or filtered wrongly
+  if (zone === null || bounds === null || lists.some((list) => list.loading)) return null;
+
+  if (lists.some((list) => list.failed)) {
+    return (
+      <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+        {t.timeline.loadFailed}
+      </p>
+    );
+  }
+
+  const nowMs = now ?? openedAt;
+  return (
+    <TimelineScroller
+      items={items.data}
+      agendas={agendas.data}
+      agendaGroups={agendaGroups.data}
+      statuses={statuses.data}
+      statusGroups={statusGroups.data}
+      tags={tags.data}
+      savedViews={savedViews.data}
+      memory={memory ?? ownMemory}
+      onMemoryChange={onMemoryChange ?? setOwnMemory}
+      bounds={bounds}
+      zone={zone}
+      nowMs={nowMs}
+      today={localDate(nowMs, zone)}
+    />
+  );
+}

+import { useState, type FormEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import { createSavedView, moveStep, type Agenda, type Id, type SavedView } from '../core';
+import {
+  VIEW_NAME_MAX,
+  isViewCurrent,
+  nextViewOrder,
+  snapshotControls,
+  sortSavedViews,
+  viewNameProblem,
+  type TimelineControls,
+} from '../filters';
+import { useData } from './data/useData';
+import { useI18n } from './i18n/useI18n';
+
+type Mode =
+  { kind: 'idle' } | { kind: 'create' } | { kind: 'rename' } | { kind: 'delete'; failed: boolean };
+
+type Failure = 'update' | 'order' | null;
+
+interface TimelineViewsProps {
+  views: readonly SavedView[];
+  /** The view the controls came from, or null. */
+  activeId: Id | null;
+  /** What is on screen now, to save or to compare with the active view. */
+  controls: TimelineControls;
+  agendas: readonly Agenda[];
+  /** Sets the controls to the view and makes it the active one. */
+  onApply: (view: SavedView) => void;
+  /** Changes only which view counts as active (a new view, or none), leaving the controls. */
+  onActiveChange: (id: Id | null) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Saved views, inside the filter panel. Analogy: presets on a radio. Pick one and the controls
+ * jump to it. The buttons act on the view that is picked: update it with what is on screen,
+ * restore it, rename, delete or move it in the list. "Save as view" takes a photo of the controls
+ * under a new name. The saving itself is here, and the screen above only learns which view is
+ * active.
+ */
+export function TimelineViews({
+  views,
+  activeId,
+  controls,
+  agendas,
+  onApply,
+  onActiveChange,
+}: TimelineViewsProps) {
+  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
+  const text = t.timeline.filters.views;
+  const { repos, notify } = useData();
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>({ kind: 'idle' });
+  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<Failure>(null);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+
+  const sorted = sortSavedViews(views, locale);
+  const active = sorted.find((view) => view.id === activeId) ?? null;
+  const current = active === null || isViewCurrent(active, controls, agendas);
+  const position = active ? sorted.findIndex((view) => view.id === active.id) : -1;
+
+  function pick(id: string) {
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    setFailure(null);
+    const view = sorted.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
+    if (view) onApply(view);
+    else onActiveChange(null);
+  }
+
+  async function create(name: string) {
+    const view = createSavedView({
+      name,
+      order: nextViewOrder(views),
+      ...snapshotControls(controls),
+    });
+    await repos.savedViews.put(view);
+    notify();
+    onActiveChange(view.id);
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function rename(name: string) {
+    if (!active) return;
+    await repos.savedViews.update(active.id, { name });
+    notify();
+    setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+  }
+
+  async function update() {
+    if (!active) return;
+    setFailure(null);
+    setBusy(true);
+    try {
+      await repos.savedViews.update(active.id, snapshotControls(controls));
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setFailure('update');
+    } finally {
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function move(step: -1 | 1) {
+    if (!active) return;
+    setFailure(null);
+    try {
+      const changes = moveStep(sorted, active.id, step);
+      await Promise.all(
+        changes.map((change) => repos.savedViews.update(change.id, { order: change.order })),
+      );
+      notify();
+    } catch {
+      setFailure('order');
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function confirmDelete() {
+    if (!active) return;
+    setBusy(true);
+    try {
+      await repos.savedViews.remove(active.id);
+      notify();
+      onActiveChange(null);
+      setMode({ kind: 'idle' });
+    } catch {
+      setMode({ kind: 'delete', failed: true });
+    } finally {
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <fieldset className="field field--group views">
+      <legend className="field__label">{text.legend}</legend>
+      <p className="field__hint">{sorted.length === 0 ? text.empty : text.hint}</p>
+
+      {sorted.length > 0 && (
+        <div className="field">
+          <label className="field__label" htmlFor="timeline-view-select">
+            {text.select}
+          </label>
+          <select
+            id="timeline-view-select"
+            className="field__input"
+            value={active?.id ?? ''}
+            onChange={(event) => pick(event.target.value)}
+          >
+            <option value="">{text.none}</option>
+            {sorted.map((view) => (
+              <option key={view.id} value={view.id}>
+                {view.name}
+              </option>
+            ))}
+          </select>
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'idle' && (
+        <div className="actions">
+          <button type="button" className="button" onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'create' })}>
+            {sorted.length === 0 ? text.saveFirst : text.saveNew}
+          </button>
+          {active && (
+            <>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                disabled={current || busy}
+                aria-label={text.updateNamed.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => void update()}
+              >
+                {text.update}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                disabled={current}
+                aria-label={text.restoreNamed.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => onApply(active)}
+              >
+                {text.restore}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                aria-label={text.renameNamed.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'rename' })}
+              >
+                {text.rename}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                disabled={position <= 0}
+                aria-label={text.moveUp.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => void move(-1)}
+              >
+                {text.up}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button"
+                disabled={position === sorted.length - 1}
+                aria-label={text.moveDown.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => void move(1)}
+              >
+                {text.down}
+              </button>
+              <button
+                type="button"
+                className="button button--danger"
+                aria-label={text.removeNamed.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+                onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'delete', failed: false })}
+              >
+                {text.remove}
+              </button>
+            </>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      )}
+
+      {failure === 'update' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {text.updateFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      {failure === 'order' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {text.orderFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'create' && (
+        <ViewNameForm
+          title={text.form.createTitle}
+          views={views}
+          onSubmit={create}
+          onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+        />
+      )}
+      {mode.kind === 'rename' && active && (
+        <ViewNameForm
+          key={active.id}
+          title={text.form.renameTitle}
+          initialName={active.name}
+          ignoreId={active.id}
+          views={views}
+          onSubmit={rename}
+          onCancel={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+        />
+      )}
+
+      {mode.kind === 'delete' && active && (
+        <div role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="view-delete-text" className="panel panel--danger">
+          <p id="view-delete-text" className="panel__text">
+            {text.confirm.replace('{name}', active.name)}
+          </p>
+          {mode.failed && (
+            <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+              {text.deleteFailed}
+            </p>
+          )}
+          <div className="actions">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button button--danger"
+              disabled={busy}
+              onClick={() => void confirmDelete()}
+            >
+              {text.confirmAction}
+            </button>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className="button"
+              disabled={busy}
+              onClick={() => setMode({ kind: 'idle' })}
+            >
+              {text.cancel}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      )}
+    </fieldset>
+  );
+}
+
+interface ViewNameFormProps {
+  title: string;
+  initialName?: string;
+  /** The view being renamed, so it does not clash with its own name. */
+  ignoreId?: Id;
+  views: readonly SavedView[];
+  onSubmit: (name: string) => Promise<void>;
+  onCancel: () => void;
+}
+
+/** The name field for a new or renamed view. Escape closes only this form, not the whole panel. */
+function ViewNameForm({
+  title,
+  initialName = '',
+  ignoreId,
+  views,
+  onSubmit,
+  onCancel,
+}: ViewNameFormProps) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const text = t.timeline.filters.views.form;
+  const [name, setName] = useState(initialName);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<'empty' | 'duplicate' | 'saveFailed' | null>(null);
+  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+
+  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const problem = viewNameProblem(name, views, ignoreId);
+    if (problem) {
+      setError(problem);
+      return;
+    }
+    setSaving(true);
+    try {
+      await onSubmit(name.trim());
+    } catch {
+      setError('saveFailed');
+      setSaving(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
+    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
+    event.stopPropagation();
+    onCancel();
+  }
+
+  const nameError = error === 'empty' || error === 'duplicate';
+  return (
+    <form
+      className="panel"
+      onSubmit={(event) => void handleSubmit(event)}
+      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+      noValidate
+      aria-label={title}
+    >
+      <h3 className="panel__title">{title}</h3>
+      <div className="field">
+        <label htmlFor="view-name" className="field__label">
+          {text.name}
+        </label>
+        <input
+          id="view-name"
+          className="field__input"
+          type="text"
+          value={name}
+          maxLength={VIEW_NAME_MAX}
+          autoFocus
+          aria-invalid={nameError}
+          aria-describedby={nameError ? 'view-name-error' : undefined}
+          onChange={(event) => {
+            setName(event.target.value);
+            if (nameError) setError(null);
+          }}
+        />
+        {nameError && (
+          <p id="view-name-error" role="alert" className="field__error">
+            {error === 'empty' ? text.nameRequired : text.nameTaken}
+          </p>
+        )}
+      </div>
+      {error === 'saveFailed' && (
+        <p role="alert" className="field__error">
+          {text.saveFailed}
+        </p>
+      )}
+      <div className="actions">
+        <button type="submit" className="button button--primary" disabled={saving}>
+          {text.save}
+        </button>
+        <button type="button" className="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={saving}>
+          {text.cancel}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </form>
+  );
+}

+/**
+ * One import problem as a sentence: where it is (for example `data.items[3].title`) and what is
+ * wrong, in the active language. For an invalid item the reasons come from the same texts the
+ * item form uses.
+ */
+export function formatIssue(issue: ImportIssue, t: Messages): string {
+  const where = issue.path === '' ? '' : `${issue.path}: `;
+  if (issue.code === 'invalidItem') {
+    const reasons = (issue.detail ?? '')
+      .split(',')
+      .filter((code) => code !== '')
+      .map((code) => (t.items.issues as Record<string, string>)[code] ?? code);
+    return `${where}${[t.backup.issues.invalidItem, ...reasons].join(' ')}`;
+  }
+  return `${where}${t.backup.issues[issue.code]}`;
+}
+
+/** The totals of an import over every kind of record. */
+export function totalSummary(summary: ImportSummary): {
+  added: number;
+  updated: number;
+  skipped: number;
+} {
+  const total = { added: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0 };
+  for (const value of Object.values(summary)) {
+    if (typeof value === 'boolean') continue;
+    total.added += value.added;
+    total.updated += value.updated;
+    total.skipped += value.skipped;
+  }
+  return total;
+}
+
+/** Reads a file chosen by the person as text. */
+export function readFileText(file: Blob): Promise<string> {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const reader = new FileReader();
+    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result ?? ''));
+    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error ?? new Error('Could not read the file'));
+    reader.readAsText(file);
+  });
+}
+
+/** Starts a download of some text, through a temporary `<a download>` link. */
+export function downloadText(fileName: string, text: string): void {
+  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: 'application/json' }));
+  const link = document.createElement('a');
+  link.href = url;
+  link.download = fileName;
+  document.body.append(link);
+  link.click();
+  link.remove();
+  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+}

+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+import { createRepositories, ensureDefaultStatuses, type AgendaDatabase } from '../../storage';
+import { useI18n } from '../i18n/useI18n';
+import { DataContext } from './DataContext';
+
+/**
+ * Gives the screens the database and tells them when to read again. On the first open it creates
+ * the starting Kanban groups, named in the active language, and asks the browser not to erase the
+ * data when the device runs low on space.
+ */
+export function DataProvider({ db, children }: { db: AgendaDatabase; children: ReactNode }) {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);
+  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
+  const repos = useMemo(() => createRepositories(db), [db]);
+  const notify = useCallback(() => setRevision((current) => current + 1), []);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => t.defaults[key])
+      .then((created) => {
+        if (cancelled) return;
+        if (created) notify();
+        setReady(true);
+      })
+      .catch(() => {
+        // The screens still open. Each one shows its own error if a read or write fails.
+        if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
+      });
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+    };
+  }, [db, t.defaults, notify]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    // Best effort: the browser may refuse, and that is fine
+    navigator.storage?.persist?.().catch(() => undefined);
+  }, []);
+
+  const value = useMemo(
+    () => ({ db, repos, revision, ready, notify }),
+    [db, repos, revision, ready, notify],
+  );
+  return <DataContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</DataContext.Provider>;
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

+/**
+ * The real time zone name to show dates in: the one chosen in the settings, or the device zone
+ * when the setting is `auto`. It is `null` until the settings have been read, so a screen can
+ * wait instead of showing a time in the wrong zone for a moment.

+      });
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+    };
+  }, [db, revision]);

+  return zone;

+import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import type { SyncFields } from '../../core';
+import type { Repositories, Repository } from '../../storage';
+import { useData } from './useData';
+
+type ListOf<K extends keyof Repositories> =
+  Repositories[K] extends Repository<infer T> ? T[] : never;
+
+export interface EntityList<K extends keyof Repositories> {
+  /** The active (not deleted) entities, in no particular order. */
+  data: ListOf<K>;
+  /** True until the first read finishes. */
+  loading: boolean;
+  /** True if the last read failed. */
+  failed: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Reads all active entities of one kind and reads again after every write (`notify`). */
+export function useEntityList<K extends keyof Repositories>(kind: K): EntityList<K> {
+  const { repos, revision } = useData();
+  const [state, setState] = useState<EntityList<K>>({
+    data: [] as unknown as ListOf<K>,
+    loading: true,
+    failed: false,
+  });
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    (repos[kind] as Repository<SyncFields>)
+      .list()
+      .then((data) => {
+        if (!cancelled)
+          setState({ data: data as unknown as ListOf<K>, loading: false, failed: false });
+      })
+      .catch(() => {
+        if (!cancelled) setState((current) => ({ ...current, loading: false, failed: true }));
+      });
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+    };
+  }, [repos, kind, revision]);
+
+  return state;
+}
+
+export const useAgendas = () => useEntityList('agendas');
+export const useAgendaGroups = () => useEntityList('agendaGroups');
+export const useItems = () => useEntityList('items');
+export const useTags = () => useEntityList('tags');
+export const useSavedViews = () => useEntityList('savedViews');
+export const useStatuses = () => useEntityList('statuses');
+export const useStatusGroups = () => useEntityList('statusGroups');

diff --git a/src/ui/eventValues.ts b/src/ui/eventValues.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..be1d29c

+++ b/src/ui/eventValues.ts

+import {
+  createItem,
+  formatPlainDate,
+  getZonedParts,
+  isPlainDate,
+  isTimestamp,
+  isValidTimeZone,
+  msToTimestamp,
+  timestampToMs,
+  validateItem,
+  zonedTimeToMs,
+  type Id,
+  type Item,
+  type ItemIssue,
+  type ItemLink,
+  type Schedule,
+} from '../core';
+
+/*
+ * The event form works with plain text (what the inputs hold). This file turns that text into
+ * the fields of an item, and back. It has no React, so it is easy to test.
+ */
+
+export type ScheduleMode = 'none' | 'allDay' | 'timed';
+
+export interface LinkValues {
+  label: string;
+  url: string;
+}
+
+export interface EventFormValues {
+  title: string;
+  mode: ScheduleMode;
+  startDate: string;
+  startTime: string;
+  endDate: string;
+  endTime: string;
+  /** Empty means "use the display time zone". */
+  timeZone: string;
+  location: string;
+  notes: string;
+  links: LinkValues[];
+  tagIds: Id[];
+  inheritTags: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Problems found only by the form, before the core rules run. */
+export type FormIssue =
+  | ItemIssue
+  | 'startDateRequired'
+  | 'startTimeRequired'
+  | 'endTimeRequired'
+  | 'linkInvalid'
+  | 'saveFailed';
+
+/** Where a message is shown. `form` is for problems that belong to no single field. */
+export type FieldKey = 'title' | 'start' | 'end' | 'timeZone' | 'links' | 'form';
+
+export type FieldErrors = Partial<Record<FieldKey, FormIssue>>;
+
+/** The part of an item that the event form edits. */
+export interface EventFields {
+  title: string;
+  notes: string;
+  schedule: Schedule | null;
+  location: string;
+  links: ItemLink[];
+  tagIds: Id[];
+  inheritTags: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Every time zone name the browser knows, for the suggestions list. Empty if it cannot tell. */
+export function knownTimeZones(): string[] {
+  const intl = Intl as unknown as { supportedValuesOf?: (key: string) => string[] };
+  try {
+    return intl.supportedValuesOf?.('timeZone') ?? [];
+  } catch {
+    return [];
+  }
+}
+
+export function emptyEventValues(): EventFormValues {
+  return {
+    title: '',
+    mode: 'none',
+    startDate: '',
+    startTime: '',
+    endDate: '',
+    endTime: '',
+    timeZone: '',
+    location: '',
+    notes: '',
+    links: [],
+    tagIds: [],
+    inheritTags: true,
+  };
+}
+
+const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
+
+export function parseTime(value: string): { hour: number; minute: number } | null {
+  const match = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$/.exec(value);
+  return match ? { hour: Number(match[1]), minute: Number(match[2]) } : null;
+}
+
+/** Splits an instant into the date and the time it shows on the wall clock of a zone. */
+export function splitInstant(instant: string, zone: string): { date: string; time: string } {
+  if (!isTimestamp(instant)) return { date: '', time: '' };
+  const parts = getZonedParts(timestampToMs(instant), zone);
+  return { date: formatPlainDate(parts), time: `${pad(parts.hour)}:${pad(parts.minute)}` };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The text of the inputs for an existing event. A timed event is shown on the clock of its own
+ * time zone when it has one, and on the display time zone otherwise.
+ */
+export function valuesFromItem(item: Item, displayTimeZone: string): EventFormValues {
+  const values: EventFormValues = {
+    ...emptyEventValues(),
+    title: item.title,
+    location: item.location,
+    notes: item.notes,
+    links: item.links.map((link) => ({ label: link.label, url: link.url })),
+    tagIds: [...item.tagIds],
+    inheritTags: item.inheritTags,
+  };
+  const schedule = item.schedule;
+  if (!schedule) return values;
+
+  if (schedule.allDay) {
+    return { ...values, mode: 'allDay', startDate: schedule.start, endDate: schedule.end ?? '' };
+  }
+  const zone = schedule.timeZone ?? displayTimeZone;
+  const start = splitInstant(schedule.start, zone);
+  const end =
+    schedule.end === undefined ? { date: '', time: '' } : splitInstant(schedule.end, zone);
+  return {
+    ...values,
+    mode: 'timed',
+    startDate: start.date,
+    startTime: start.time,
+    // An end on the same day as the start leaves the end date empty, to keep the form short
+    endDate: end.date === start.date ? '' : end.date,
+    endTime: end.time,
+    timeZone: schedule.timeZone ?? '',
+  };
+}
+
+export function isHttpUrl(value: string): boolean {
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(value);
+    return url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'https:';
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+function buildSchedule(
+  values: EventFormValues,
+  displayTimeZone: string,
+): { schedule: Schedule | null; errors: FieldErrors } {
+  if (values.mode === 'none') return { schedule: null, errors: {} };
+
+  if (values.mode === 'allDay') {
+    if (values.startDate === '') return { schedule: null, errors: { start: 'startDateRequired' } };
+    const end = values.endDate === '' ? {} : { end: values.endDate };
+    return { schedule: { allDay: true, start: values.startDate, ...end }, errors: {} };
+  }
+
+  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
+  const zoneText = values.timeZone.trim();
+  if (zoneText !== '' && !isValidTimeZone(zoneText)) errors.timeZone = 'invalidTimeZone';
+  if (values.startDate === '') errors.start = 'startDateRequired';
+  const start = parseTime(values.startTime);
+  if (!errors.start && !start) errors.start = 'startTimeRequired';
+  const end = parseTime(values.endTime);
+  if (values.endDate !== '' && !end) errors.end = 'endTimeRequired';
+  if (values.endTime !== '' && !end) errors.end = 'endTimeRequired';
+  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0 || !start) return { schedule: null, errors };
+  if (!isPlainDate(values.startDate) || (values.endDate !== '' && !isPlainDate(values.endDate))) {
+    return { schedule: null, errors: { start: 'startDateRequired' } };
+  }
+
+  const zone = zoneText === '' ? displayTimeZone : zoneText;
+  const startMs = zonedTimeToMs(values.startDate, start.hour, start.minute, zone);
+  const schedule: Schedule = {
+    allDay: false,
+    start: msToTimestamp(startMs),
+    ...(zoneText === '' ? {} : { timeZone: zoneText }),
+  };
+  if (end) {
+    const endDate = values.endDate === '' ? values.startDate : values.endDate;
+    schedule.end = msToTimestamp(zonedTimeToMs(endDate, end.hour, end.minute, zone));
+  }
+  return { schedule, errors: {} };
+}
+
+export function buildLinks(rows: LinkValues[]): { links: ItemLink[]; valid: boolean } {
+  const links: ItemLink[] = [];
+  let valid = true;
+  for (const row of rows) {
+    const label = row.label.trim();
+    const url = row.url.trim();
+    if (label === '' && url === '') continue;
+    if (!isHttpUrl(url)) {
+      valid = false;
+      continue;
+    }
+    links.push({ label: label === '' ? url : label, url });
+  }
+  return { links, valid };
+}
+
+/** Which field shows the message for each rule of the core. */
+function fieldOf(issue: ItemIssue, mode: ScheduleMode): FieldKey {
+  switch (issue) {
+    case 'titleRequired':
+      return 'title';
+    case 'invalidDate':
+    case 'invalidInstant':
+      return 'start';
+    case 'endBeforeStart':
+      return mode === 'none' ? 'form' : 'end';
+    case 'invalidTimeZone':
+      return 'timeZone';
+    default:
+      return 'form';
+  }
+}
+
+export interface BuildResult {
+  /** Filled only when there are no errors. */
+  fields: EventFields | null;
+  errors: FieldErrors;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks the text of the form and builds the fields of the event. Our own checks (a missing
+ * date, a bad link) run first, then the rules of the core run over the finished item, so the
+ * form and the stored data never disagree. Each field keeps only its first message.
+ */
+export function buildEventFields(
+  values: EventFormValues,
+  displayTimeZone: string,
+  base: { agendaId: Id; existing?: Item },
+): BuildResult {
+  const built = buildSchedule(values, displayTimeZone);
+  const errors: FieldErrors = { ...built.errors };
+  const links = buildLinks(values.links);
+  if (!links.valid) errors.links = 'linkInvalid';
+
+  const fields: EventFields = {
+    title: values.title.trim(),
+    notes: values.notes,
+    schedule: built.schedule,
+    location: values.location.trim(),
+    links: links.links,
+    tagIds: [...new Set(values.tagIds)],
+    inheritTags: values.inheritTags,
+  };
+
+  const draft: Item = {
+    ...(base.existing ?? createItem({ kind: 'event', title: '', agendaId: base.agendaId })),
+    ...fields,
+  };
+  for (const issue of validateItem(draft, displayTimeZone)) {
+    const key = fieldOf(issue, values.mode);
+    if (!errors[key]) errors[key] = issue;
+  }
+
+  return Object.keys(errors).length > 0 ? { fields: null, errors } : { fields, errors };
+}
diff --git a/src/ui/format.ts b/src/ui/format.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..03fb1f8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ui/format.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import {
+  localDate,
+  resolveTimeZone,
+  timestampToMs,
+  type Due,
+  type PlainDate,
+  type Schedule,
+  type Timestamp,
+} from '../core';
+
+/** Texts for a count. Zero has its own text because Portuguese treats 0 like 1 (singular). */
+export interface CountForms {
+  zero: string;
+  one: string;
+  /** Used for every other count. */
+  other: string;
+}
+
+/** Picks the right form and fills `{count}`, for example "1 item", "3 itens" or "Nenhum item". */
+export function formatCount(locale: string, count: number, forms: CountForms): string {
+  const form =
+    count === 0
+      ? forms.zero
+      : new Intl.PluralRules(locale).select(count) === 'one'
+        ? forms.one
+        : forms.other;
+  return form.replace('{count}', count.toLocaleString(locale));
+}
+
+/** A calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). It has no time zone, so it is read as UTC to never shift a day. */
+export function formatDate(locale: string, date: PlainDate): string {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(
+    new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`),
+  );
+}
+
+/** An instant shown in the display time zone. `auto` follows the device. */
+export function formatDateTime(
+  locale: string,
+  instant: Timestamp,
+  timeZone: string = 'auto',
+): string {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
+    dateStyle: 'medium',
+    timeStyle: 'short',
+    timeZone: timeZone === 'auto' ? undefined : timeZone,
+  }).format(new Date(instant));
+}
+
+/** Only the hour and minute of an instant, in the display time zone. */
+export function formatTime(locale: string, instant: Timestamp, timeZone: string = 'auto'): string {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
+    timeStyle: 'short',
+    timeZone: timeZone === 'auto' ? undefined : timeZone,
+  }).format(new Date(instant));
+}
+
+/**
+ * When something happens, as one line of text. A timed schedule is shown in the display time
+ * zone. `rangeTemplate` has `{start}` and `{end}`, so each language writes its own "to".
+ * An end on the same day as the start shows only the hour.
+ */
+export function formatSchedule(
+  locale: string,
+  schedule: Schedule,
+  timeZone: string,
+  rangeTemplate: string,
+): string {
+  const join = (start: string, end: string) =>
+    rangeTemplate.replace('{start}', start).replace('{end}', end);
+
+  if (schedule.allDay) {
+    const start = formatDate(locale, schedule.start);
+    if (schedule.end === undefined || schedule.end === schedule.start) return start;
+    return join(start, formatDate(locale, schedule.end));
+  }
+
+  const start = formatDateTime(locale, schedule.start, timeZone);
+  if (schedule.end === undefined) return start;
+  const zone = resolveTimeZone(timeZone);
+  const sameDay =
+    localDate(timestampToMs(schedule.start), zone) === localDate(timestampToMs(schedule.end), zone);
+  return join(
+    start,
+    sameDay
+      ? formatTime(locale, schedule.end, timeZone)
+      : formatDateTime(locale, schedule.end, timeZone),
+  );
+}
+
+/** The delivery of a task: a day, or a day and time shown in the display time zone. */
+export function formatDue(locale: string, due: Due, timeZone: string): string {
+  return due.allDay ? formatDate(locale, due.date) : formatDateTime(locale, due.at, timeZone);
+}
+
+/** A ratio from 0 to 1 as a percentage for the language, for example 60% or 60 %. */
+export function formatPercent(locale: string, ratio: number): string {
+  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(
+    ratio,
+  );
+}
+
+/** The heading of a day, for example "Saturday, November 7". A calendar date has no time zone. */
+export function formatDayHeading(locale: string, date: PlainDate): string {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
+    weekday: 'long',
+    day: 'numeric',
+    month: 'long',
+    timeZone: 'UTC',
+  }).format(new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`));
+}

+import { createContext } from 'react';

+  locale: Locale;

+};

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+import { I18nContext } from './I18nContext';
+import {
+  MESSAGES,
+  readStoredLocaleMode,
+  resolveLocale,
+  storeLocaleMode,
+  type LocaleMode,
+} from './locale';
+
+export function I18nProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<LocaleMode>(readStoredLocaleMode);
+  const locale = resolveLocale(mode);
+
+  // Keep the page language in sync, for screen readers and browser translation
+  useEffect(() => {
+    document.documentElement.lang = locale;
+  }, [locale]);
+
+  const setMode = useCallback((next: LocaleMode) => {
+    setModeState(next);
+    storeLocaleMode(next);
+  }, []);
+
+  const value = useMemo(
+    () => ({ t: MESSAGES[locale], locale, mode, setMode }),
+    [locale, mode, setMode],
+  );
+
+  return <I18nContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</I18nContext.Provider>;
+}

+++ b/src/ui/i18n/locale.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+import { en, type Messages } from './messages/en';
+import { ptBR } from './messages/pt-BR';
+
+export const LOCALES = ['pt-BR', 'en'] as const;
+export type Locale = (typeof LOCALES)[number];
+
+export const LOCALE_MODES = ['auto', ...LOCALES] as const;
+export type LocaleMode = (typeof LOCALE_MODES)[number];
+
+export const LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY = 'unified-agenda:locale';
+export const DEFAULT_LOCALE_MODE: LocaleMode = 'auto';
+export const FALLBACK_LOCALE: Locale = 'en';
+
+// Each language is written in its own name, so it is always recognizable
+export const LOCALE_NAMES: Record<Locale, string> = {
+  'pt-BR': 'Português',
+  en: 'English',
+};
+
+export const MESSAGES: Record<Locale, Messages> = {
+  'pt-BR': ptBR,
+  en,
+};
+
+export function isLocaleMode(value: unknown): value is LocaleMode {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && (LOCALE_MODES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
+}
+
+export function parseLocaleMode(value: unknown): LocaleMode {
+  return isLocaleMode(value) ? value : DEFAULT_LOCALE_MODE;
+}
+
+// Any Portuguese variant (pt, pt-PT, pt-BR) maps to the pt-BR texts, the only Portuguese we have.
+export function resolveLocale(
+  mode: LocaleMode,
+  preferred: readonly string[] = typeof navigator === 'undefined' ? [] : navigator.languages,
+): Locale {
+  if (mode !== 'auto') return mode;
+  for (const tag of preferred) {
+    const base = tag.toLowerCase().split('-')[0];
+    if (base === 'pt') return 'pt-BR';
+    if (base === 'en') return 'en';
+  }
+  return FALLBACK_LOCALE;
+}
+
+export function readStoredLocaleMode(): LocaleMode {
+  try {
+    return parseLocaleMode(localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY));
+  } catch {
+    return DEFAULT_LOCALE_MODE;
+  }
+}
+
+export function storeLocaleMode(mode: LocaleMode) {
+  try {
+    localStorage.setItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY, mode);
+  } catch {
+    // Storage can be blocked. The choice then lasts only for this visit.
+  }
+}

+import { useContext } from 'react';
+import { I18nContext } from './I18nContext';
+
+export function useI18n() {
+  const value = useContext(I18nContext);
+  if (!value) throw new Error('useI18n must be used inside I18nProvider');
+  return value;
+}
diff --git a/src/ui/settingsValues.ts b/src/ui/settingsValues.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7f7ab00
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ui/settingsValues.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+import { isValidPeriodBounds, isValidTimeZone, type Settings } from '../core';
+
+/** What the settings form holds: plain text, converted to and from `Settings` here. */
+export interface SettingsFormValues {
+  zoneMode: 'auto' | 'custom';
+  timeZone: string;
+  morningStart: string;
+  afternoonStart: string;
+  eveningStart: string;
+}
+
+export type SettingsIssue = 'timeZoneRequired' | 'invalidTimeZone' | 'hourInvalid' | 'periodOrder';
+
+export interface SettingsErrors {
+  timeZone?: SettingsIssue;
+  morningStart?: SettingsIssue;
+  afternoonStart?: SettingsIssue;
+  eveningStart?: SettingsIssue;
+  /** The three hours are fine one by one but are not in order. */
+  periods?: SettingsIssue;
+}
+
+export type BuildSettingsResult =
+  { ok: true; settings: Settings } | { ok: false; errors: SettingsErrors };
+
+const HOUR_FIELDS = ['morningStart', 'afternoonStart', 'eveningStart'] as const;
+
+export function settingsToValues(settings: Settings): SettingsFormValues {
+  const custom = settings.displayTimeZone !== 'auto';
+  return {
+    zoneMode: custom ? 'custom' : 'auto',
+    timeZone: custom ? settings.displayTimeZone : '',
+    morningStart: String(settings.periodBounds.morningStart),
+    afternoonStart: String(settings.periodBounds.afternoonStart),
+    eveningStart: String(settings.periodBounds.eveningStart),
+  };
+}
+
+/** Reads one hour typed by the person: a whole number from 1 to 23, or null. */
+function parseHour(text: string): number | null {
+  const trimmed = text.trim();
+  if (!/^\d{1,2}$/.test(trimmed)) return null;
+  const hour = Number(trimmed);
+  return hour >= 1 && hour <= 23 ? hour : null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks the form and builds the settings. The form checks what only it can see (empty or
+ * non-numeric text), then `isValidPeriodBounds` and `isValidTimeZone` from the core decide the
+ * rest, so the form and the stored data never disagree.
+ */
+export function buildSettings(values: SettingsFormValues): BuildSettingsResult {
+  const errors: SettingsErrors = {};
+
+  let displayTimeZone = 'auto';
+  if (values.zoneMode === 'custom') {
+    const zone = values.timeZone.trim();
+    if (zone === '') errors.timeZone = 'timeZoneRequired';
+    else if (!isValidTimeZone(zone)) errors.timeZone = 'invalidTimeZone';
+    else displayTimeZone = zone;
+  }
+
+  const hours: Record<(typeof HOUR_FIELDS)[number], number> = {
+    morningStart: 0,
+    afternoonStart: 0,
+    eveningStart: 0,
+  };
+  for (const field of HOUR_FIELDS) {
+    const hour = parseHour(values[field]);
+    if (hour === null) errors[field] = 'hourInvalid';
+    else hours[field] = hour;
+  }
+
+  const hoursOk = HOUR_FIELDS.every((field) => !errors[field]);
+  if (hoursOk && !isValidPeriodBounds(hours)) errors.periods = 'periodOrder';
+
+  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return { ok: false, errors };
+  return { ok: true, settings: { displayTimeZone, periodBounds: hours } };
+}
diff --git a/src/ui/tagValues.ts b/src/ui/tagValues.ts

+++ b/src/ui/tagValues.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import { isActive, tagWithDescendantIds, type Id, type Tag } from '../core';
+
+export interface TagRow {
+  tag: Tag;
+  /** 0 for a top-level tag. */
+  depth: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The tag tree as a flat list in reading order: each tag followed by its sub-tags, siblings sorted
+ * by name. A tag whose parent is missing or deleted is shown at the top level, so nothing is lost.
+ * Safe on data that has a loop.
+ */
+export function flattenTagTree(tags: readonly Tag[], locale: string): TagRow[] {
+  const active = tags.filter(isActive);
+  const ids = new Set(active.map((tag) => tag.id));
+  const byParent = new Map<Id | null, Tag[]>();
+  for (const tag of active) {
+    const key = tag.parentId !== null && ids.has(tag.parentId) ? tag.parentId : null;
+    const list = byParent.get(key);
+    if (list) list.push(tag);
+    else byParent.set(key, [tag]);
+  }
+  for (const list of byParent.values()) {
+    list.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, locale) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
+  }
+
+  const rows: TagRow[] = [];
+  const seen = new Set<Id>();
+  const visit = (parent: Id | null, depth: number) => {
+    for (const tag of byParent.get(parent) ?? []) {
+      if (seen.has(tag.id)) continue;
+      seen.add(tag.id);
+      rows.push({ tag, depth });
+      visit(tag.id, depth + 1);
+    }
+  };
+  visit(null, 0);
+  return rows;
+}
+
+/** The tags a tag can be moved under: not itself and not anything inside it (that would be a loop). */
+export function possibleParents(tag: Tag | null, tags: readonly Tag[]): Tag[] {
+  const active = tags.filter(isActive);
+  if (tag === null) return active;
+  const blocked = tagWithDescendantIds(tag.id, active);
+  return active.filter((candidate) => !blocked.has(candidate.id));
+}
diff --git a/src/ui/taskValues.ts b/src/ui/taskValues.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f4ed2ba

+++ b/src/ui/taskValues.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+import {
+  createItem,
+  isValidTimeZone,
+  msToTimestamp,
+  validateItem,
+  zonedTimeToMs,
+  type Due,
+  type Id,
+  type Item,
+  type ItemIssue,
+  type ItemLink,
+  type PlainDate,
+} from '../core';
+import { buildLinks, parseTime, splitInstant, type LinkValues } from './eventValues';
+
+/*
+ * The task form works with plain text (what the inputs hold). This file turns that text into the
+ * fields of a task, and back. It has no React, so it is easy to test. It mirrors eventValues.ts.
+ */
+
+export type DueMode = 'none' | 'allDay' | 'timed';
+
+export interface TaskFormValues {
+  title: string;
+  /** Empty until a status is chosen. */
+  statusId: string;
+  /** The first day the task is pending. Empty means the day the task is created. */
+  from: string;
+  dueMode: DueMode;
+  dueDate: string;
+  dueTime: string;
+  /** Empty means "use the display time zone". */
+  timeZone: string;
+  location: string;
+  notes: string;
+  links: LinkValues[];
+  tagIds: Id[];
+  inheritTags: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Problems found only by the form, before the core rules run. */
+export type TaskIssue =
+  ItemIssue | 'dueDateRequired' | 'dueTimeRequired' | 'linkInvalid' | 'saveFailed';
+
+/** Where a message is shown. `form` is for problems that belong to no single field. */
+export type TaskFieldKey = 'title' | 'status' | 'from' | 'due' | 'timeZone' | 'links' | 'form';
+
+export type TaskFieldErrors = Partial<Record<TaskFieldKey, TaskIssue>>;
+
+/** The part of an item that the task form edits. */
+export interface TaskFields {
+  title: string;
+  notes: string;
+  statusId: Id | null;
+  from: PlainDate | null;
+  due: Due | null;
+  location: string;
+  links: ItemLink[];
+  tagIds: Id[];
+  inheritTags: boolean;
+}
+
+export function emptyTaskValues(statusId: Id = ''): TaskFormValues {
+  return {
+    title: '',
+    statusId,
+    from: '',
+    dueMode: 'none',
+    dueDate: '',
+    dueTime: '',
+    timeZone: '',
+    location: '',
+    notes: '',
+    links: [],
+    tagIds: [],
+    inheritTags: true,
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The text of the inputs for an existing task. A timed delivery is shown on the clock of its own
+ * time zone when it has one, and on the display time zone otherwise.
+ */
+export function valuesFromTask(item: Item, displayTimeZone: string): TaskFormValues {
+  const values: TaskFormValues = {
+    ...emptyTaskValues(item.statusId ?? ''),
+    title: item.title,
+    from: item.from ?? '',
+    location: item.location,
+    notes: item.notes,
+    links: item.links.map((link) => ({ label: link.label, url: link.url })),
+    tagIds: [...item.tagIds],
+    inheritTags: item.inheritTags,
+  };
+  const due = item.due;
+  if (!due) return values;
+  if (due.allDay) return { ...values, dueMode: 'allDay', dueDate: due.date };
+
+  const parts = splitInstant(due.at, due.timeZone ?? displayTimeZone);
+  return {
+    ...values,
+    dueMode: 'timed',
+    dueDate: parts.date,
+    dueTime: parts.time,
+    timeZone: due.timeZone ?? '',
+  };
+}
+
+function buildDue(
+  values: TaskFormValues,
+  displayTimeZone: string,
+): { due: Due | null; errors: TaskFieldErrors } {
+  if (values.dueMode === 'none') return { due: null, errors: {} };
+
+  if (values.dueMode === 'allDay') {
+    if (values.dueDate === '') return { due: null, errors: { due: 'dueDateRequired' } };
+    return { due: { allDay: true, date: values.dueDate }, errors: {} };
+  }
+
+  const errors: TaskFieldErrors = {};
+  const zoneText = values.timeZone.trim();
+  if (zoneText !== '' && !isValidTimeZone(zoneText)) errors.timeZone = 'invalidTimeZone';
+  if (values.dueDate === '') errors.due = 'dueDateRequired';
+  const time = parseTime(values.dueTime);
+  if (!errors.due && !time) errors.due = 'dueTimeRequired';
+  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0 || !time) return { due: null, errors };
+
+  const zone = zoneText === '' ? displayTimeZone : zoneText;
+  const at = msToTimestamp(zonedTimeToMs(values.dueDate, time.hour, time.minute, zone));
+  return { due: { allDay: false, at, ...(zoneText === '' ? {} : { timeZone: zoneText }) }, errors };
+}
+
+/** Which field shows the message for each rule of the core. */
+function fieldOf(issue: ItemIssue): TaskFieldKey {
+  switch (issue) {
+    case 'titleRequired':
+      return 'title';
+    case 'taskNeedsStatus':
+      return 'status';
+    case 'fromNeedsDue':
+    case 'invalidFromDate':
+    case 'fromAfterDue':
+      return 'from';
+    case 'invalidDueDate':
+    case 'invalidDueInstant':
+      return 'due';
+    case 'invalidDueTimeZone':
+      return 'timeZone';
+    default:
+      return 'form';
+  }
+}
+
+export interface TaskBuildResult {
+  /** Filled only when there are no errors. */
+  fields: TaskFields | null;
+  errors: TaskFieldErrors;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks the text of the form and builds the fields of the task. Our own checks (a missing date,
+ * a bad link) run first, then the rules of the core run over the finished item, so the form and
+ * the stored data never disagree. Each field keeps only its first message.
+ */
+export function buildTaskFields(
+  values: TaskFormValues,
+  displayTimeZone: string,
+  base: { agendaId: Id; parentId?: Id | null; existing?: Item },
+): TaskBuildResult {
+  const built = buildDue(values, displayTimeZone);
+  const errors: TaskFieldErrors = { ...built.errors };
+  const links = buildLinks(values.links);
+  if (!links.valid) errors.links = 'linkInvalid';
+
+  const fields: TaskFields = {
+    title: values.title.trim(),
+    notes: values.notes,
+    statusId: values.statusId === '' ? null : values.statusId,
+    from: values.from === '' ? null : values.from,
+    due: built.due,
+    location: values.location.trim(),
+    links: links.links,
+    tagIds: [...new Set(values.tagIds)],
+    inheritTags: values.inheritTags,
+  };
+
+  const fresh = createItem({
+    kind: 'task',
+    title: '',
+    agendaId: base.agendaId,
+    parentId: base.parentId ?? null,
+  });
+  const draft: Item = { ...(base.existing ?? fresh), ...fields };
+  for (const issue of validateItem(draft, displayTimeZone)) {
+    const key = fieldOf(issue);
+    if (!errors[key]) errors[key] = issue;
+  }
+
+  return Object.keys(errors).length > 0 ? { fields: null, errors } : { fields, errors };
+}

+export const THEME_MODES = ['auto', 'light', 'dark'] as const;
+
+export type ThemeMode = (typeof THEME_MODES)[number];
+
+export const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'unified-agenda:theme';
+
+export const DEFAULT_THEME_MODE: ThemeMode = 'auto';
+
+export function isThemeMode(value: unknown): value is ThemeMode {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && (THEME_MODES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
+}
+
+export function parseThemeMode(value: unknown): ThemeMode {
+  return isThemeMode(value) ? value : DEFAULT_THEME_MODE;
+}
+
+// Auto follows the device. Light and dark are explicit choices that win over the device.
+export function applyThemeMode(mode: ThemeMode, root: HTMLElement = document.documentElement) {
+  if (mode === 'auto') {
+    delete root.dataset.theme;
+  } else {
+    root.dataset.theme = mode;
+  }
+}
+
+export function readStoredThemeMode(): ThemeMode {
+  try {
+    return parseThemeMode(localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY));
+  } catch {
+    return DEFAULT_THEME_MODE;
+  }
+}
+
+export function storeThemeMode(mode: ThemeMode) {
+  try {
+    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, mode);
+  } catch {
+    // Storage can be blocked. The choice then lasts only for this visit.
+  }
+}

+import { isValidDueWithin, type ItemFilter, type PeriodFilter } from '../filters';
+
+/** The order of the "when" chips: the four day periods, then what has no set time. */
+export const PERIOD_CHIPS: readonly PeriodFilter[] = [
+  'dawn',
+  'morning',
+  'afternoon',
+  'evening',
+  'untimed',
+];
+
+/** Adds the value to the list, or takes it off, keeping the rest of the list as it was. */
+export function toggleValue<T>(list: readonly T[], value: T, on: boolean): T[] {
+  const without = list.filter((existing) => existing !== value);
+  return on ? [...without, value] : without;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads the "due within" field. Only whole days written with digits count (zero is allowed, and
+ * means only on the delivery day). Empty, negative, decimal or any other text turns the limit off.
+ */
+export function parseDueWithin(text: string): number | null {
+  const trimmed = text.trim();
+  return /^\d{1,4}$/.test(trimmed) ? Number(trimmed) : null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * How many sieves are on (tags, type, when, text, due limit and the agenda selection each count
+ * once). Pass `agendasOn` when some agenda is hidden.
+ */
+export function activeFilterCount(filter: ItemFilter, agendasOn = false): number {
+  return [
+    agendasOn,
+    filter.tagIds.length > 0,
+    filter.kinds.length > 0,
+    filter.periods.length > 0,
+    filter.text.trim() !== '',
+    isValidDueWithin(filter.dueWithinDays),
+  ].filter(Boolean).length;
+}

+import { msToTimestamp, type OpenTask, type TimelineEntry } from '../core';
+import { formatDate, formatTime } from './format';
+import type { Messages } from './i18n/messages/en';
+
+/*
+ * Texts of the Timeline rows, without React. Each function takes the language texts as a
+ * parameter, so the screen and the tests use the same code.
+ */
+
+type TimelineTexts = Messages['timeline'];
+
+/**
+ * The time column of an entry. A whole-day item says so. A timed item shows its hours inside this
+ * day: a range, only the start (a point in time), "From" when it goes on after midnight, "Until"
+ * when it began the day before, or "Throughout the day" when it covers the whole day.
+ * `rangeTemplate` has `{start}` and `{end}` (the `items.range` text), so each language writes
+ * its own "to".
+ */
+export function entryTimeText(
+  locale: string,
+  entry: TimelineEntry,
+  zone: string,
+  texts: TimelineTexts,
+  rangeTemplate: string,
+): string {
+  if (entry.type === 'allDay') return texts.allDay;
+
+  const start = formatTime(locale, msToTimestamp(entry.startMs!), zone);
+  const end = formatTime(locale, msToTimestamp(entry.endMs!), zone);
+
+  if (entry.continuesFromPrevious && entry.continuesToNext) return texts.throughoutDay;
+  if (entry.continuesFromPrevious) return texts.until.replace('{time}', end);
+  if (entry.continuesToNext) return texts.fromTime.replace('{time}', start);
+  if (entry.endMs === entry.startMs) return start;
+  return rangeTemplate.replace('{start}', start).replace('{end}', end);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The delivery of an open task. On its delivery day it says "this day" or the hour. On the other
+ * days of its window it names the day of the delivery. The hour is read in the display zone.
+ */
+export function openTaskDueText(
+  locale: string,
+  open: OpenTask,
+  zone: string,
+  texts: TimelineTexts,
+): string {
+  if (!open.isDueDay) return texts.dueOn.replace('{date}', formatDate(locale, open.dueDate));
+  const due = open.item.due!;
+  return due.allDay
+    ? texts.dueDay
+    : texts.dueAt.replace('{time}', formatTime(locale, due.at, zone));
+}

+import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
+import { applyThemeMode, readStoredThemeMode, storeThemeMode, type ThemeMode } from './theme';
+
+export function useThemeMode() {
+  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>(readStoredThemeMode);
+
+  const setMode = useCallback((next: ThemeMode) => {
+    setModeState(next);
+    applyThemeMode(next);
+    storeThemeMode(next);
+  }, []);
+
+  return { mode, setMode };
+}

diff --git a/tests/core/dayPeriod.test.ts b/tests/core/dayPeriod.test.ts

+import {
+  isValidPeriodBounds,
+  periodsOfSchedule,
+  periodsOnDate,
+  zonedTimeToMs,
+  type PlainDate,
+  type Schedule,
+} from '../../src/core';
+
+const SP = 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+
+function timed(
+  date: PlainDate,
+  from: [number, number],
+  endDate: PlainDate,
+  to: [number, number] | null,
+  zone = SP,
+): Schedule {
+  const start = new Date(zonedTimeToMs(date, from[0], from[1], zone)).toISOString();
+  const end = to ? new Date(zonedTimeToMs(endDate, to[0], to[1], zone)).toISOString() : undefined;
+  return { allDay: false, start, ...(end ? { end } : {}) };
+}
+
+describe('day periods', () => {
+  it('puts a point in time in one period, boundaries starting a period', () => {
+    const at = (h: number, m = 0) => periodsOfSchedule(timed('2026-11-07', [h, m], '', null), SP);
+    expect(at(0)).toEqual(['dawn']);
+    expect(at(5, 59)).toEqual(['dawn']);
+    expect(at(6)).toEqual(['morning']);
+    expect(at(12)).toEqual(['afternoon']);
+    expect(at(18)).toEqual(['evening']);
+    expect(at(23, 59)).toEqual(['evening']);
+  });
+
+  it('puts an item in every period it overlaps', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [11, 0], '2026-11-07', [14, 0]);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['morning', 'afternoon']);
+  });
+
+  it('does not enter a period the item ends exactly at', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [11, 0], '2026-11-07', [12, 0]);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['morning']);
+  });
+
+  it('covers a long item', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [0, 0], '2026-11-07', [23, 59]);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening']);
+  });
+
+  it('splits an overnight item across the two days', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [22, 0], '2026-11-08', [7, 0]);
+    expect(periodsOnDate(item, '2026-11-07', SP)).toEqual(['evening']);
+    expect(periodsOnDate(item, '2026-11-08', SP)).toEqual(['dawn', 'morning']);
+    expect(periodsOnDate(item, '2026-11-09', SP)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['dawn', 'morning', 'evening']);
+  });
+
+  it('depends on the zone shown, not on the zone it was made in', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [14, 0], '', null, SP); // 17:00 UTC
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['afternoon']);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, 'Asia/Tokyo')).toEqual(['dawn']); // 02:00 next day
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, 'America/New_York')).toEqual(['afternoon']); // 12:00
+  });
+
+  it('has no period for whole-day or unscheduled items', () => {
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07' }, SP)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(null, SP)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('uses custom bounds', () => {
+    const bounds = { morningStart: 5, afternoonStart: 13, eveningStart: 19 };
+    const item = timed('2026-11-07', [12, 30], '', null);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP)).toEqual(['afternoon']);
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, SP, bounds)).toEqual(['morning']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the periods right on a 23 hour day', () => {
+    const item = timed('2026-03-08', [12, 0], '', null, 'America/New_York');
+    expect(periodsOfSchedule(item, 'America/New_York')).toEqual(['afternoon']);
+  });
+
+  it('validates bounds', () => {
+    expect(isValidPeriodBounds({ morningStart: 6, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 18 })).toBe(
+      true,
+    );
+    expect(isValidPeriodBounds({ morningStart: 12, afternoonStart: 6, eveningStart: 18 })).toBe(
+      false,
+    );
+    expect(isValidPeriodBounds({ morningStart: 0, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 18 })).toBe(
+      false,
+    );
+    expect(isValidPeriodBounds({ morningStart: 6, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 24 })).toBe(
+      false,
+    );
+    expect(isValidPeriodBounds({ morningStart: 6.5, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 18 })).toBe(
+      false,
+    );
+  });
+});

+import { createStatus, createStatusGroup, type Context } from '../../src/core';
+import type { Status, StatusGroup } from '../../src/core';
+
+/** A fixed clock and predictable ids (id-1, id-2, ...), so results can be compared exactly. */
+export function testContext(
+  startMs = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 12, 0, 0),
+): Context & { tick: () => void } {
+  let counter = 0;
+  let nowMs = startMs;
+  return {
+    now: () => new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
+    newId: () => `id-${++counter}`,
+    tick: () => {
+      nowMs += 1000;
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+export function testStatuses(ctx: Context): {
+  groups: StatusGroup[];
+  planned: Status;
+  started: Status;
+  done: Status;
+} {
+  const plannedGroup = createStatusGroup({ name: 'Planned', role: 'planned' }, ctx);
+  const startedGroup = createStatusGroup({ name: 'Started', role: 'started' }, ctx);
+  const doneGroup = createStatusGroup({ name: 'Done', role: 'done' }, ctx);
+  return {
+    groups: [plannedGroup, startedGroup, doneGroup],
+    planned: createStatus({ name: 'Scheduled', groupId: plannedGroup.id }, ctx),
+    started: createStatus({ name: 'In progress', groupId: startedGroup.id }, ctx),
+    done: createStatus({ name: 'Done', groupId: doneGroup.id }, ctx),
+  };
+}

+import { moveStep } from '../../src/core';
+
+const entry = (id: string, order: number) => ({ id, order });
+
+describe('moveStep', () => {
+  const list = [entry('a', 0), entry('b', 1), entry('c', 2)];
+
+  it('swaps an entry with the one above and renumbers only what changed', () => {
+    expect(moveStep(list, 'b', -1)).toEqual([
+      { id: 'b', order: 0 },
+      { id: 'a', order: 1 },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('swaps an entry with the one below', () => {
+    expect(moveStep(list, 'b', 1)).toEqual([
+      { id: 'c', order: 1 },
+      { id: 'b', order: 2 },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing at either end or for an unknown id', () => {
+    expect(moveStep(list, 'a', -1)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(moveStep(list, 'c', 1)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(moveStep(list, 'zzz', 1)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('repairs entries that share the same order', () => {
+    const tied = [entry('a', 0), entry('b', 0), entry('c', 0)];
+    expect(moveStep(tied, 'b', 1)).toEqual([
+      { id: 'c', order: 1 },
+      { id: 'b', order: 2 },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('numbers from zero even when the orders have gaps', () => {
+    const gaps = [entry('a', 4), entry('b', 9)];
+    expect(moveStep(gaps, 'b', -1)).toEqual([
+      { id: 'b', order: 0 },
+      { id: 'a', order: 1 },
+    ]);
+  });
+});

+    expect(isPlainDate('2026-11-07')).toBe(true);

+    expect(isPlainDate('2026-02-29')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isPlainDate('2026-13-01')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isPlainDate('2026-1-1')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isPlainDate(20261107)).toBe(false);

+    expect(addDays('2028-02-28', 1)).toBe('2028-02-29');
+    expect(addDays('2026-03-01', -1)).toBe('2026-02-28');
+  });
+

+    expect(daysBetween('2026-11-07', '2026-11-10')).toBe(3);
+    expect(daysBetween('2026-11-10', '2026-11-07')).toBe(-3);
+    expect(comparePlainDates('2026-11-07', '2026-11-08')).toBe(-1);
+    expect(comparePlainDates('2026-11-07', '2026-11-07')).toBe(0);
+  });

+import {
+  computeProgress,
+  createItem,
+  defaultDoneStatusId,
+  doneStatusIds,
+  softDelete,
+  type Item,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import { testContext, testStatuses } from './helpers';
+
+function setup() {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const s = testStatuses(ctx);
+  const statuses = [s.planned, s.started, s.done];
+  const done = doneStatusIds(statuses, s.groups);
+  const task = (title: string, parentId: string | null, statusId: string | null) =>
+    createItem({ kind: 'task', title, agendaId: 'a', parentId, statusId }, ctx);
+  const event = (title: string, parentId: string | null = null) =>
+    createItem({ kind: 'event', title, agendaId: 'a', parentId }, ctx);
+  return { ctx, s, done, task, event };
+}
+
+describe('progress', () => {
+  it('finds the statuses that count as done', () => {
+    const { s, done } = setup();
+    expect(done).toEqual(new Set([s.done.id]));
+  });
+
+  it('treats a lone task as 1 of 1 or 0 of 1', () => {
+    const { s, done, task } = setup();
+    const open = task('open', null, s.started.id);
+    const finished = task('finished', null, s.done.id);
+    const result = computeProgress([open, finished], done);
+    expect(result.get(open.id)).toEqual({ completed: 0, total: 1, ratio: 0 });
+    expect(result.get(finished.id)).toEqual({ completed: 1, total: 1, ratio: 1 });
+  });
+
+  it('computes a parent from its children and ignores the parent status', () => {
+    const { s, done, task } = setup();
+    const parent = task('parent', null, s.done.id);
+    const kids = [
+      task('1', parent.id, s.done.id),
+      task('2', parent.id, s.planned.id),
+      task('3', parent.id, s.done.id),
+      task('4', parent.id, null),
+    ];
+    const result = computeProgress([parent, ...kids], done);
+    expect(result.get(parent.id)).toEqual({ completed: 2, total: 4, ratio: 0.5 });
+  });
+
+  it('is recursive, counting leaves at any depth', () => {
+    const { s, done, task } = setup();
+    const root = task('root', null, null);
+    const a = task('a', root.id, null);
+    const a1 = task('a1', a.id, s.done.id);
+    const a2 = task('a2', a.id, s.done.id);
+    const b = task('b', root.id, s.planned.id);
+    const result = computeProgress([root, a, a1, a2, b], done);
+    expect(result.get(a.id)).toEqual({ completed: 2, total: 2, ratio: 1 });
+    expect(result.get(root.id)).toEqual({ completed: 2, total: 3, ratio: 2 / 3 });
+  });
+
+  it('ignores events, but counts tasks inside them', () => {
+    const { s, done, task, event } = setup();
+    const lone = event('lone event');
+    const holder = event('holder');
+    const inside = task('inside', holder.id, s.done.id);
+    const noTasks = event('child event', lone.id);
+    const result = computeProgress([lone, noTasks, holder, inside], done);
+    expect(result.has(lone.id)).toBe(false);
+    expect(result.has(noTasks.id)).toBe(false);
+    expect(result.get(holder.id)).toEqual({ completed: 1, total: 1, ratio: 1 });
+  });
+
+  it('falls back to the own status when children are only events', () => {
+    const { s, done, task, event } = setup();
+    const parent = task('parent', null, s.done.id);
+    const child = event('child', parent.id);
+    expect(computeProgress([parent, child], done).get(parent.id)?.ratio).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores deleted items', () => {
+    const { ctx, s, done, task } = setup();
+    const parent = task('parent', null, null);
+    const kept = task('kept', parent.id, s.done.id);
+    const removed = softDelete(task('removed', parent.id, s.planned.id), ctx);
+    const result = computeProgress([parent, kept, removed], done);
+    expect(result.get(parent.id)).toEqual({ completed: 1, total: 1, ratio: 1 });
+    expect(result.has(removed.id)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('handles a very deep tree without overflowing the stack', () => {
+    const { s, done, task } = setup();
+    const items: Item[] = [];
+    let parentId: string | null = null;
+    for (let i = 0; i < 20_000; i++) {
+      const node = task(`n${i}`, parentId, i === 19_999 ? s.done.id : null);
+      items.push(node);
+      parentId = node.id;
+    }
+    const result = computeProgress(items, done);
+    expect(result.get(items[0]!.id)).toEqual({ completed: 1, total: 1, ratio: 1 });
+  });
+
+  it('does not hang on a cycle', () => {
+    const { s, done, task } = setup();
+    const a = task('a', null, s.done.id);
+    const b = task('b', a.id, s.done.id);
+    const cyclic = { ...a, parentId: b.id };
+    expect(() => computeProgress([cyclic, b], done)).not.toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it('picks the first status of the done group as the one a finished task gets', () => {
+    const { s } = setup();
+    const statuses = [s.planned, s.started, s.done];
+    expect(defaultDoneStatusId(statuses, s.groups)).toBe(s.done.id);
+  });
+
+  it('skips deleted done statuses and returns null when none is left', () => {
+    const { ctx, s } = setup();
+    const extra = { ...s.done, id: 'extra', order: 5 };
+    expect(defaultDoneStatusId([s.planned, softDelete(s.done, ctx), extra], s.groups)).toBe(
+      'extra',
+    );
+    expect(defaultDoneStatusId([s.planned, softDelete(s.done, ctx)], s.groups)).toBeNull();
+    expect(defaultDoneStatusId([s.planned, s.started], s.groups)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('uses the lowest order inside the done group', () => {
+    const { s } = setup();
+    const later = { ...s.done, id: 'later', order: 3 };
+    const sooner = { ...s.done, id: 'sooner', order: 1 };
+    expect(defaultDoneStatusId([later, sooner], s.groups)).toBe('sooner');
+  });
+});

+import { createSavedView, EMPTY_SAVED_FILTER, SAVED_VIEW_LAYOUTS } from '../../src/core';

+      id: 'id-1',
+      name: 'All',
+      order: 0,

+    const agendaIds = ['a1', 'a2'];

+  });

+import {
+  createItem,
+  createTag,
+  effectiveScope,
+  effectiveTagIds,
+  indexById,
+  inheritedTags,
+  normalizeTagScopes,
+  shouldOfferGlobal,
+  softDelete,
+  tagWithDescendantIds,
+  tagsForAgenda,
+  tagsForFilter,
+  tagsLostByMoving,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import { testContext } from './helpers';
+
+function setup() {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const mk = (name: string, parentId: string | null = null, agendaIds: string[] = []) =>
+    createTag({ name, color: '#3b5bdb', parentId, agendaIds }, ctx);
+  return { ctx, mk };
+}
+
+describe('tag scope', () => {
+  it('treats an empty list as global', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const t = mk('global');
+    expect(effectiveScope(t.id, indexById([t]))).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('inherits the parent scope when the child is global', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a', 'b']);
+    const child = mk('child', parent.id);
+    expect(effectiveScope(child.id, indexById([parent, child]))).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
+  });
+
+  it('never lets a child be wider than the parent', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a', 'b']);
+    const child = mk('child', parent.id, ['b', 'c']);
+    const grand = mk('grand', child.id, ['a', 'b']);
+    const byId = indexById([parent, child, grand]);
+    expect(effectiveScope(child.id, byId)).toEqual(['b']);
+    expect(effectiveScope(grand.id, byId)).toEqual(['b']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('normalizeTagScopes', () => {
+  it('changes nothing when every child already fits', () => {
+    const { ctx, mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a', 'b']);
+    const child = mk('child', parent.id, ['a']);
+    const { changed, changes } = normalizeTagScopes([parent, child], ctx);
+    expect(changed).toEqual([]);
+    expect(changes).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('narrows children after the parent is restricted and reports each change', () => {
+    const { ctx, mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a']);
+    const globalChild = mk('global child', parent.id);
+    const partial = mk('partial', parent.id, ['a', 'b']);
+    const outside = mk('outside', parent.id, ['c']);
+    const grand = mk('grand', globalChild.id);
+
+    const { changed, changes } = normalizeTagScopes(
+      [grand, outside, partial, globalChild, parent],
+      ctx,
+    );
+
+    const after = Object.fromEntries(changes.map((c) => [c.tagId, c.after]));
+    expect(after[globalChild.id]).toEqual(['a']);
+    expect(after[partial.id]).toEqual(['a']);
+    expect(after[outside.id]).toEqual(['a']);
+    expect(after[grand.id]).toEqual(['a']);
+    expect(changes.find((c) => c.tagId === partial.id)?.before).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
+    expect(changed).toHaveLength(4);
+    expect(changed.every((t) => t.agendaIds.length === 1)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('does not touch the input and ignores deleted tags', () => {
+    const { ctx, mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a']);
+    const child = mk('child', parent.id);
+    const gone = softDelete(mk('gone', parent.id), ctx);
+    const { changed } = normalizeTagScopes([parent, child, gone], ctx);
+    expect(child.agendaIds).toEqual([]);
+    expect(changed.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual([child.id]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('tags for an agenda', () => {
+  it('offers global tags plus the ones restricted to that agenda', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const global = mk('global');
+    const onlyA = mk('only a', null, ['a']);
+    const onlyB = mk('only b', null, ['b']);
+    const names = tagsForAgenda([global, onlyA, onlyB], 'a').map((t) => t.name);
+    expect(names).toEqual(['global', 'only a']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('tags for a filter', () => {
+  it('shows tags valid in at least one selected agenda and flags the partial ones', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const global = mk('global');
+    const onlyA = mk('only a', null, ['a']);
+    const aAndB = mk('a and b', null, ['a', 'b']);
+    const onlyC = mk('only c', null, ['c']);
+    const result = tagsForFilter([global, onlyA, aAndB, onlyC], ['a', 'b']);
+    const view = Object.fromEntries(result.map((r) => [r.tag.name, r.partial]));
+    expect(view).toEqual({ global: false, 'only a': true, 'a and b': false });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('tag filtering and moving', () => {
+  it('includes descendants of a parent and only itself for a leaf', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const root = mk('root');
+    const mid = mk('mid', root.id);
+    const leaf = mk('leaf', mid.id);
+    const other = mk('other');
+    const all = [root, mid, leaf, other];
+    expect(tagWithDescendantIds(root.id, all)).toEqual(new Set([root.id, mid.id, leaf.id]));
+    expect(tagWithDescendantIds(leaf.id, all)).toEqual(new Set([leaf.id]));
+  });
+
+  it('lists the tags an item would lose by moving to another agenda', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const global = mk('global');
+    const onlyA = mk('only a', null, ['a']);
+    const lost = tagsLostByMoving([global.id, onlyA.id], 'b', [global, onlyA]);
+    expect(lost.map((t) => t.name)).toEqual(['only a']);
+    expect(tagsLostByMoving([global.id, onlyA.id], 'a', [global, onlyA])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('offers to make a tag global when it covers every agenda', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const covers = mk('covers', null, ['a', 'b']);
+    const partial = mk('partial', null, ['a']);
+    const global = mk('global');
+    const all = [covers, partial, global];
+    expect(shouldOfferGlobal(covers, all, ['a', 'b'])).toBe(true);
+    expect(shouldOfferGlobal(partial, all, ['a', 'b'])).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldOfferGlobal(global, all, ['a', 'b'])).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldOfferGlobal(covers, all, [])).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('does not offer global under a restricted parent', () => {
+    const { mk } = setup();
+    const parent = mk('parent', null, ['a']);
+    const child = mk('child', parent.id, ['a']);
+    expect(shouldOfferGlobal(child, [parent, child], ['a'])).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('inherited tags', () => {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const make = (title: string, extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]> = {}) =>
+    createItem({ kind: 'task', title, agendaId: 'a', ...extra }, ctx);
+
+  it('an item gets the tags of its parent and grandparent, with the source', () => {
+    const top = make('Top', { tagIds: ['work'] });
+    const middle = make('Middle', { parentId: top.id, tagIds: ['urgent'] });
+    const leaf = make('Leaf', { parentId: middle.id });
+    const byId = indexById([top, middle, leaf]);
+    expect(inheritedTags(leaf, byId)).toEqual([
+      { tagId: 'urgent', fromItemId: middle.id },
+      { tagId: 'work', fromItemId: top.id },
+    ]);
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(leaf, byId)).toEqual(['urgent', 'work']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the own tags first and does not repeat a tag', () => {
+    const top = make('Top', { tagIds: ['work', 'urgent'] });
+    const child = make('Child', { parentId: top.id, tagIds: ['urgent', 'home'] });
+    const byId = indexById([top, child]);
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(child, byId)).toEqual(['urgent', 'home', 'work']);
+    expect(inheritedTags(child, byId)).toEqual([{ tagId: 'work', fromItemId: top.id }]);
+  });
+
+  it('stops at an item whose switch is off', () => {
+    const top = make('Top', { tagIds: ['work'] });
+    const off = make('Off', { parentId: top.id, inheritTags: false, tagIds: ['home'] });
+    const leaf = make('Leaf', { parentId: off.id });
+    const byId = indexById([top, off, leaf]);
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(off, byId)).toEqual(['home']);
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(leaf, byId)).toEqual(['home']);
+  });
+
+  it('a top item, a missing parent and a deleted parent inherit nothing', () => {
+    const top = make('Top', { tagIds: ['work'] });
+    const orphan = make('Orphan', { parentId: 'gone' });
+    const child = make('Child', { parentId: top.id });
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(top, indexById([top]))).toEqual(['work']);
+    expect(inheritedTags(orphan, indexById([orphan]))).toEqual([]);
+    expect(inheritedTags(child, indexById([softDelete(top, ctx), child]))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('does not loop on corrupted data', () => {
+    const a = make('A', { tagIds: ['x'] });
+    const b = make('B', { parentId: a.id });
+    const looped = { ...a, parentId: b.id };
+    expect(effectiveTagIds(b, indexById([looped, b]))).toEqual(['x']);
+  });
+});

+import { createItem, descendantIds, softDelete, wouldCreateCycle, type Item } from '../../src/core';
+import { testContext } from './helpers';
+
+function tree() {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const mk = (title: string, parentId: string | null = null, order = 0) =>
+    createItem({ kind: 'task', title, agendaId: 'a', parentId, order }, ctx);
+  const root = mk('root');
+  const a = mk('a', root.id, 1);
+  const b = mk('b', root.id, 0);
+  const a1 = mk('a1', a.id);
+  const a11 = mk('a11', a1.id);
+  return { ctx, root, a, b, a1, a11, all: [root, a, b, a1, a11] };
+}
+
+describe('tree helpers', () => {
+  it('finds descendants at any depth', () => {
+    const { root, a, b, a1, a11, all } = tree();
+    expect(descendantIds(root.id, all)).toEqual(new Set([a.id, b.id, a1.id, a11.id]));
+    expect(descendantIds(a.id, all)).toEqual(new Set([a1.id, a11.id]));
+    expect(descendantIds(b.id, all)).toEqual(new Set());
+  });
+
+  it('skips deleted items', () => {
+    const { ctx, root, a, all } = tree();
+    const withDeleted = all.map((item) => (item.id === a.id ? softDelete(item, ctx) : item));
+    expect(descendantIds(root.id, withDeleted).has(a.id)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('detects a move that would create a cycle', () => {
+    const { root, a, a11, b, all } = tree();
+    expect(wouldCreateCycle(a.id, a.id, all)).toBe(true);
+    expect(wouldCreateCycle(a.id, a11.id, all)).toBe(true);
+    expect(wouldCreateCycle(root.id, null, all)).toBe(false);
+    expect(wouldCreateCycle(a.id, b.id, all)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('does not hang on data that already has a cycle', () => {
+    const { a, a11, all } = tree();
+    const broken: Item[] = all.map((item) =>
+      item.id === a.id ? { ...item, parentId: a11.id } : item,
+    );
+    expect(descendantIds(a.id, broken).size).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  });
+});
