+import { createItem, validateDue, validateItem, validateSchedule } from '../../src/core';
+import { testContext } from './helpers';
+
+const make = (over: Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]) => createItem(over, testContext());
+
+describe('item validation', () => {
+  it('accepts a good task', () => {
+    const item = make({ kind: 'task', title: 'Read', agendaId: 'a', statusId: 's' });
+    expect(validateItem(item)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('requires a title and, for tasks, a status', () => {
+    expect(validateItem(make({ kind: 'task', title: '  ', agendaId: 'a' }))).toEqual([
+      'titleRequired',
+      'taskNeedsStatus',
+    ]);
+    expect(validateItem(make({ kind: 'event', title: 'Class', agendaId: 'a' }))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('rejects a parent that is the item itself', () => {
+    const item = make({ kind: 'event', title: 'x', agendaId: 'a' });
+    expect(validateItem({ ...item, parentId: item.id })).toEqual(['parentIsSelf']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('schedule validation', () => {
+  it('checks whole-day schedules', () => {
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07' })).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07', end: '2026-11-09' })).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: true, start: '2026-02-30' })).toEqual(['invalidDate']);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09', end: '2026-11-07' })).toEqual([
+      'endBeforeStart',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('checks timed schedules', () => {
+    const start = '2026-11-07T12:00:00.000Z';
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: false, start })).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: false, start, end: '2026-11-07T11:00:00.000Z' })).toEqual([
+      'endBeforeStart',
+    ]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: false, start: '2026-11-07 12:00' })).toEqual([
+      'invalidInstant',
+    ]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: false, start, timeZone: 'Nowhere/Land' })).toEqual([
+      'invalidTimeZone',
+    ]);
+    expect(validateSchedule({ allDay: false, start, timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon' })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('task window validation', () => {
+  const task = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]>) =>
+    make({ kind: 'task', title: 'Paper', agendaId: 'a', statusId: 's', ...over });
+  const due = { allDay: true as const, date: '2026-11-24' };
+
+  it('accepts a start with a due date, and a due date alone', () => {
+    expect(validateItem(task({ from: '2026-11-03', due }))).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateItem(task({ due }))).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateItem(task({ from: '2026-11-24', due }))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('rejects a start after the due day', () => {
+    expect(validateItem(task({ from: '2026-11-25', due }))).toEqual(['fromAfterDue']);
+  });
+
+  it('rejects a start with no due date', () => {
+    expect(validateItem(task({ from: '2026-11-03' }))).toEqual(['fromNeedsDue']);
+  });
+
+  it('rejects impossible dates', () => {
+    expect(validateItem(task({ from: '2026-02-30', due }))).toEqual(['invalidFromDate']);
+    expect(validateItem(task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-13-01' } }))).toEqual([
+      'invalidDueDate',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('compares a start with a timed delivery in the display zone', () => {
+    const timed = { allDay: false as const, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z' };
+    const item = task({ from: '2026-11-25', due: timed });
+    expect(validateItem(item, 'America/Sao_Paulo')).toEqual(['fromAfterDue']);
+    expect(validateItem(item, 'Europe/Lisbon')).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateItem(item)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('checks a timed delivery', () => {
+    expect(validateDue({ allDay: false, at: '2026-11-25 23:59' })).toEqual(['invalidDueInstant']);
+    expect(
+      validateDue({ allDay: false, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z', timeZone: 'Nowhere/Land' }),
+    ).toEqual(['invalidDueTimeZone']);
+    expect(
+      validateDue({ allDay: false, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z', timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' }),
+    ).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps schedule for events and the window for tasks', () => {
+    const schedule = { allDay: true as const, start: '2026-11-10' };
+    expect(validateItem(task({ schedule, due }))).toEqual(['taskCannotHaveSchedule']);
+    expect(validateItem(make({ kind: 'event', title: 'Class', agendaId: 'a', due }))).toEqual([
+      'eventCannotHaveWindow',
+    ]);
+    expect(
+      validateItem(make({ kind: 'event', title: 'Class', agendaId: 'a', from: '2026-11-03' })),
+    ).toEqual(['eventCannotHaveWindow', 'fromNeedsDue']);
+  });
+});

+import {

+const LISBON = 'Europe/Lisbon';
+
+/** The test clock starts on 2026-11-07 12:00 UTC, which is 09:00 on the same day in Sao Paulo. */
+function task(over: Partial<Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]> = {}, ctx: Context = testContext()) {
+  return createItem({ kind: 'task', title: 'Paper', agendaId: 'a', statusId: 's', ...over }, ctx);
+}
+
+describe('task window', () => {
+  it('runs from the start day to the due day', () => {

+    expect(taskWindow(item, SP)).toEqual({ from: '2026-11-03', due: '2026-11-24' });
+  });
+
+  it('starts on the creation day when there is no start', () => {
+    const item = task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' } });
+    expect(taskWindow(item, SP)).toEqual({ from: '2026-11-07', due: '2026-11-24' });
+  });
+
+  it('follows the display zone for the creation day', () => {

+    const item = task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' } });
+    expect(taskWindow(item, 'Pacific/Kiritimati')?.from).toBe('2026-11-08');
+  });
+
+  it('is only the due day for a task created after its delivery', () => {
+    const item = task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-02' } });
+    expect(taskWindow(item, SP)).toEqual({ from: '2026-11-02', due: '2026-11-02' });
+  });
+
+  it('is empty for events and for tasks with no delivery', () => {
+    expect(taskWindow(task(), SP)).toBeNull();
+    const event = task({ kind: 'event' });
+    expect(taskWindow(event, SP)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('puts a timed delivery on its day in the display zone', () => {
+    // 23:59 in Sao Paulo on the 24th is 02:59 UTC on the 25th
+    const due = { allDay: false as const, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z' };
+    expect(dueDate(due, SP)).toBe('2026-11-24');

+    expect(dueDate({ allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' }, 'Asia/Tokyo')).toBe('2026-11-24');

+
+  it('includes both ends and nothing outside', () => {

+    expect(isInWindow(item, '2026-11-02', SP)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isInWindow(item, '2026-11-03', SP)).toBe(true);

+    expect(isInWindow(item, '2026-11-25', SP)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isInWindow(task(), '2026-11-15', SP)).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('past due', () => {
+  it('treats a whole-day delivery as late only after its day is over', () => {
+    const due = { allDay: true as const, date: '2026-11-24' };
+    expect(isPastDue(due, '2026-11-24T20:00:00.000Z', SP)).toBe(false);
+    // 03:00 UTC on the 25th is midnight on the 25th in Sao Paulo
+    expect(isPastDue(due, '2026-11-25T03:00:00.000Z', SP)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isPastDue(due, '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z', SP)).toBe(false);
+  });

+  it('treats a timed delivery as late right after its time', () => {

+    expect(isPastDue(due, '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z', SP)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isPastDue(due, '2026-11-25T03:00:00.000Z', SP)).toBe(true);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('pending and overdue lists', () => {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const open = task(
+    {
+      title: 'Open',
+      from: '2026-11-03',
+      due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' },

+      title: 'Done',
+      from: '2026-11-03',
+      due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' },

+  );

+      title: 'Class',
+      agendaId: 'a',
+      schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-10' },
+    },
+    ctx,
+  );
+  const removed: Item = {
+    ...task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' } }, ctx),
+    deletedAt: 'x',
+  };
+  const items = [open, finished, late, later, event, removed];
+  const doneIds = new Set(['ok']);
+
+  it('lists the open tasks of a day and skips done, deleted and events', () => {
+    expect(pendingOnDate(items, '2026-11-10', SP, doneIds).map((i) => i.title)).toEqual(['Open']);
+  });
+
+  it('shows a task on every day of its window and on no other day', () => {
+    expect(pendingOnDate(items, '2026-11-03', SP, doneIds)).toEqual([open]);
+    expect(pendingOnDate(items, '2026-11-25', SP, doneIds)).toEqual([]);
+  });

+  it('keeps a late task out of the pending days after its delivery', () => {
+    expect(pendingOnDate(items, '2026-11-06', SP, doneIds).map((i) => i.title)).toEqual(['Open']);
+  });
+

+      'Late',
+      'Open',
+    ]);
+    expect(overdueTasks(items, '2026-11-04T12:00:00.000Z', SP, doneIds)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+describe('work blocks', () => {
+  const ctx = testContext();
+  const parent = task({ due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' } }, ctx);

+        kind: 'event',
+        title: 'Work',
+        agendaId: 'a',

+        ...over,
+      },
+      ctx,
+    );

+    const elsewhere = block('2026-11-09T14:00:00.000Z', { parentId: 'other' });
+    const removed: Item = { ...block('2026-11-08T14:00:00.000Z'), deletedAt: 'x' };
+    const all = [parent, second, first, wholeDay, checklistTask, elsewhere, removed];
+    expect(workBlocks(parent, all)).toEqual([first, second]);
+  });
+});

+import {
+  getTimeZoneOffsetMinutes,
+  isValidTimeZone,
+  localDate,
+  resolveTimeZone,
+  startOfDayMs,
+  zonedTimeToMs,
+} from '../../src/core';
+
+const iso = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString();
+const SP = 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+const NY = 'America/New_York';
+
+describe('time zones', () => {
+  it('validates zone names', () => {
+    expect(isValidTimeZone(SP)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isValidTimeZone('UTC')).toBe(true);
+    expect(isValidTimeZone('Mars/Olympus')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isValidTimeZone('')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isValidTimeZone(null)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('reads offsets', () => {
+    const summer = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 4, 12);
+    expect(getTimeZoneOffsetMinutes(summer, SP)).toBe(-180);
+    expect(getTimeZoneOffsetMinutes(summer, NY)).toBe(-240);
+    expect(getTimeZoneOffsetMinutes(summer, 'Asia/Tokyo')).toBe(540);
+    expect(getTimeZoneOffsetMinutes(Date.UTC(2026, 0, 4, 12), NY)).toBe(-300);
+  });
+
+  it('gives a different calendar date for the same instant', () => {
+    const instant = Date.parse('2026-11-08T02:30:00Z');
+    expect(localDate(instant, SP)).toBe('2026-11-07');
+    expect(localDate(instant, 'Asia/Tokyo')).toBe('2026-11-08');
+    expect(localDate(instant, 'UTC')).toBe('2026-11-08');
+  });
+
+  it('converts a wall clock reading to an instant', () => {
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-11-07', 14, 0, SP))).toBe('2026-11-07T17:00:00.000Z');
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-07-04', 12, 0, NY))).toBe('2026-07-04T16:00:00.000Z');
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-01-04', 12, 0, NY))).toBe('2026-01-04T17:00:00.000Z');
+    expect(iso(startOfDayMs('2026-11-07', 'Asia/Tokyo'))).toBe('2026-11-06T15:00:00.000Z');
+  });
+
+  it('moves a reading that does not exist forward (clock jumps ahead)', () => {
+    // New York, 2026-03-08: 02:00 became 03:00, so 02:30 does not exist
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-03-08', 2, 30, NY))).toBe('2026-03-08T07:30:00.000Z');
+  });
+
+  it('picks the first occurrence of a repeated reading (clock goes back)', () => {
+    // New York, 2026-11-01: 01:30 happens twice. The first is still daylight time.
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-11-01', 1, 30, NY))).toBe('2026-11-01T05:30:00.000Z');
+  });
+
+  it('handles the right hour on both sides of a change', () => {
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-03-08', 4, 0, NY))).toBe('2026-03-08T08:00:00.000Z');
+    expect(iso(zonedTimeToMs('2026-03-08', 1, 0, NY))).toBe('2026-03-08T06:00:00.000Z');
+  });
+
+  it('has days of 23 and 25 hours when the clock changes', () => {
+    const hours = (a: string, b: string) => (startOfDayMs(b, NY) - startOfDayMs(a, NY)) / 3_600_000;
+    expect(hours('2026-03-08', '2026-03-09')).toBe(23);
+    expect(hours('2026-11-01', '2026-11-02')).toBe(25);
+    expect(hours('2026-06-01', '2026-06-02')).toBe(24);
+  });
+
+  it('resolves auto to the device zone and ignores unknown names', () => {
+    expect(resolveTimeZone('auto', SP)).toBe(SP);
+    expect(resolveTimeZone('Europe/Lisbon', SP)).toBe('Europe/Lisbon');
+    expect(resolveTimeZone('Nowhere/Land', SP)).toBe(SP);
+  });
+});

+import { buildTimelineDay, type Item, type OverdueEntry } from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  EMPTY_FILTER,
+  applyDayFilters,
+  applyOverdueFilter,
+  type ItemFilter,
+} from '../../src/filters';
+import { SP, event, task, titles } from './helpers';
+
+const none = new Set<string>();
+const filter = (changes: Partial<ItemFilter>): ItemFilter => ({ ...EMPTY_FILTER, ...changes });
+
+// São Paulo is UTC-3, so 09:00 there is 12:00Z
+const at = (hour: number, minute = 0) =>
+  new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, hour + 3, minute)).toISOString();
+
+function dayOf(items: Item[], date = '2026-11-09') {
+  return buildTimelineDay(items, date, SP, none);
+}
+const timedTitles = (day: ReturnType<typeof dayOf>) => day.timed.map((entry) => entry.item.title);
+
+describe('applyDayFilters: periods', () => {
+  const items = [
+    event('Dawn run', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(5), end: at(5, 45) } }),
+    event('Standup', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(9), end: at(9, 30) } }),
+    event('Lunch', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(12), end: at(13) } }),
+    event('Class', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(19), end: at(22) } }),
+    event('Holiday', { schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09' } }),
+    task('Paper', { due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' } }),
+  ];
+
+  it('returns the same day when no period is chosen', () => {
+    const day = dayOf(items);
+    expect(applyDayFilters(day, EMPTY_FILTER, SP)).toBe(day);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the timed events that touch a chosen period, and drops whole-day events', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['morning'] }), SP);
+    expect(timedTitles(day)).toEqual(['Standup']);
+    expect(day.allDay).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('several periods work as "any of them"', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['dawn', 'evening'] }), SP);
+    expect(timedTitles(day)).toEqual(['Dawn run', 'Class']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps an event that crosses periods in each one it touches', () => {
+    const long = [event('Workshop', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(11), end: at(14) } })];
+    const morning = applyDayFilters(dayOf(long), filter({ periods: ['morning'] }), SP);
+    const afternoon = applyDayFilters(dayOf(long), filter({ periods: ['afternoon'] }), SP);
+    const evening = applyDayFilters(dayOf(long), filter({ periods: ['evening'] }), SP);
+    expect([morning, afternoon, evening].map((d) => d.timed.length)).toEqual([1, 1, 0]);
+  });
+
+  it('hides the open tasks when only day periods are chosen', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['dawn'] }), SP);
+    expect(day.open).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('uses the period hours it is given', () => {
+    const bounds = { morningStart: 10, afternoonStart: 14, eveningStart: 20 };
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['dawn'] }), SP, bounds);
+    // With the morning starting at 10h, the 09:00 stand-up is dawn too
+    expect(timedTitles(day)).toEqual(['Dawn run', 'Standup']);
+  });
+
+  it('marks a day that lost everything as empty, so it can fold', () => {
+    const lonely = [event('Holiday', { schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09' } })];
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(lonely), filter({ periods: ['morning'] }), SP);
+    expect(day.empty).toBe(true);
+    expect(applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['morning'] }), SP).empty).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('applyDayFilters: untimed chip', () => {
+  const items = [
+    event('Standup', { schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(9), end: at(9, 30) } }),
+    event('Holiday', { schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09' } }),
+    task('Paper', { due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' } }),
+    task('Report at six', { due: { allDay: false, at: at(18) } }),
+  ];
+  const open = (day: ReturnType<typeof dayOf>) => titles(day.open.map((entry) => entry.item));
+
+  it('alone, keeps the whole-day events and the tasks, and drops the timed events', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['untimed'] }), SP);
+    expect(timedTitles(day)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(titles(day.allDay.map((entry) => entry.item))).toEqual(['Holiday']);
+    expect(open(day).sort()).toEqual(['Paper', 'Report at six']);
+  });
+
+  it('with a period, shows that period plus what has no set time', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['morning', 'untimed'] }), SP);
+    expect(timedTitles(day)).toEqual(['Standup']);
+    expect(day.allDay).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(day.open).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+
+  it('a task due at a time of day is still untimed', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ periods: ['evening'] }), SP);
+    expect(open(day)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('is empty when nothing combines, so the day can fold', () => {
+    const tasksOnly = [task('Paper', { due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' } })];
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(tasksOnly), filter({ periods: ['morning'] }), SP);
+    expect(day.empty).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('still lets the due within limit cut the tasks', () => {
+    const far = [task('Far', { due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-12-25' } })];
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(far), filter({ periods: ['untimed'], dueWithinDays: 3 }), SP);
+    expect(day.open).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('applyOverdueFilter', () => {
+  const entries: OverdueEntry[] = [{ item: task('Late'), dueDate: '2026-11-05', daysLate: 4 }];
+
+  it('keeps the strip when no chip is on or the untimed chip is on', () => {
+    expect(applyOverdueFilter(entries, EMPTY_FILTER)).toBe(entries);
+    expect(applyOverdueFilter(entries, filter({ periods: ['morning', 'untimed'] }))).toBe(entries);
+  });
+
+  it('hides the strip when only day periods are on', () => {
+    expect(applyOverdueFilter(entries, filter({ periods: ['morning'] }))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('is not cut by the due within limit', () => {
+    expect(applyOverdueFilter(entries, filter({ dueWithinDays: 0 }))).toBe(entries);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('applyDayFilters: due within', () => {
+  const items = [
+    task('Far', { from: '2026-10-01', due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-12-31' } }),
+    task('Near', { from: '2026-10-01', due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-12' } }),
+    task('Today', { from: '2026-10-01', due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' } }),
+    event('Class', { schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09' } }),
+  ];
+  const openTitles = (day: ReturnType<typeof dayOf>) => titles(day.open.map((o) => o.item));
+
+  it('hides a task until its delivery is within the limit, counted from the day shown', () => {
+    const nov9 = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ dueWithinDays: 3 }), SP);
+    expect(openTitles(nov9)).toEqual(['Today', 'Near']);
+    const nov10 = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items, '2026-11-10'), filter({ dueWithinDays: 1 }), SP);
+    // Near is 2 days away and Today is already overdue, so nothing is open
+    expect(openTitles(nov10)).toEqual([]);
+    const nov11 = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items, '2026-11-11'), filter({ dueWithinDays: 1 }), SP);
+    expect(openTitles(nov11)).toEqual(['Near']);
+  });
+
+  it('zero means only on the delivery day', () => {
+    const nov9 = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ dueWithinDays: 0 }), SP);
+    expect(openTitles(nov9)).toEqual(['Today']);
+  });
+
+  it('shows the far task when its time comes', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items, '2026-12-29'), filter({ dueWithinDays: 2 }), SP);
+    expect(openTitles(day)).toEqual(['Far']);
+  });
+
+  it('does not touch events, and ignores a limit that is not valid', () => {
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(items), filter({ dueWithinDays: 0 }), SP);
+    expect(day.allDay).toHaveLength(1);
+    const plain = dayOf(items);
+    expect(applyDayFilters(plain, filter({ dueWithinDays: -2 }), SP)).toBe(plain);
+  });
+
+  it('marks the day empty when the limit hides the only task', () => {
+    const lonely = [task('Far', { from: '2026-10-01', due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-12-31' } })];
+    const day = applyDayFilters(dayOf(lonely), filter({ dueWithinDays: 7 }), SP);
+    expect(day.empty).toBe(true);
+  });
+});

+import { createItem, createTag, type Item, type Tag } from '../../src/core';
+import { testContext } from '../core/helpers';
+
+export const SP = 'America/Sao_Paulo'; // UTC-3 all year since 2019
+const ctx = testContext();
+
+export function task(title: string, extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]> = {}): Item {
+  return createItem({ kind: 'task', title, agendaId: 'a', statusId: 's-planned', ...extra }, ctx);
+}
+
+export function event(title: string, extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof createItem>[0]> = {}): Item {
+  return createItem({ kind: 'event', title, agendaId: 'a', ...extra }, ctx);
+}
+
+export function tag(name: string, parentId: string | null = null): Tag {
+  return createTag({ name, color: '#3b5bdb', parentId }, ctx);
+}
+
+export const titles = (items: readonly Item[]) => items.map((item) => item.title);

+import { softDelete, type Item } from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  EMPTY_FILTER,
+  createItemMatcher,
+  filterItems,
+  isFilterActive,
+  normalizeText,
+  type ItemFilter,
+} from '../../src/filters';
+import { event, tag, task, titles } from './helpers';
+
+const filter = (changes: Partial<ItemFilter>): ItemFilter => ({ ...EMPTY_FILTER, ...changes });
+
+describe('text helpers', () => {
+  it('ignores case, accents and extra spaces', () => {
+    expect(normalizeText('  Ação   RÁPIDA ')).toBe('acao rapida');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('isFilterActive', () => {
+  it('is off for the empty filter and for blank text', () => {
+    expect(isFilterActive(EMPTY_FILTER)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ text: '   ' }))).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('is on when any sieve is on, and zero days counts', () => {
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ tagIds: ['t'] }))).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ kinds: ['task'] }))).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ periods: ['morning'] }))).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ text: 'a' }))).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ dueWithinDays: 0 }))).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores a due within limit that is negative or not whole', () => {
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ dueWithinDays: -1 }))).toBe(false);
+    expect(isFilterActive(filter({ dueWithinDays: 2.5 }))).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('filterItems: kind', () => {
+  const items = [task('Paper'), event('Class')];
+
+  it('keeps everything when no kind is chosen', () => {
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, EMPTY_FILTER, []))).toEqual(['Paper', 'Class']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps only the chosen kinds', () => {
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, filter({ kinds: ['task'] }), []))).toEqual(['Paper']);
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, filter({ kinds: ['event'] }), []))).toEqual(['Class']);
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, filter({ kinds: ['event', 'task'] }), []))).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('filterItems: text', () => {
+  const items = [
+    task('Entregar relatório', { notes: 'Estatística aplicada' }),
+    event('Aula', { location: 'Sala 12 Bloco B' }),
+    event('Dentista'),
+  ];
+  const find = (text: string) => titles(filterItems(items, filter({ text }), []));
+
+  it('looks in the title, the notes and the location', () => {
+    expect(find('relatorio')).toEqual(['Entregar relatório']);
+    expect(find('estatistica')).toEqual(['Entregar relatório']);
+    expect(find('bloco b')).toEqual(['Aula']);
+  });
+
+  it('needs every word, in any order, ignoring case and accents', () => {
+    expect(find('APLICADA relatório')).toEqual(['Entregar relatório']);
+    expect(find('relatorio sala')).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing for blank text', () => {
+    expect(find('   ')).toHaveLength(3);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('filterItems: tags', () => {
+  const care = tag('Care');
+  const gardening = tag('Gardening', care.id);
+  const watering = tag('Watering', gardening.id);
+  const work = tag('Work');
+  const tags = [care, gardening, watering, work];
+  const items = [
+    task('Water ferns', { tagIds: [watering.id] }),
+    task('Buy soil', { tagIds: [gardening.id] }),
+    task('Call mom', { tagIds: [care.id] }),
+    task('Report', { tagIds: [work.id] }),
+    task('No tag'),
+  ];
+  const find = (tagIds: string[]) => titles(filterItems(items, filter({ tagIds }), tags));
+
+  it('a parent includes its descendants', () => {
+    expect(find([care.id])).toEqual(['Water ferns', 'Buy soil', 'Call mom']);
+  });
+
+  it('a leaf includes only itself', () => {
+    expect(find([watering.id])).toEqual(['Water ferns']);
+  });
+
+  it('several tags work as "any of them"', () => {
+    expect(find([watering.id, work.id])).toEqual(['Water ferns', 'Report']);
+  });
+
+  it('drops a deleted or unknown tag, so the sieve does not match nothing', () => {
+    const gone = softDelete(work);
+    const withGone = [care, gardening, watering, gone];
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, filter({ tagIds: [work.id] }), withGone))).toHaveLength(5);
+    expect(titles(filterItems(items, filter({ tagIds: ['nope'] }), tags))).toHaveLength(5);
+    // A deleted one next to a live one: only the live one counts
+    expect(
+      titles(filterItems(items, filter({ tagIds: [work.id, watering.id] }), withGone)),
+    ).toEqual(['Water ferns']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('filterItems: inherited tags', () => {
+  const garden = tag('Garden');
+  const home = tag('Home');
+  const tags = [garden, home];
+  const parent = task('Garden task', { tagIds: [garden.id] });
+  const child = (title: string, extra: Parameters<typeof task>[1] = {}) =>
+    task(title, { parentId: parent.id, ...extra });
+  const find = (items: Item[], tagIds: string[]) =>
+    titles(filterItems(items, filter({ tagIds }), tags));
+
+  it('a child with no tag of its own passes the parent tag, and a grandchild too', () => {
+    const buySoil = child('Buy soil');
+    const bag = task('Pick a bag', { parentId: buySoil.id });
+    expect(find([parent, buySoil, bag], [garden.id])).toEqual([
+      'Garden task',
+      'Buy soil',
+      'Pick a bag',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('adds its own tags to the inherited ones', () => {
+    const urgent = tag('Urgent');
+    const block = event('Study block', { parentId: parent.id, tagIds: [urgent.id] });
+    const list = (ids: string[]) =>
+      titles(filterItems([parent, block], filter({ tagIds: ids }), [...tags, urgent]));
+    expect(list([urgent.id])).toEqual(['Study block']);
+    expect(list([garden.id])).toEqual(['Garden task', 'Study block']);
+  });
+
+  it('stops inheriting when the switch is off', () => {
+    const personal = child('Personal', { tagIds: [home.id], inheritTags: false });
+    expect(find([parent, personal], [garden.id])).toEqual(['Garden task']);
+    expect(find([parent, personal], [home.id])).toEqual(['Personal']);
+  });
+
+  it('a parent with the switch off still passes what its parent gives only if its child asks', () => {
+    const top = task('Top', { tagIds: [home.id] });
+    const middle = task('Middle', { parentId: top.id, inheritTags: false });
+    const leaf = task('Leaf', { parentId: middle.id });
+    // The leaf inherits from the middle, which has no tags, and the middle does not reach the top
+    expect(find([top, middle, leaf], [home.id])).toEqual(['Top']);
+  });
+
+  it('finds the parent even when another sieve would drop it', () => {
+    const block = event('Study block', { parentId: parent.id });
+    const byKind = filterItems(
+      [parent, block],
+      filter({ tagIds: [garden.id], kinds: ['event'] }),
+      tags,
+    );
+    expect(titles(byKind)).toEqual(['Study block']);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores a deleted parent', () => {
+    const buySoil = child('Buy soil');
+    expect(find([softDelete(parent), buySoil], [garden.id])).not.toContain('Buy soil');
+  });
+
+  it('without the item list, only own tags count', () => {
+    const match = createItemMatcher(filter({ tagIds: [garden.id] }), tags);
+    expect(match(child('Buy soil'))).toBe(false);
+    expect(match(parent)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('survives a loop in corrupted data', () => {
+    const a = task('A', { tagIds: [home.id] });
+    const b = task('B', { parentId: a.id });
+    const looped = { ...a, parentId: b.id };
+    expect(find([looped, b], [garden.id])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('filterItems: everything together', () => {
+  it('needs the item to pass every sieve that is on', () => {
+    const work = tag('Work');
+    const items = [
+      task('Report draft', { tagIds: [work.id] }),
+      event('Report meeting', { tagIds: [work.id] }),
+      task('Report at home'),
+    ];
+    const matches = createItemMatcher(
+      filter({ tagIds: [work.id], kinds: ['task'], text: 'report' }),
+      [work],
+    );
+    expect(titles(items.filter(matches))).toEqual(['Report draft']);
+  });
+});

+import {
+  buildOverdueStrip,
+  buildTimelineDay,
+  createAgenda,
+  createAgendaGroup,
+  softDelete,
+  type Agenda,
+  type AgendaGroup,
+  type Item,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  arrangeDay,
+  arrangeDayWithOverdue,
+  arrangeOverdue,
+  createLayoutPlan,
+  isAgendaLayout,
+  type DaySection,
+} from '../../src/filters';
+import { testContext } from '../core/helpers';
+import { SP, event, task } from './helpers';
+
+const ctx = testContext();
+const none = new Set<string>();
+
+function agenda(name: string, order: number): Agenda {
+  return createAgenda({ name, color: '#3b5bdb', order }, ctx);
+}
+function group(name: string, members: Agenda[], order: number): AgendaGroup {
+  return createAgendaGroup({ name, agendaIds: members.map((a) => a.id), order }, ctx);
+}
+
+const school = agenda('School', 1);
+const freelance = agenda('Freelance', 2);
+const home = agenda('Home', 3);
+const agendas = [home, freelance, school];
+const work = group('Work', [school, freelance], 1);
+const personal = group('Personal', [home], 2);
+
+// São Paulo is UTC-3, so 09:00 there is 12:00Z
+const at = (hour: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 9, hour + 3)).toISOString();
+const timed = (title: string, agendaId: string, hour: number): Item =>
+  event(title, { agendaId, schedule: { allDay: false, start: at(hour), end: at(hour + 1) } });
+
+const items = [
+  timed('Home lunch', home.id, 12),
+  timed('Class', school.id, 9),
+  timed('Client call', freelance.id, 10),
+  event('School holiday', { agendaId: school.id, schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-09' } }),
+  task('Home paper', { agendaId: home.id, due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' } }),
+];
+const day = buildTimelineDay(items, '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+
+const titlesOf = (section: DaySection) => [
+  ...section.day.allDay.map((entry) => entry.item.title),
+  ...section.day.timed.map((entry) => entry.item.title),
+  ...section.day.open.map((entry) => entry.item.title),
+];
+const summary = (sections: DaySection[]) =>
+  sections.map((section) => [section.info.key, titlesOf(section)]);
+
+describe('isAgendaLayout', () => {
+  it('accepts only the three layouts', () => {
+    expect(['mixed', 'separate', 'grouped'].every(isAgendaLayout)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isAgendaLayout('tabs')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isAgendaLayout(null)).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('arrangeDay: mixed', () => {
+  const plan = createLayoutPlan('mixed', agendas, [work, personal]);
+
+  it('returns the day itself, untouched, as the only section', () => {
+    const sections = arrangeDay(day, plan);
+    expect(sections).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(sections[0]!.info).toMatchObject({ key: 'all', kind: 'all' });
+    expect(sections[0]!.day).toBe(day);
+  });
+
+  it('returns no section for an empty day', () => {
+    const empty = buildTimelineDay([], '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+    expect(arrangeDay(empty, plan)).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('arrangeDay: separate', () => {
+  const plan = createLayoutPlan('separate', agendas, [work, personal]);
+
+  it('makes one section per agenda, in agenda order, keeping the time order inside', () => {
+    expect(summary(arrangeDay(day, plan))).toEqual([
+      [`agenda:${school.id}`, ['School holiday', 'Class']],
+      [`agenda:${freelance.id}`, ['Client call']],
+      [`agenda:${home.id}`, ['Home lunch', 'Home paper']],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('describes each section by its agenda', () => {
+    const [first] = arrangeDay(day, plan);
+    expect(first!.info).toEqual({
+      key: `agenda:${school.id}`,
+      kind: 'agenda',
+      agendaId: school.id,
+      groupId: null,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('drops sections with nothing and keeps the structure of each part', () => {
+    const onlyHome = buildTimelineDay(
+      items.filter((item) => item.agendaId === home.id),
+      '2026-11-09',
+      SP,
+      none,
+    );
+    const sections = arrangeDay(onlyHome, plan);
+    expect(sections).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(sections[0]!.day.timed).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(sections[0]!.day.open).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(sections[0]!.day.allDay).toEqual([]);
+    expect(sections[0]!.day.date).toBe('2026-11-09');
+    expect(sections[0]!.day.empty).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores deleted agendas when ordering, and puts an unknown agenda last', () => {
+    const stray = timed('Stray', 'missing', 8);
+    const homeItem = items.find((item) => item.agendaId === home.id)!;
+    const schoolItem = items.find((item) => item.agendaId === school.id)!;
+    const strayDay = buildTimelineDay([stray, homeItem, schoolItem], '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+    const sections = arrangeDay(
+      strayDay,
+      createLayoutPlan('separate', [softDelete(school, ctx), home], []),
+    );
+    expect(sections.map((section) => section.info.key)).toEqual([
+      `agenda:${home.id}`,
+      `agenda:${school.id}`,
+      'agenda:missing',
+    ]);
+    expect(sections.at(-1)!.info.agendaId).toBe('missing');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('arrangeDay: grouped', () => {
+  it('makes one section per group, in group order', () => {
+    const plan = createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [personal, work]);
+    expect(summary(arrangeDay(day, plan))).toEqual([
+      [`group:${work.id}`, ['School holiday', 'Class', 'Client call']],
+      [`group:${personal.id}`, ['Home lunch', 'Home paper']],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('puts agendas that are in no group into a last section', () => {
+    const plan = createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [work]);
+    const sections = arrangeDay(day, plan);
+    expect(sections.map((section) => section.info.key)).toEqual([`group:${work.id}`, 'ungrouped']);
+    expect(titlesOf(sections[1]!)).toEqual(['Home lunch', 'Home paper']);
+    expect(sections[1]!.info.kind).toBe('ungrouped');
+  });
+
+  it('sends an agenda in two groups to the first group only, so nothing shows twice', () => {
+    const both = group('Both', [school, home], 0);
+    const plan = createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [work, both]);
+    const sections = arrangeDay(day, plan);
+    expect(sections.map((section) => section.info.groupId)).toEqual([both.id, work.id]);
+    const all = sections.flatMap(titlesOf);
+    expect(all).toHaveLength(new Set(all).size);
+    expect(titlesOf(sections[0]!)).toEqual(['School holiday', 'Class', 'Home lunch', 'Home paper']);
+    expect(titlesOf(sections[1]!)).toEqual(['Client call']);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores deleted groups', () => {
+    const plan = createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [softDelete(work, ctx), personal]);
+    expect(arrangeDay(day, plan).map((section) => section.info.key)).toEqual([
+      `group:${personal.id}`,
+      'ungrouped',
+    ]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('arrangeOverdue', () => {
+  const now = '2026-11-09T15:00:00.000Z';
+  const late = [
+    task('Late home', { agendaId: home.id, due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-05' } }),
+    task('Late school', { agendaId: school.id, due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-03' } }),
+  ];
+  const strip = buildOverdueStrip(late, now, '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+
+  it('returns nothing for an empty strip, in every layout', () => {
+    for (const layout of ['mixed', 'separate', 'grouped'] as const) {
+      expect(arrangeOverdue([], createLayoutPlan(layout, agendas, [work]))).toEqual([]);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('returns the strip itself in mixed', () => {
+    const [section] = arrangeOverdue(strip, createLayoutPlan('mixed', agendas, []));
+    expect(section!.entries).toBe(strip);
+  });
+
+  it('deals the strip into sections, keeping the oldest delivery first inside each', () => {
+    const separate = arrangeOverdue(strip, createLayoutPlan('separate', agendas, []));
+    expect(separate.map((s) => [s.info.key, s.entries.map((e) => e.item.title)])).toEqual([
+      [`agenda:${school.id}`, ['Late school']],
+      [`agenda:${home.id}`, ['Late home']],
+    ]);
+
+    const grouped = arrangeOverdue(strip, createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [work]));
+    expect(grouped.map((s) => s.info.key)).toEqual([`group:${work.id}`, 'ungrouped']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('arrangeDayWithOverdue', () => {
+  const now = '2026-11-09T15:00:00.000Z';
+  const late = [
+    task('Late home', { agendaId: home.id, due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-05' } }),
+    task('Late freelance', { agendaId: freelance.id, due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-03' } }),
+  ];
+  const strip = buildOverdueStrip(late, now, '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+  const keys = (plan: ReturnType<typeof createLayoutPlan>, d = day, o = strip) =>
+    arrangeDayWithOverdue(d, o, plan).map((section) => section.info.key);
+
+  it('keeps the day and the strip whole in mixed', () => {
+    const [only, ...rest] = arrangeDayWithOverdue(
+      day,
+      strip,
+      createLayoutPlan('mixed', agendas, []),
+    );
+    expect(rest).toEqual([]);
+    expect(only!.day).toBe(day);
+    expect(only!.overdue).toBe(strip);
+  });
+
+  it('puts the day and the strip of each agenda in the same section, in plan order', () => {
+    const sections = arrangeDayWithOverdue(day, strip, createLayoutPlan('separate', agendas, []));
+    expect(sections.map((s) => s.info.key)).toEqual([
+      `agenda:${school.id}`,
+      `agenda:${freelance.id}`,
+      `agenda:${home.id}`,
+    ]);
+    const freelanceSection = sections[1]!;
+    expect(titlesOf(freelanceSection)).toEqual(['Client call']);
+    expect(freelanceSection.overdue.map((e) => e.item.title)).toEqual(['Late freelance']);
+    expect(sections[0]!.overdue).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives a section to an agenda that only has an overdue task', () => {
+    const onlySchool = buildTimelineDay(
+      items.filter((item) => item.agendaId === school.id),
+      '2026-11-09',
+      SP,
+      none,
+    );
+    const sections = arrangeDayWithOverdue(
+      onlySchool,
+      strip,
+      createLayoutPlan('separate', agendas, []),
+    );
+    const home = sections.find(
+      (s) => s.info.key.startsWith('agenda:') && s.overdue.length > 0 && s.day.timed.length === 0,
+    );
+    expect(home).toBeDefined();
+    expect(home!.day.allDay).toEqual([]);
+    expect(home!.day.date).toBe('2026-11-09');
+  });
+
+  it('works with an empty day and a strip, and returns nothing when both are empty', () => {
+    const empty = buildTimelineDay([], '2026-11-09', SP, none);
+    for (const layout of ['mixed', 'separate', 'grouped'] as const) {
+      const plan = createLayoutPlan(layout, agendas, [work]);
+      expect(arrangeDayWithOverdue(empty, [], plan)).toEqual([]);
+      expect(keys(plan, empty).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    }
+    const grouped = createLayoutPlan('grouped', agendas, [work]);
+    expect(keys(grouped, empty)).toEqual([`group:${work.id}`, 'ungrouped']);
+  });
+});

+import { createAgenda, createSavedView, softDelete } from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_CONTROLS,
+  controlsFromView,
+  isViewCurrent,
+  nextViewOrder,
+  snapshotControls,
+  sortSavedViews,
+  viewNameProblem,
+  type TimelineControls,
+} from '../../src/filters';
+
+const a = createAgenda({ name: 'A', color: '#111111', order: 0 });
+const b = createAgenda({ name: 'B', color: '#222222', order: 1 });
+const agendas = [a, b];
+
+const controls = (patch: Partial<TimelineControls> = {}): TimelineControls => ({
+  ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS,
+  ...patch,
+});
+
+describe('snapshotControls and controlsFromView', () => {
+  it('round trips every control', () => {
+    const start = controls({
+      filter: {
+        tagIds: ['t1'],
+        kinds: ['task'],
+        periods: ['morning'],
+        text: 'x',
+        dueWithinDays: 3,
+      },
+      selection: [a.id],
+      layout: 'separate',
+    });
+    const view = createSavedView({ name: 'V', ...snapshotControls(start) });
+    expect(controlsFromView(view)).toEqual(start);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps "every agenda" as null', () => {
+    const view = createSavedView({ name: 'V', ...snapshotControls(DEFAULT_CONTROLS) });
+    expect(view.agendaIds).toBeNull();
+    expect(controlsFromView(view).selection).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('copies the lists, so later changes do not leak into the view', () => {
+    const start = controls({ selection: [a.id] });
+    const snap = snapshotControls(start);
+    (start.selection as string[]).push(b.id);
+    expect(snap.agendaIds).toEqual([a.id]);
+    const view = createSavedView({ name: 'V', ...snap });
+    const back = controlsFromView(view);
+    (back.selection as string[]).push(b.id);
+    expect(view.agendaIds).toEqual([a.id]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('isViewCurrent', () => {
+  const saved = createSavedView({
+    name: 'V',
+    ...snapshotControls(
+      controls({
+        filter: { tagIds: ['t1', 't2'], kinds: [], periods: [], text: 'x', dueWithinDays: null },
+        selection: [a.id],
+      }),
+    ),
+  });
+
+  it('is true for the controls it was saved from', () => {
+    expect(isViewCurrent(saved, controlsFromView(saved), agendas)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores the order of the lists and spaces around the text', () => {
+    const same = controls({
+      filter: { tagIds: ['t2', 't1'], kinds: [], periods: [], text: ' x ', dueWithinDays: null },
+      selection: [a.id],
+    });
+    expect(isViewCurrent(saved, same, agendas)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('notices a change in each group of controls', () => {
+    const base = controlsFromView(saved);
+    expect(isViewCurrent(saved, { ...base, layout: 'grouped' }, agendas)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isViewCurrent(saved, { ...base, selection: null }, agendas)).toBe(false);
+    expect(
+      isViewCurrent(saved, { ...base, filter: { ...base.filter, kinds: ['event'] } }, agendas),
+    ).toBe(false);
+    expect(
+      isViewCurrent(saved, { ...base, filter: { ...base.filter, dueWithinDays: 2 } }, agendas),
+    ).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('treats null and a list of every agenda as the same thing on screen', () => {
+    const all = createSavedView({ name: 'All', ...snapshotControls(DEFAULT_CONTROLS) });
+    expect(isViewCurrent(all, controls({ selection: [a.id, b.id] }), agendas)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('treats an invalid due limit as no limit', () => {
+    const plain = createSavedView({ name: 'P', ...snapshotControls(DEFAULT_CONTROLS) });
+    const odd = controls({ filter: { ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS.filter, dueWithinDays: -1 } });
+    expect(isViewCurrent(plain, odd, agendas)).toBe(true);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('listing and names', () => {
+  const v = (name: string, order: number) => createSavedView({ name, order });
+
+  it('sorts by order then name, and leaves out deleted views', () => {
+    const gone = softDelete(v('Gone', 0));
+    const list = sortSavedViews([v('Z', 1), v('B', 0), v('A', 0), gone]);
+    expect(list.map((view) => view.name)).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'Z']);
+  });
+
+  it('puts a new view after the last one', () => {
+    expect(nextViewOrder([])).toBe(0);
+    expect(nextViewOrder([v('A', 0), v('B', 4)])).toBe(5);
+  });
+
+  it('refuses empty and repeated names, ignoring case and spaces', () => {
+    const views = [v('Work', 0), softDelete(v('Old', 1))];
+    expect(viewNameProblem('   ', views)).toBe('empty');
+    expect(viewNameProblem(' work ', views)).toBe('duplicate');
+    expect(viewNameProblem('Old', views)).toBeNull();
+    expect(viewNameProblem('Home', views)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('lets a view keep its own name when renaming', () => {
+    const own = v('Work', 0);
+    expect(viewNameProblem('WORK', [own], own.id)).toBeNull();
+  });
+});

+import { act, render, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+import type { ReactElement } from 'react';
+import type { AgendaDatabase } from '../src/storage';
+import { DataProvider } from '../src/ui/data/DataProvider';
+import { mountedDbs } from './mounted';
+import { I18nProvider } from '../src/ui/i18n/I18nProvider';
+
+export function renderWithI18n(ui: ReactElement) {
+  return render(<I18nProvider>{ui}</I18nProvider>);
+}
+
+/** Renders with the language and data providers, over the given (test) database. */
+export function renderApp(ui: ReactElement, db: AgendaDatabase) {
+  mountedDbs.add(db);
+  return render(
+    <I18nProvider>
+      <DataProvider db={db}>{ui}</DataProvider>
+    </I18nProvider>,
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * Waits for the data provider to finish its first-open setup (the starting status groups), so a
+ * test that ends right after rendering does not leave the provider updating after the test.
+ * A database that never gets status groups (a test that empties them on purpose) just times out
+ * quickly, and the remaining updates are still flushed.
+ */
+export async function settleApp(db: AgendaDatabase) {
+  try {
+    await waitFor(async () => expect(await db.statusGroups.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0), {
+      timeout: 500,
+    });
+  } catch {
+    // Nothing to wait for
+  }
+  // Lets the screens' own reads finish too, which land a little after the provider's setup
+  await act(async () => {
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 30));
+  });
+}

+import { createAgenda, createItem, createSavedView, type Item } from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  BACKUP_FORMAT,
+  backupFileName,
+  exportBackup,
+  importBackup,
+  importBackupText,
+  isPristine,
+  loadSettings,
+  parseBackup,
+  saveSettings,
+  serializeBackup,
+  createRepositories,
+  ensureDefaultStatuses,
+} from '../../src/storage';
+import { testContext } from '../core/helpers';
+import { fill, label, openTestDb, sampleData } from './helpers';
+
+const NOW = () => '2026-11-07T20:00:00.000Z';
+
+async function snapshot(db: ReturnType<typeof openTestDb>) {
+  const sorted = <T extends { id: string }>(list: T[]) =>
+    [...list].sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
+  return {
+    agendas: sorted(await db.agendas.toArray()),
+    groups: sorted(await db.statusGroups.toArray()),
+    statuses: sorted(await db.statuses.toArray()),
+    tags: sorted(await db.tags.toArray()),
+    items: sorted(await db.items.toArray()),
+    savedViews: sorted(await db.savedViews.toArray()),
+  };
+}
+
+/** Parses text and expects it to fail, returning the issues. */
+function issuesOf(text: string) {
+  const result = parseBackup(text);
+  if (result.ok) throw new Error('expected the file to be refused');
+  return result.issues;
+}
+
+describe('export', () => {
+  it('writes the format, the version and all the data', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const data = sampleData();
+    await fill(db, data);
+    const backup = await exportBackup(db, { now: NOW });
+    expect(backup).toMatchObject({
+      format: BACKUP_FORMAT,
+      version: 1,
+      exportedAt: NOW(),
+      settings: null,
+    });
+    expect(backup.data.agendas).toEqual([data.agenda]);
+    expect(backup.data.items).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(backup.data.statusGroups).toHaveLength(3);
+    expect(backup.data.statuses).toHaveLength(7);
+    expect(backupFileName(NOW())).toBe('unified-agenda-2026-11-07.json');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps tombstones by default and can leave them out', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const data = sampleData();
+    await fill(db, data);
+    await createRepositories(db).items.remove(data.block.id);
+    expect((await exportBackup(db)).data.items).toHaveLength(2);
+    const clean = await exportBackup(db, { includeDeleted: false });
+    expect(clean.data.items.map((i) => i.id)).toEqual([data.task.id]);
+  });
+
+  it('includes the settings only when they were saved', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const settings = {
+      displayTimeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon',
+      periodBounds: { morningStart: 5, afternoonStart: 13, eveningStart: 19 },
+    };
+    await saveSettings(db, settings);
+    expect((await exportBackup(db)).settings).toEqual(settings);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('round trip', () => {
+  it('rebuilds exactly the same data on another device', async () => {
+    const source = openTestDb();
+    await fill(source, sampleData());
+    await createRepositories(source).items.remove(sampleData().block.id);
+    await saveSettings(source, {
+      displayTimeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo',
+      periodBounds: { morningStart: 5, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 20 },
+    });
+    const text = serializeBackup(await exportBackup(source, { now: NOW }));
+
+    const target = openTestDb();
+    const result = await importBackupText(target, text, 'replace');
+    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
+    expect(await snapshot(target)).toEqual(await snapshot(source));
+    expect(await loadSettings(target)).toEqual(await loadSettings(source));
+  });
+
+  it('survives text with accents and quotes', async () => {
+    const source = openTestDb();
+    const data = sampleData();
+    const odd: Item = {
+      ...data.task,
+      title: 'Redação "final" ✓ \\ 日本',
+      notes: 'linha 1\nlinha 2',
+    };
+    await fill(source, { ...data, task: odd });
+    const text = serializeBackup(await exportBackup(source));
+    const target = openTestDb();
+    await importBackupText(target, text, 'replace');
+    expect(await target.items.get(odd.id)).toEqual(odd);
+  });
+
+  it('handles a few thousand items', async () => {

+    // Real random ids, so none of them collides with the predictable ids of the sample data
+    const many = Array.from({ length: 3000 }, (_, i) =>
+      createItem({ kind: 'event', title: `Event ${i}`, agendaId: data.agenda.id }),
+    );
+    await fill(source, data);
+    await source.items.bulkPut(many);
+    const text = serializeBackup(await exportBackup(source));
+    const target = openTestDb();
+    const result = await importBackupText(target, text, 'replace');
+    expect(result.ok && result.summary.items.added).toBe(3002);
+    expect(await target.items.count()).toBe(3002);
+  });
+});

+describe('merge', () => {

+  });

+  it('carries a deletion to the other device', async () => {

+    expect(await createRepositories(db).items.list()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });

+  it('takes the settings from the file only when none are saved here', async () => {

+});

+describe('replace', () => {
+  it('erases what is not in the file', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    await fill(db, sampleData());
+    await saveSettings(db, {
+      displayTimeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo',
+      periodBounds: { morningStart: 6, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 18 },

+  it('refuses a file whose references point outside of it, and changes nothing', async () => {

+  it('lets a partial file merge, since the rest is already here', async () => {

+    await fill(db, data);
+    const source = openTestDb();
+    await fill(source, data);
+    const backup = await exportBackup(source);

+    expect(await isPristine(db)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('reads an older backup without inheritTags as switched on', async () => {

+    expect((await importBackup(openTestDb(), backup, 'replace')).ok).toBe(true);
+  });

+import {
+  createAgenda,

+async function withDeeperItem() {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  const data = sampleData();
+  await fill(db, data);
+  const deeper = createItem({
+    kind: 'event',
+    title: 'Deeper',
+    agendaId: data.agenda.id,
+    parentId: data.block.id,
+  });
+  await db.items.put(deeper);
+  return { db, data, deeper };
+}

+describe('removeItemCascade', () => {
+  it('marks the item and every descendant as deleted, and nothing else', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    const sibling = createItem({ kind: 'task', title: 'Other', agendaId: data.agenda.id });
+    await db.items.put(sibling);
+
+    const result = await removeItemCascade(db, data.task.id);
+
+    expect(result).toEqual({ removed: true, items: 3 });
+    const items = await db.items.toArray();
+    expect(
+      items
+        .filter((item) => !isActive(item))
+        .map((item) => item.title)
+        .sort(),
+    ).toEqual(['Deeper', 'Paper', 'Work on paper']);
+    expect(isActive((await db.items.get(sibling.id))!)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isActive((await db.agendas.get(data.agenda.id))!)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the parent when only a child is removed', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    const result = await removeItemCascade(db, data.block.id);
+    expect(result.items).toBe(2);
+    expect(isActive((await db.items.get(data.task.id))!)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing for an unknown or already deleted item', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    expect(await removeItemCascade(db, 'nope')).toEqual({ removed: false, items: 0 });
+    await removeItemCascade(db, data.task.id);
+    expect(await removeItemCascade(db, data.task.id)).toEqual({ removed: false, items: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('counts what a removal would affect before doing it', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    expect(await countItemSubtree(db, data.task.id)).toBe(3);
+    expect(await countItemSubtree(db, 'nope')).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('removeAgendaCascade', () => {
+  it('deletes the agenda and every item in it, at any depth', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    const result = await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id);
+
+    expect(result).toEqual({ removed: true, items: 3 });
+    expect(isActive((await db.agendas.get(data.agenda.id))!)).toBe(false);
+    expect((await db.items.toArray()).every((item) => !isActive(item))).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves other agendas and their items alone', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    const other = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#2f9e44' });
+    const chore = createItem({ kind: 'task', title: 'Chore', agendaId: other.id });
+    await db.agendas.put(other);
+    await db.items.put(chore);
+
+    await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id);
+
+    expect(isActive((await db.agendas.get(other.id))!)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isActive((await db.items.get(chore.id))!)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('takes the agenda out of the groups that list it', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    const other = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#2f9e44' });
+    const group = createAgendaGroup({ name: 'All', agendaIds: [data.agenda.id, other.id] });
+    await db.agendas.put(other);
+    await db.agendaGroups.put(group);
+
+    await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id);
+
+    expect((await db.agendaGroups.get(group.id))!.agendaIds).toEqual([other.id]);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the tombstones, so the deletion can sync later', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id);
+    expect(await db.items.count()).toBe(3);
+    expect((await db.agendas.get(data.agenda.id))!.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
+  });

+  it('does nothing for an unknown or already deleted agenda', async () => {

+    expect(await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id)).toEqual({ removed: false, items: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('counts what a removal would affect before doing it', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withDeeperItem();
+    expect(await countAgendaItems(db, data.agenda.id)).toBe(3);
+    expect(await countAgendaItems(db, 'nope')).toBe(0);
+  });
+});

+describe('removeTagCascade', () => {
+  async function setup() {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const parent = createTag({ name: 'Work', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+    const child = createTag({ name: 'Reports', color: '#3b5bdb', parentId: parent.id });
+    const other = createTag({ name: 'Home', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+    await db.tags.bulkPut([parent, child, other]);
+    const base = { kind: 'task', agendaId: 'a', statusId: 's' } as const;
+    const a = createItem({ ...base, title: 'A', tagIds: [child.id, other.id] });
+    const b = createItem({ ...base, title: 'B', tagIds: [parent.id] });
+    const c = createItem({ ...base, title: 'C', tagIds: [other.id] });
+    await db.items.bulkPut([a, b, c]);
+    return { db, parent, child, other, a, b, c };
+  }
+
+  it('counts the sub-tags and the items that carry the tag or a sub-tag', async () => {
+    const { db, parent, other } = await setup();
+    expect(await countTagUsage(db, parent.id)).toEqual({ subTags: 1, items: 2 });
+    expect(await countTagUsage(db, other.id)).toEqual({ subTags: 0, items: 2 });
+    expect(await countTagUsage(db, 'nope')).toEqual({ subTags: 0, items: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('deletes the tag and its sub-tags and takes them off the items, which stay', async () => {
+    const { db, parent, child, other, a, b, c } = await setup();
+    expect(await removeTagCascade(db, parent.id)).toEqual({ removed: true, subTags: 1, items: 2 });
+
+    const tags = await db.tags.toArray();
+    expect(tags.filter(isActive).map((tag) => tag.id)).toEqual([other.id]);
+    expect(tags.find((tag) => tag.id === child.id)?.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
+
+    const items = new Map((await db.items.toArray()).map((item) => [item.id, item]));
+    expect(items.get(a.id)?.tagIds).toEqual([other.id]);
+    expect(items.get(b.id)?.tagIds).toEqual([]);
+    expect(items.get(b.id)?.deletedAt).toBeNull();
+    // An item that did not carry the tag is left exactly as it was
+    expect(items.get(c.id)).toEqual(c);
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing for an unknown or already deleted tag', async () => {
+    const { db, parent } = await setup();
+    await removeTagCascade(db, parent.id);
+    expect(await removeTagCascade(db, parent.id)).toEqual({ removed: false, subTags: 0, items: 0 });
+    expect(await removeTagCascade(db, 'nope')).toEqual({ removed: false, subTags: 0, items: 0 });
+  });
+});

+describe('saved views when something they mention is deleted', () => {
+  async function withViews() {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const data = sampleData();
+    await fill(db, data);
+    const other = createAgenda({ name: 'Other', color: '#000000' });
+    await db.agendas.put(other);
+    const both = createSavedView({ name: 'Both', agendaIds: [data.agenda.id, other.id] });
+    const only = createSavedView({ name: 'Only', agendaIds: [data.agenda.id] });
+    const everything = createSavedView({ name: 'Everything', agendaIds: null });
+    const nothing = createSavedView({ name: 'Nothing', agendaIds: [] });
+    await db.savedViews.bulkPut([both, only, everything, nothing]);
+    return { db, data, other, both, only, everything, nothing };
+  }
+  const byName = async (db: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof withViews>>['db'], name: string) =>
+    (await db.savedViews.toArray()).find((view) => view.name === name)!;
+
+  it('takes a deleted agenda out of the views that list it', async () => {
+    const { db, data, other, both } = await withViews();
+    await removeAgendaCascade(db, data.agenda.id);
+    const after = await byName(db, 'Both');
+    expect(after.agendaIds).toEqual([other.id]);
+    expect(after.updatedAt >= both.updatedAt).toBe(true);

+  it('sends a view that listed only that agenda back to every agenda', async () => {

+  it('leaves alone the views that do not list it, including "all" and "nothing"', async () => {

+    await removeAgendaCascade(db, other.id);
+    expect(await byName(db, 'Everything')).toEqual(everything);
+    expect(await byName(db, 'Nothing')).toEqual(nothing);
+    expect(await byName(db, 'Only')).toMatchObject({ agendaIds: expect.any(Array) });
+  });
+
+  it('does not touch a view that was already deleted', async () => {

+    expect((await byName(db, 'Only')).agendaIds).toEqual([data.agenda.id]);
+  });
+
+  it('is not affected by deleting an agenda group, which views never mention', async () => {

+    await db.agendaGroups.put(group);

+    await db.agendaGroups.put({ ...group, deletedAt: '2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z' });
+    expect(await db.savedViews.toArray()).toEqual(before);
+  });
+
+  it('takes deleted tags out of the filter of a view, keeping the rest of the filter', async () => {
+    const { db, data } = await withViews();
+    const keep = createTag({ name: 'Keep', color: '#000000' });
+    await db.tags.put(keep);
+    const view = createSavedView({
+      name: 'Tagged',
+      filter: {
+        tagIds: [data.tag.id, keep.id],
+        kinds: ['task'],
+        periods: ['morning'],
+        text: 'paper',
+        dueWithinDays: 2,
+      },
+    });
+    await db.savedViews.put(view);
+
+    await removeTagCascade(db, data.tag.id);
+    const after = await byName(db, 'Tagged');
+    expect(after.filter).toEqual({ ...view.filter, tagIds: [keep.id] });
+
+    await removeTagCascade(db, keep.id);
+    expect((await byName(db, 'Tagged')).filter.tagIds).toEqual([]);
+    expect(await byName(db, 'Everything')).toMatchObject({ filter: { tagIds: [] } });
+  });
+});

+import { afterEach } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  createAgenda,
+  createItem,
+  createDefaultStatuses,
+  createTag,
+  type Context,
+  type Item,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import { createDatabase, type AgendaDatabase } from '../../src/storage';
+import { testContext } from '../core/helpers';
+import { settleApp } from '../helpers';
+import { mountedDbs } from '../mounted';
+
+const opened: AgendaDatabase[] = [];
+let counter = 0;
+
+/** A fresh, empty database with its own name, closed and deleted after each test. */
+export function openTestDb(name = `test-db-${++counter}`): AgendaDatabase {
+  const db = createDatabase(name);
+  opened.push(db);
+  return db;
+}
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  for (const db of opened.splice(0)) {
+    if (mountedDbs.has(db)) await settleApp(db);
+    db.close();
+    await db.delete();
+  }
+});
+
+export const label = (key: string) => key;
+
+/** A small but complete data set: agenda, status groups, a tag, a task with a window and a block. */
+export function sampleData(ctx: Context = testContext()) {
+  const agenda = createAgenda({ name: 'College', color: '#3b5bdb' }, ctx);
+  const { groups, statuses } = createDefaultStatuses(label, ctx);
+  const tag = createTag({ name: 'Study', color: '#2f9e44' }, ctx);
+  const planned = statuses.find((s) => s.name === 'scheduled')!;
+  const task = createItem(
+    {
+      kind: 'task',
+      title: 'Paper',
+      agendaId: agenda.id,
+      statusId: planned.id,
+      tagIds: [tag.id],
+      from: '2026-11-03',
+      due: { allDay: false, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z', timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' },
+      links: [{ label: 'Portal', url: 'https://example.com' }],
+    },
+    ctx,
+  );
+  const block: Item = createItem(
+    {
+      kind: 'event',
+      title: 'Work on paper',
+      agendaId: agenda.id,
+      parentId: task.id,
+      schedule: {
+        allDay: false,
+        start: '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z',
+        end: '2026-11-10T19:00:00.000Z',
+      },
+    },
+    ctx,
+  );
+  return { agenda, groups, statuses, tag, task, block };
+}
+
+export async function fill(db: AgendaDatabase, data: ReturnType<typeof sampleData>) {
+  await db.agendas.put(data.agenda);
+  await db.statusGroups.bulkPut(data.groups);
+  await db.statuses.bulkPut(data.statuses);
+  await db.tags.put(data.tag);
+  await db.items.bulkPut([data.task, data.block]);
+}

+  });

+    const repos = createRepositories(openTestDb());
+    const ctx = testContext();

+    const drop = createAgenda({ name: 'Drop', color: '#000000' }, ctx);
+    await repos.agendas.putMany([keep, drop]);
+    ctx.tick();
+
+    const removed = await repos.agendas.remove(drop.id, ctx);
+    expect(removed?.deletedAt).toBe('2026-11-07T12:00:01.000Z');
+    expect((await repos.agendas.list()).map((a) => a.name)).toEqual(['Keep']);
+    expect(await repos.agendas.list({ includeDeleted: true })).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(await repos.agendas.get(drop.id)).toBeDefined();
+
+    ctx.tick();
+    const twice = await repos.agendas.remove(drop.id, ctx);
+    expect(twice?.deletedAt).toBe('2026-11-07T12:00:01.000Z');
+    expect(await repos.agendas.remove('missing', ctx)).toBeUndefined();
+  });

+import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { createAgenda, createItem } from '../../src/core';
+import { exportBackup, serializeBackup } from '../../src/storage';
+import { BackupSection } from '../../src/ui/BackupSection';
+import { readFileText } from '../../src/ui/backupValues';
+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';
+import { fill, openTestDb, sampleData } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+/** The text of a backup made from a database that holds the sample data. */
+async function sampleBackupText() {
+  const source = openTestDb();
+  await fill(source, sampleData());
+  return serializeBackup(await exportBackup(source, { now: () => '2026-11-07T12:00:00.000Z' }));
+}
+
+function chooseFile(text: string, name = 'backup.json') {
+  const input = screen.getByLabelText('Backup file');
+  return userEvent.setup().upload(input, new File([text], name, { type: 'application/json' }));
+}
+
+describe('BackupSection export', () => {
+  it('downloads one file named after the day, with all the data', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    await fill(db, sampleData());
+
+    const blobs: Blob[] = [];
+    URL.createObjectURL = (blob: Blob | MediaSource) => {
+      blobs.push(blob as Blob);
+      return 'blob:test';
+    };
+    URL.revokeObjectURL = () => undefined;
+    const names: string[] = [];
+    const click = vi.spyOn(HTMLAnchorElement.prototype, 'click').mockImplementation(function (
+      this: HTMLAnchorElement,
+    ) {
+      names.push(this.download);
+    });
+
+    renderApp(<BackupSection />, db);
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Download backup' }));
+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(
+      /^Backup saved as unified-agenda-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.json\.$/,
+    );
+    expect(names).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(names[0]).toMatch(/^unified-agenda-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.json$/);
+    expect(blobs).toHaveLength(1);
+    const file = JSON.parse(await readFileText(blobs[0]!));
+    expect(file.format).toBe('unified-agenda-backup');
+    expect(file.data.items).toHaveLength(2);
+    click.mockRestore();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('BackupSection import', () => {
+  it('lists each problem of a bad file and changes nothing', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();

+

+
+    const alert = await screen.findByRole('alert');
+    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent('"bad.json" cannot be imported. Nothing was changed.');

+  });
+
+  it('suggests replacing on an empty app and imports without asking again', async () => {

+

+
+    expect(
+      await screen.findByText(/Import finished\. Added: \d+\. Updated: 0\. Unchanged: 0\./),
+    ).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(await db.agendas.count()).toBe(1);
+    expect(await db.items.count()).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it('merges by default when the app already has data, keeping what is there', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const local = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#e03131' });
+    await db.agendas.put(local);
+    const text = await sampleBackupText();
+    renderApp(<BackupSection />, db);
+
+    await chooseFile(text);
+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('radio', { name: 'Merge' })).toBeChecked();

+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Import' }));

+

+import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, createAgenda, createItem, createTag } from '../../src/core';
+import { ensureDefaultStatuses, saveSettings } from '../../src/storage';
+import { en } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/en';
+import { ItemsSection } from '../../src/ui/ItemsSection';
+import { LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import { renderApp, settleApp } from '../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+async function dbWithAgenda(name = 'College') {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  const agenda = createAgenda({ name, color: '#3b5bdb' });
+  await db.agendas.put(agenda);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+  // The starting statuses, created before the screen opens, so the provider does not repeat them
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  return { db, agenda };
+}
+
+/** The starting statuses are created in English by the provider on the first open. */
+async function waitForStatuses(db: ReturnType<typeof openTestDb>) {
+  await waitFor(async () => expect(await db.statuses.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0));
+  const statuses = await db.statuses.toArray();
+  const groups = await db.statusGroups.toArray();
+  return { statuses, groups };
+}
+
+async function anyStatus(db: ReturnType<typeof openTestDb>) {
+  const { statuses, groups } = await waitForStatuses(db);
+  const planned = groups.find((group) => group.role === 'planned')!;
+  return statuses
+    .filter((status) => status.groupId === planned.id)
+    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0]!;
+}
+
+async function anyStatusName(db: ReturnType<typeof openTestDb>) {
+  return (await anyStatus(db)).name;
+}
+
+async function doneStatus(db: ReturnType<typeof openTestDb>) {
+  const { statuses, groups } = await waitForStatuses(db);
+  const done = groups.find((group) => group.role === 'done')!;
+  return statuses.find((status) => status.groupId === done.id)!;
+}
+
+describe('ItemsSection', () => {
+  it('asks for an agenda first when there is none', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    renderApp(<ItemsSection />, db);
+    expect(await screen.findByText(/Create an agenda first/)).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'New event' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    await settleApp(db);
+  });
+
+  it('shows the empty state of the chosen agenda', async () => {
+    const { db } = await dbWithAgenda();
+    renderApp(<ItemsSection />, db);
+    expect(await screen.findByText('No items in this agenda yet.')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('creates a timed event on the display time zone, with place, notes and a link', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const { db, agenda } = await dbWithAgenda();
+    renderApp(<ItemsSection />, db);
+
+    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'New event' }));
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Title'), '  Statistics class  ');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'At a time' }));
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Start date'), { target: { value: '2026-11-10' } });
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Start time'), { target: { value: '14:00' } });
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('End time (optional)'), { target: { value: '16:00' } });
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Location'), 'Room 2');
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Notes'), 'Bring the calculator');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add link' }));
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Link 1 name'), 'Portal');
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Link 1 address'), 'https://example.com');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
+
+    expect(await screen.findByText('Statistics class')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    const saved = await db.items.toArray();
+    expect(saved).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(saved[0]).toMatchObject({
+      kind: 'event',
+      title: 'Statistics class',
+      agendaId: agenda.id,
+      parentId: null,
+      order: 0,
+      location: 'Room 2',
+      notes: 'Bring the calculator',
+      links: [{ label: 'Portal', url: 'https://example.com' }],
+      schedule: {
+        allDay: false,
+        start: '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z',
+        end: '2026-11-10T19:00:00.000Z',
+      },

+    await user.selectOptions(target, 'Project');

+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Move' }));

+import { fireEvent, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';

+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';

+function setHour(label: string, value: string) {
+  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(label), { target: { value } });
+}
+
+describe('SettingsSection', () => {
+  it('starts on automatic with the default hours', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    renderApp(<SettingsSection />, db);
+

+    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Afternoon starts at (hour)')).toHaveValue('12');

+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('radio', { name: 'Choose one' })).toBeChecked();

+    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Morning starts at (hour)')).toHaveValue('5');
+  });
+
+  it('saves a chosen zone and new hours', async () => {

+    const db = openTestDb();
+    renderApp(<SettingsSection />, db);
+
+    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('radio', { name: 'Choose one' }));
+    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Time zone name'), 'Asia/Tokyo');
+    setHour('Morning starts at (hour)', '7');
+    setHour('Evening starts at (hour)', '20');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save settings' }));
+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Settings saved.');
+    expect(await loadSettings(db)).toEqual({

+      periodBounds: { morningStart: 7, afternoonStart: 12, eveningStart: 20 },
+    });
+  });

+

+    await user.click(within(form).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Choose one' }));
+    await user.type(within(form).getByLabelText('Time zone name'), 'x');
+    await user.clear(within(form).getByLabelText('Time zone name'));

+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';

+/** Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00 in São Paulo (UTC-3). */
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 15, 0, 0);
+
+const school = createAgenda({ name: 'School', color: '#3b5bdb', order: 0 });
+const home = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#2f9e44', order: 1 });
+const health = createAgenda({ name: 'Health', color: '#e03131', order: 2 });
+const personal = createAgendaGroup({ name: 'Personal', agendaIds: [home.id, health.id] });
+const exams = createTag({ name: 'Exams', color: '#e8590c', agendaIds: [school.id] });
+const chores = createTag({ name: 'Chores', color: '#2f9e44' });
+
+const today = (title: string, agendaId: string, tagIds: string[] = []) =>
+  createItem({
+    kind: 'event',
+    title,
+    agendaId,
+    tagIds,
+    schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07' },
+  });
+
+async function setup() {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  await db.agendas.bulkPut([school, home, health]);
+  await db.agendaGroups.put(personal);
+  await db.tags.bulkPut([exams, chores]);
+  await db.items.bulkPut([
+    today('Exam', school.id, [exams.id]),
+    today('Dishes', home.id, [chores.id]),
+    today('Dentist', health.id),
+  ]);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  return db;
+}

+const titles = () =>
+  within(screen.getByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ }))
+    .queryAllByRole('listitem')
+    .map((row) => row.querySelector('.entry__title')?.textContent);

+async function openPanel(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>) {

+  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filters/ }));
