+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Home' }));
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Exam']);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Filters (1)' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText(en.timeline.filters.activeNotice)).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Home' }));
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Dishes', 'Exam']);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Filters' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('turns a whole group off and on, with a half state in between', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+    const group = () => within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Group Personal' });
+
+    await user.click(group());
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Exam']);
+    expect(group()).not.toBeChecked();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Health' }));
+    expect(group()).not.toBeChecked();
+    expect((group() as HTMLInputElement).indeterminate).toBe(true);
+
+    await user.click(group());
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Dishes', 'Exam']);
+    expect(group()).toBeChecked();
+  });
+
+  it('says nothing matches when every agenda is hidden, and clearing brings them back', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    for (const name of ['School', 'Home', 'Health']) {
+      await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name }));
+    }
+    expect(screen.getByText(en.timeline.filters.noMatch)).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filters' }));
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Dishes', 'Exam']);
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'School' })).toBeChecked();
+    expect(screen.queryByText(en.timeline.filters.noMatch)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('offers only the tags valid in the shown agendas, and marks the partial ones', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    // All shown: Exams exists only in School, so it is marked. Chores is global.
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: /Exams/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(within(panel).getByText('(only in some agendas)')).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'School' }));
+    expect(within(panel).queryByRole('checkbox', { name: /Exams/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: /Chores/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('takes a ticked tag out of the filter when its agenda is hidden, and says so', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: /Exams/ }));
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Exam']);
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'School' }));
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'Taken out of the tag filter because they do not exist in the shown agendas: Exams.',
+    );
+    // The tag filter is off now, so the other agendas show everything again
+    expect(titles()).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Dishes']);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Filters (1)' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('does not show the agenda choice when there is a single agenda', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    await db.agendas.put(school);
+    await db.items.put(today('Exam', school.id));
+    await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+    await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+    expect(within(panel).queryByText('Agendas')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('speaks Portuguese', async () => {
+    localStorage.setItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY, 'pt-BR');
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /7 de novembro/ });
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filtros/ }));
+    const panel = screen.getByRole('group', { name: /filtros/i });
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Grupo Personal' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(within(panel).getByText('Agendas')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+});

+import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  createAgenda,
+  createItem,
+  createTag,
+  type Item,
+  type Tag,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import { ensureDefaultStatuses, saveSettings } from '../../src/storage';
+import { LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import { en } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/en';
+import { TimelineView } from '../../src/ui/TimelineView';
+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+/** Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00 in São Paulo (UTC-3). */
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 15, 0, 0);
+const ZONE = 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+
+interface Built {
+  tags: Tag[];
+  items: Item[];
+}
+
+async function setup(
+  build: (ctx: {
+    agendaId: string;
+    planned: string;
+    done: string;
+    school: Tag;
+    math: Tag;
+  }) => Built,
+) {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  const agenda = createAgenda({ name: 'College', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+  await db.agendas.put(agenda);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: ZONE });
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  const groups = await db.statusGroups.toArray();
+  const statuses = await db.statuses.toArray();
+  const firstOf = (role: string) => {
+    const group = groups.find((candidate) => candidate.role === role)!;
+    return statuses.find((status) => status.groupId === group.id)!.id;
+  };
+  const school = createTag({ name: 'School', color: '#2f9e44' });
+  const math = createTag({ name: 'Math', color: '#e8590c', parentId: school.id });
+  const built = build({
+    agendaId: agenda.id,
+    planned: firstOf('planned'),
+    done: firstOf('done'),
+    school,
+    math,
+  });
+  await db.tags.bulkPut([school, math, ...built.tags]);
+  // Fixed creation day, so a task with no start day does not depend on today's real date
+  await db.items.bulkPut(
+    built.items.map((item) => ({ ...item, createdAt: '2026-11-07T12:00:00.000Z' })),
+  );
+  return db;
+}
+
+const titles = (scope: ReturnType<typeof within> | typeof screen = screen) =>
+  scope
+    .queryAllByRole('listitem')
+    .map((row: HTMLElement) => row.querySelector('.entry__title')?.textContent);
+
+async function openFilters(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>) {
+  await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Filters' }));
+  return screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' });
+}

+    const toggle = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Filters' });
+    expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.click(toggle);
+    expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
+    const panel = screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' });
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' }));
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(toggle).toHaveFocus();
+  });
+
+  it('closes with Escape', async () => {

+    const panel = await openFilters(user);

+    expect(screen.getByText(en.timeline.filters.activeNotice)).toBeInTheDocument();

+import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, createAgenda, createAgendaGroup, createItem } from '../../src/core';
+import { ensureDefaultStatuses, saveSettings } from '../../src/storage';
+import { LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import { en } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/en';
+import { ptBR } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/pt-BR';
+import { TimelineView } from '../../src/ui/TimelineView';
+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+/** Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00 in São Paulo (UTC-3). */
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 15, 0, 0);
+
+const school = createAgenda({ name: 'School', color: '#3b5bdb', order: 0 });
+const home = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#2f9e44', order: 1 });
+const health = createAgenda({ name: 'Health', color: '#e03131', order: 2 });
+const personal = createAgendaGroup({ name: 'Personal', agendaIds: [home.id, health.id] });
+
+const today = (title: string, agendaId: string) =>
+  createItem({
+    kind: 'event',
+    title,
+    agendaId,
+    schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07' },
+  });
+
+async function setup(withLateTask = false) {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  await db.agendas.bulkPut([school, home, health]);
+  await db.agendaGroups.put(personal);
+  await db.items.bulkPut([
+    today('Exam', school.id),
+    today('Dishes', home.id),
+    today('Dentist', health.id),
+  ]);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  if (withLateTask) {
+    const planned = (await db.statusGroups.toArray()).find((group) => group.role === 'planned')!;
+    const status = (await db.statuses.toArray()).find((s) => s.groupId === planned.id)!;
+    await db.items.put(
+      createItem({
+        kind: 'task',
+        title: 'Late paper',
+        agendaId: home.id,
+        from: '2026-11-01',
+        due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-03' },
+        statusId: status.id,
+      }),
+    );
+  }
+  return db;
+}
+
+const dayRegion = () => screen.getByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ });
+
+/** The section titles of today, in order. */
+const sectionTitles = () =>
+  within(dayRegion())
+    .queryAllByRole('group')
+    .map((section) => section.querySelector('.day__section-title')?.textContent);
+
+/** The titles of the rows inside one section. */
+const rowsIn = (name: string) =>
+  within(within(dayRegion()).getByRole('group', { name }))
+    .queryAllByRole('listitem')
+    .map((row) => row.querySelector('.entry__title')?.textContent);
+
+async function openPanel(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>) {
+  await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ });
+  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filters/ }));
+  return screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' });
+}
+
+const choose = async (
+  user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>,
+  panel: HTMLElement,
+  label: string,
+) => user.click(within(panel).getByRole('radio', { name: label }));
+
+describe('Timeline: layout', () => {
+  afterEach(() => localStorage.removeItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY));
+
+  it('starts mixed: one list, no section titles', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    expect(
+      within(panel).getByRole('radio', { name: en.timeline.filters.layouts.mixed }),
+    ).toBeChecked();
+    expect(sectionTitles()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('separates by agenda, in the order of the agendas', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.separate);
+    expect(sectionTitles()).toEqual(['School', 'Home', 'Health']);
+    expect(rowsIn('School')).toEqual(['Exam']);
+    expect(rowsIn('Home')).toEqual(['Dishes']);
+    expect(rowsIn('Health')).toEqual(['Dentist']);
+  });
+
+  it('groups by group, with a last section for the agendas in no group', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.grouped);
+    expect(sectionTitles()).toEqual(['Personal', 'No group']);
+    expect(rowsIn('Personal')).toEqual(['Dentist', 'Dishes']);
+    expect(rowsIn('No group')).toEqual(['Exam']);
+  });
+
+  it('goes back to mixed and never counts as a filter', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.separate);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Filters' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.queryByText(en.timeline.filters.activeNotice)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.mixed);
+    expect(sectionTitles()).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('does not make a section for a hidden agenda', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.separate);
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Home' }));
+    expect(sectionTitles()).toEqual(['School', 'Health']);
+  });
+
+  it('deals the overdue strip into the same sections as the day', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup(true);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await choose(user, panel, en.timeline.filters.layouts.separate);
+    expect(rowsIn('Home')).toEqual(['Late paper', 'Dishes']);
+    const homeSection = within(dayRegion()).getByRole('group', { name: 'Home' });
+    expect(
+      within(homeSection).getByRole('heading', { name: en.timeline.overdue }),
+    ).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(rowsIn('School')).toEqual(['Exam']);
+  });
+
+  it('is not offered with a single agenda', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    await db.agendas.put(school);
+    await db.items.put(today('Exam', school.id));
+    await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+    await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    expect(within(panel).queryByRole('radio')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('speaks Portuguese', async () => {
+    localStorage.setItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY, 'pt-BR');
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /7 de novembro/ });
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filtros/ }));
+    const panel = screen.getByRole('group', { name: ptBR.timeline.filters.panelLabel });
+
+    await user.click(
+      within(panel).getByRole('radio', { name: ptBR.timeline.filters.layouts.grouped }),
+    );
+    const region = screen.getByRole('region', { name: /7 de novembro/ });
+    const titles = within(region)
+      .getAllByRole('group')
+      .map((section) => section.querySelector('.day__section-title')?.textContent);
+    expect(titles).toEqual(['Personal', ptBR.timeline.ungrouped]);
+  });
+});

+import { act, fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, createAgenda, createItem, type Agenda, type Item } from '../../src/core';
+import { ensureDefaultStatuses, saveSettings } from '../../src/storage';
+import { en } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/en';
+import { LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import { TimelineView } from '../../src/ui/TimelineView';
+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+/** Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00 in São Paulo (UTC-3, no clock change in November). */
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 15, 0, 0);
+const ZONE = 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+const CREATED = '2026-11-07T12:00:00.000Z';
+
+/** Intl puts a narrow no-break space before AM and PM in newer versions. Compare with plain ones. */
+const plain = (text: string | null) => (text ?? '').replace(/\s/g, ' ');
+
+async function setup(build: (agenda: Agenda, status: { planned: string; done: string }) => Item[]) {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  const agenda = createAgenda({ name: 'College', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+  await db.agendas.put(agenda);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: ZONE });
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  const groups = await db.statusGroups.toArray();
+  const statuses = await db.statuses.toArray();
+  const firstOf = (role: string) => {
+    const group = groups.find((candidate) => candidate.role === role)!;
+    return statuses.find((status) => status.groupId === group.id)!.id;
+  };
+  // A task with no start day begins on the day it was created, so the creation day is fixed to the day
+  // of NOW. Without it these tests only pass on the day they were written.
+  const built = build(agenda, { planned: firstOf('planned'), done: firstOf('done') });
+  await db.items.bulkPut(built.map((item) => ({ ...item, createdAt: CREATED })));
+  return db;
+}
+
+const day = (name: RegExp) => screen.getByRole('region', { name });
+

+  it('opens a week before today to three weeks ahead, folding empty days in a row', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();

+

+    expect(
+      within(day(/Saturday, November 7/)).getByText('Nothing on this day.'),
+    ).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    const before = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /7 empty days/ });
+    const after = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /20 empty days/ });
+    expect(plain(before.textContent)).toBe('Oct 31, 2026 to Nov 6, 2026 · 7 empty days');
+    expect(plain(after.textContent)).toBe('Nov 8, 2026 to Nov 27, 2026 · 20 empty days');
+    expect(before).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+
+    await user.click(before);
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('region')).toHaveLength(8);
+    expect(day(/Saturday, October 31/)).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Hide empty days/ })).toHaveAttribute(
+      'aria-expanded',
+      'true',
+    );
+
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Hide empty days/ }));
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('region')).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('badges today and tomorrow', async () => {

+      createItem({
+        kind: 'event',
+        title: 'Class',

+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);

+

+        createItem({
+          kind: 'event',
+          title: 'Work on paper',
+          agendaId: agenda.id,
+          parentId: parent.id,

+            start: '2026-11-08T17:00:00.000Z',
+            end: '2026-11-08T19:00:00.000Z',
+          },
+        }),
+      ];
+    });
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+
+    const tomorrow = within(await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /November 8/ }));
+    expect(tomorrow.getByText('Inside "Paper"')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });

+  it('ignores deleted items and items with no date', async () => {

+describe('TimelineView scrolling', () => {
+  const scrollIntoView = vi.fn();
+  const scrollTo = vi.fn();
+  // jsdom's own scroll position and window height, put back after a test fakes them
+  const originals = (['scrollY', 'innerHeight'] as const).map(
+    (name) => [name, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, name)!] as const,
+  );
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+    scrollTo.mockClear();
+    Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = scrollIntoView;
+    vi.spyOn(window, 'scrollTo').mockImplementation(scrollTo);
+  });
+
+  afterEach(() => {
+    vi.restoreAllMocks();
+    for (const [name, descriptor] of originals) {
+      Object.defineProperty(window, name, descriptor);
+    }
+  });
+
+  /** Fakes the page size and scroll position, which jsdom does not compute. */
+  function mockPage(scrollY: number, scrollHeight: () => number, innerHeight = 800) {
+    Object.defineProperty(window, 'scrollY', { configurable: true, value: scrollY });
+    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerHeight', { configurable: true, value: innerHeight });
+    vi.spyOn(document.documentElement, 'scrollHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(scrollHeight);
+  }
+
+  const allDayEvent = (agenda: Agenda, title: string, date: string) =>
+    createItem({
+      kind: 'event',
+      title,
+      agendaId: agenda.id,
+      schedule: { allDay: true, start: date },
+    });
+
+  it('opens on today when it starts far down, and the button goes back to it', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    // Days with content above today push it down the page
+    vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'getBoundingClientRect').mockReturnValue({ top: 900 } as DOMRect);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+
+    expect(scrollIntoView).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(scrollIntoView.mock.contexts[0]).toBe(day(/November 7/));
+
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go to today' }));
+    expect(scrollIntoView).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ block: 'start' });
+    expect(scrollIntoView.mock.contexts[0]).toBe(day(/November 7/));
+  });
+
+  it('stays at the top of the page when today is already near it, and the button still goes to today', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    // jsdom puts every block at 0, which is near the top
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    expect(scrollIntoView).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go to today' }));
+    expect(scrollIntoView).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+  });
+
+  it('loads later days with the button at the end, and earlier days with the one at the top', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup((agenda) => [
+      allDayEvent(agenda, 'Far ahead', '2026-11-30'),
+      allDayEvent(agenda, 'Long ago', '2026-10-25'),
+    ]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    expect(screen.queryByText('Far ahead')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.queryByText('Long ago')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show later days' }));
+    expect(day(/November 30/)).toBeInTheDocument();
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show earlier days' }));
+    expect(day(/October 25/)).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('loads later days by itself when the scroll gets near the bottom', async () => {
+    const db = await setup((agenda) => [allDayEvent(agenda, 'Far ahead', '2026-12-05')]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+
+    // 2000 high page, 800 shown, scrolled to 700: 500 pixels left, inside the 600 margin
+    mockPage(700, () => 2000);
+    fireEvent.scroll(window);
+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /December 5/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(scrollTo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the page in place when days load above', async () => {
+    const db = await setup((agenda) => [allDayEvent(agenda, 'Long ago', '2026-10-20')]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+
+    // The page grows by 600 pixels once the days above are in, so the scroll moves down by 600
+    mockPage(100, () => (document.getElementById('timeline-day-2026-10-20') ? 5600 : 5000));
+    fireEvent.scroll(window);
+
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /October 20/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(scrollTo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(0, 700);
+  });
+
+  it('does not load by itself when the person did not scroll', async () => {
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    await act(async () => {
+      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
+    });
+
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /20 empty days/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /7 empty days/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(scrollTo).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('goes to a date inside the loaded range, opening the folded days around it', async () => {
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Go to date'), { target: { value: '2026-11-15' } });
+
+    const target = await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /November 15/ });
+    expect(scrollIntoView).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ block: 'start' });
+    expect(scrollIntoView.mock.contexts[0]).toBe(target);
+  });
+
+  it('goes to a far date by replacing the range, and back to today the same way', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup((agenda) => [allDayEvent(agenda, 'Exam', '2027-03-10')]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Go to date'), { target: { value: '2027-03-10' } });
+    const target = await screen.findByRole('region', {
+      name: /March 10, 2027|Wednesday, March 10/,
+    });
+    expect(within(target).getByText('Exam')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(scrollIntoView.mock.contexts[0]).toBe(target);
+    // The old range is gone, so today is not on the page now
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go to today' }));
+    const today = await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ });
+    expect(scrollIntoView.mock.contexts[0]).toBe(today);
+  });
+
+  it('ignores a date outside the accepted span', async () => {
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    scrollIntoView.mockClear();
+
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Go to date'), { target: { value: '1800-01-01' } });
+    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Go to date'), { target: { value: '2300-06-01' } });
+
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('region')).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(scrollIntoView).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('shows the back to top button only after scrolling, and goes to the top', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, openTestDb());
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Back to top' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    mockPage(700, () => 5000);
+    fireEvent.scroll(window);
+    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Back to top' }));
+    expect(scrollTo).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(0, 0);
+
+    // The page is at the top now, and the button leaves
+    mockPage(0, () => 5000);
+    fireEvent.scroll(window);
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Back to top' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+});

+describe('TimelineView marking a task as done', () => {
+  it('marks an open task as done from its row, and Undo brings it back', async () => {

+          statusId: status.planned,
+          due: { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-09' },

+      ];

+    // The done group has two statuses. A finished task gets the first one, "Done".

+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    await screen.findAllByRole('region');
+
+    const today = within(day(/November 7/));

+    // It leaves the strip, the message says so, and the database has the done status
+    expect(await screen.findByText('"Paper" marked as done.')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    // The list reads the database again after the save, a moment after the message shows up
+    await waitFor(() => expect(today.queryByText('Paper')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Open tasks' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    const [saved] = await db.items.toArray();

+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo: Paper is done' }));
+    expect(await within(day(/November 7/)).findByText('Paper')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.queryByText('"Paper" marked as done.')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+    const [restored] = await db.items.toArray();
+    expect(restored!.statusId).toBe(plannedId);
+  });

+import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  createAgenda,
+  createItem,
+  createSavedView,
+  createTag,
+} from '../../src/core';
+import { ensureDefaultStatuses, saveSettings } from '../../src/storage';
+import { AppShell } from '../../src/ui/AppShell';
+import { LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import { en } from '../../src/ui/i18n/messages/en';
+import { TimelineView } from '../../src/ui/TimelineView';
+import { renderApp } from '../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../storage/helpers';
+
+/** Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00 in São Paulo (UTC-3). */
+const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 15, 0, 0);
+const text = en.timeline.filters.views;
+
+const school = createAgenda({ name: 'School', color: '#3b5bdb', order: 0 });
+const home = createAgenda({ name: 'Home', color: '#2f9e44', order: 1 });
+const study = createTag({ name: 'Study', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+
+const today = (title: string, agendaId: string, tagIds: string[] = []) =>
+  createItem({
+    kind: 'event',
+    title,
+    agendaId,
+    tagIds,
+    schedule: { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-07' },
+  });
+
+async function setup() {
+  const db = openTestDb();
+  await db.agendas.bulkPut([school, home]);
+  await db.tags.put(study);
+  await db.items.bulkPut([today('Exam', school.id, [study.id]), today('Dishes', home.id)]);
+  await saveSettings(db, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, displayTimeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' });
+  await ensureDefaultStatuses(db, (key) => en.defaults[key]);
+  return db;
+}
+
+type User = ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>;
+
+async function openPanel(user: User) {
+  await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ });
+  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filters/ }));
+  return screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' });
+}
+
+const rowTitles = () =>
+  within(screen.getByRole('region', { name: /November 7/ }))
+    .queryAllByRole('listitem')
+    .map((row) => row.querySelector('.entry__title')?.textContent);
+
+async function saveAs(user: User, panel: HTMLElement, name: string) {
+  await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Save as (new )?view$/ }));
+  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText(text.form.name), name);
+  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: text.form.save }));
+}
+
+describe('Timeline: saved views', () => {
+  afterEach(() => localStorage.removeItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY));
+
+  it('saves what is on screen and stores it', async () => {

+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);

+    expect(within(panel).getByText(text.empty)).toBeInTheDocument();
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Home' }));
+    await user.click(

+    await waitFor(async () => expect(await db.savedViews.count()).toBe(1));
+    const [saved] = await db.savedViews.toArray();
+    expect(saved).toMatchObject({

+      agendaIds: [school.id],
+      layout: 'separate',

+    expect(await screen.findByText('View: Only school')).toBeInTheDocument();

+
+  it('applies a view and shows it as changed after an edit', async () => {

+    const db = await setup();

+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'Study');
+    expect(rowTitles()).toEqual(['Exam']);
+    expect(screen.getByText('View: Study')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Study' })).toBeChecked();

+    expect(screen.getByText(`View: Study (${text.changed})`)).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(rowTitles()).toEqual(['Dishes', 'Exam']);
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Go back to the saved/ }));
+    expect(rowTitles()).toEqual(['Exam']);
+    expect(screen.getByText('View: Study')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('updates the view with what is on screen', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup();
+    const view = createSavedView({ name: 'Mine' });
+    await db.savedViews.put(view);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'Mine');
+    const update = within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Update the view/ });
+    expect(update).toBeDisabled();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Home' }));
+    await user.click(update);
+    await waitFor(async () =>
+      expect((await db.savedViews.get(view.id))?.agendaIds).toEqual([school.id]),
+    );
+    expect(await screen.findByText('View: Mine')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('renames a view and refuses a name another view has', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup();
+    const first = createSavedView({ name: 'First', order: 0 });
+    await db.savedViews.bulkPut([first, createSavedView({ name: 'Second', order: 1 })]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'First');
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Rename the view/ }));
+    const field = screen.getByLabelText(text.form.name);
+    await user.clear(field);
+    await user.type(field, ' second ');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: text.form.save }));
+    expect(await screen.findByText(text.form.nameTaken)).toBeInTheDocument();
+
+    await user.clear(field);
+    await user.type(field, 'Renamed');
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: text.form.save }));
+    await waitFor(async () => expect((await db.savedViews.get(first.id))?.name).toBe('Renamed'));
+  });
+
+  it('refuses an empty name', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, await setup());
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: text.saveFirst }));
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: text.form.save }));
+    expect(await screen.findByText(text.form.nameRequired)).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('deletes only after asking, and keeps the controls', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup();
+    const view = createSavedView({ name: 'Doomed', filter: { ...emptyFilter(), text: 'exam' } });
+    await db.savedViews.put(view);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'Doomed');
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Delete the view/ }));
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: text.cancel }));
+    expect((await db.savedViews.get(view.id))?.deletedAt).toBeNull();
+
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Delete the view/ }));
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: text.confirmAction }));
+    await waitFor(async () => expect((await db.savedViews.get(view.id))?.deletedAt).not.toBeNull());
+    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText(/^View: /)).not.toBeInTheDocument());
+    // The sieves stay as they were
+    expect(rowTitles()).toEqual(['Exam']);
+  });
+
+  it('moves the picked view up and down the list', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup();
+    const a = createSavedView({ name: 'A', order: 0 });
+    const b = createSavedView({ name: 'B', order: 1 });
+    await db.savedViews.bulkPut([a, b]);
+    renderApp(<TimelineView now={NOW} />, db);
+    const panel = await openPanel(user);
+
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'B');
+    expect(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Move the view B down/ })).toBeDisabled();
+    await user.click(within(panel).getByRole('button', { name: /^Move the view B up/ }));
+    await waitFor(async () => expect((await db.savedViews.get(b.id))?.order).toBe(0));
+    expect((await db.savedViews.get(a.id))?.order).toBe(1);
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      const names = within(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select))
+        .getAllByRole('option')
+        .map((option) => option.textContent);
+      expect(names).toEqual([text.none, 'B', 'A']);
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('remembers the filters and the view when the tab changes', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = await setup();
+    await db.savedViews.put(
+      createSavedView({ name: 'Study', filter: { ...emptyFilter(), tagIds: [study.id] } }),
+    );
+    renderApp(<AppShell />, db);
+    await screen.findByRole('region', { name: /^Today|November/ }).catch(() => undefined);
+    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /^Filters/ }));
+    const panel = screen.getByRole('group', { name: 'Timeline filters' });
+    await user.selectOptions(within(panel).getByLabelText(text.select), 'Study');
+
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Kanban' }));
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Timeline' }));
+
+    expect(await screen.findByText('View: Study')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^Filters \(1\)/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+});
+
+function emptyFilter() {
+  return { tagIds: [], kinds: [], periods: [], text: '', dueWithinDays: null };
+}

+import { totalSummary, formatIssue } from '../../src/ui/backupValues';
+import { MESSAGES } from '../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+import type { ImportSummary } from '../../src/storage';
+
+const en = MESSAGES.en;
+const pt = MESSAGES['pt-BR'];
+
+describe('formatIssue', () => {
+  it('says where the problem is and what it is, in the active language', () => {
+    const issue = { path: 'data.items[3].title', code: 'invalidField' } as const;
+    expect(formatIssue(issue, en)).toBe('data.items[3].title: This value is missing or not valid.');
+    expect(formatIssue(issue, pt)).toBe(
+      'data.items[3].title: Este valor está faltando ou não é válido.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out the place when the problem is the whole file', () => {
+    expect(formatIssue({ path: '', code: 'notJson' }, en)).toBe('This is not a JSON file.');
+  });
+
+  it('adds the reasons of an invalid item with the texts of the item form', () => {
+    const text = formatIssue(
+      { path: 'data.items[0].item', code: 'invalidItem', detail: 'titleRequired,fromNeedsDue' },
+      en,
+    );
+    expect(text).toBe(
+      'data.items[0].item: This item is not valid. Enter a title. Add a due date to use a start day.',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('keeps an unknown reason as it came', () => {
+    const text = formatIssue({ path: 'x', code: 'invalidItem', detail: 'somethingNew' }, en);
+    expect(text).toBe('x: This item is not valid. somethingNew');
+  });
+
+  it('has a text for every import problem in both languages', () => {
+    for (const code of [
+      'notJson',
+      'notBackup',
+      'unsupportedVersion',
+      'invalidField',
+      'invalidItem',
+      'duplicateId',
+      'danglingReference',
+    ] as const) {
+      expect(formatIssue({ path: '', code }, en)).not.toBe('');
+      expect(formatIssue({ path: '', code }, pt)).not.toBe('');
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+describe('totalSummary', () => {
+  it('adds up every kind of record', () => {
+    const kind = (added: number, updated: number, skipped: number) => ({ added, updated, skipped });
+    const summary: ImportSummary = {
+      agendas: kind(1, 0, 2),
+      agendaGroups: kind(0, 0, 0),
+      items: kind(5, 3, 1),
+      tags: kind(0, 1, 0),
+      statusGroups: kind(3, 0, 0),
+      statuses: kind(7, 0, 0),
+      savedViews: kind(0, 0, 0),
+      settingsApplied: true,
+    };
+    expect(totalSummary(summary)).toEqual({ added: 16, updated: 4, skipped: 3 });
+  });
+});

+import { screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { createAgenda } from '../../../src/core';
+import { useData } from '../../../src/ui/data/useData';
+import { useAgendas } from '../../../src/ui/data/useEntityList';
+import { renderApp, settleApp } from '../../helpers';
+import { openTestDb } from '../../storage/helpers';
+
+function Probe() {
+  const { data, loading } = useAgendas();
+  const { db, notify } = useData();
+  return (
+    <div>
+      <p data-testid="count">{loading ? 'loading' : data.length}</p>
+      <button
+        type="button"
+        onClick={async () => {
+          await db.agendas.put(createAgenda({ name: 'Extra', color: '#000000' }));
+          notify();
+        }}
+      >
+        add
+      </button>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+describe('DataProvider', () => {
+  afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
+
+  it('creates the starting Kanban groups in the active language', async () => {
+    vi.spyOn(navigator, 'languages', 'get').mockReturnValue(['pt-BR']);
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    renderApp(<div />, db);
+
+    await waitFor(async () => expect(await db.statusGroups.count()).toBe(3));
+    const names = (await db.statusGroups.toArray()).map((group) => group.name);
+    expect(names).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['Planejado', 'Em curso', 'Concluído']));
+    expect(await db.statuses.count()).toBe(7);
+  });
+
+  it('does not create the groups twice when the language changes', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    renderApp(<div />, db);
+    await waitFor(async () => expect(await db.statusGroups.count()).toBe(3));
+    expect(await db.statuses.count()).toBe(7);
+  });
+
+  it('reads the list again after notify', async () => {
+    const user = userEvent.setup();
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    await db.agendas.put(createAgenda({ name: 'First', color: '#3b5bdb' }));
+    renderApp(<Probe />, db);
+
+    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('count')).toHaveTextContent('1'));
+    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'add' }));
+    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('count')).toHaveTextContent('2'));
+  });
+
+  it('hides deleted agendas from the list', async () => {
+    const db = openTestDb();
+    const agenda = createAgenda({ name: 'Gone', color: '#3b5bdb' });
+    await db.agendas.put({ ...agenda, deletedAt: agenda.createdAt });
+    renderApp(<Probe />, db);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('count')).toHaveTextContent('0'));
+    await settleApp(db);
+  });
+});

+import { createItem } from '../../src/core';
+import {
+  buildEventFields,
+  emptyEventValues,
+  isHttpUrl,
+  valuesFromItem,
+  type EventFormValues,
+} from '../../src/ui/eventValues';
+
+const SAO_PAULO = 'America/Sao_Paulo';
+const base = { agendaId: 'agenda-1' };
+
+function values(changes: Partial<EventFormValues>): EventFormValues {
+  return { ...emptyEventValues(), title: 'Class', ...changes };
+}
+
+describe('buildEventFields', () => {
+  it('builds an event with no date', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({ title: '  Class  ', location: ' Room 2 ' }),
+      SAO_PAULO,
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.errors).toEqual({});
+    expect(result.fields).toMatchObject({ title: 'Class', location: 'Room 2', schedule: null });
+  });
+
+  it('reads a timed event on the display time zone and stores it in UTC', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'timed', startDate: '2026-11-10', startTime: '14:00', endTime: '16:30' }),
+      SAO_PAULO,
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.fields?.schedule).toEqual({
+      allDay: false,
+      start: '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z',
+      end: '2026-11-10T19:30:00.000Z',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('reads the clock on the zone of the event when it has one', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({
+        mode: 'timed',
+        startDate: '2026-11-10',
+        startTime: '14:00',
+        timeZone: ' Europe/Lisbon ',
+      }),
+      SAO_PAULO,
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.fields?.schedule).toEqual({
+      allDay: false,
+      start: '2026-11-10T14:00:00.000Z',
+      timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('lets a timed event end on another day', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({
+        mode: 'timed',
+        startDate: '2026-11-10',
+        startTime: '22:00',
+        endDate: '2026-11-11',
+        endTime: '02:00',
+      }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.fields?.schedule).toMatchObject({
+      start: '2026-11-10T22:00:00.000Z',
+      end: '2026-11-11T02:00:00.000Z',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('builds a whole-day event with and without an end', () => {
+    const one = buildEventFields(values({ mode: 'allDay', startDate: '2026-11-12' }), 'UTC', base);
+    expect(one.fields?.schedule).toEqual({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-12' });
+    const many = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'allDay', startDate: '2026-11-12', endDate: '2026-11-14' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(many.fields?.schedule).toEqual({ allDay: true, start: '2026-11-12', end: '2026-11-14' });
+  });
+
+  it('asks for a title', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(values({ title: '   ' }), 'UTC', base);
+    expect(result.fields).toBeNull();
+    expect(result.errors).toEqual({ title: 'titleRequired' });
+  });
+
+  it('asks for the start date and the start time', () => {
+    expect(buildEventFields(values({ mode: 'allDay' }), 'UTC', base).errors).toEqual({
+      start: 'startDateRequired',
+    });
+    expect(
+      buildEventFields(values({ mode: 'timed', startDate: '2026-11-10' }), 'UTC', base).errors,
+    ).toEqual({ start: 'startTimeRequired' });
+  });
+
+  it('asks for the end time when there is an end date', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'timed', startDate: '2026-11-10', startTime: '10:00', endDate: '2026-11-11' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.errors).toEqual({ end: 'endTimeRequired' });
+  });
+
+  it('rejects an end before the start, with the core rule', () => {
+    const timed = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'timed', startDate: '2026-11-10', startTime: '14:00', endTime: '13:00' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(timed.errors).toEqual({ end: 'endBeforeStart' });
+    const allDay = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'allDay', startDate: '2026-11-12', endDate: '2026-11-10' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(allDay.errors).toEqual({ end: 'endBeforeStart' });
+  });
+
+  it('rejects a time zone that does not exist', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'timed', startDate: '2026-11-10', startTime: '10:00', timeZone: 'Mars/Base' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.errors).toEqual({ timeZone: 'invalidTimeZone' });
+  });
+
+  it('ignores the time zone text when the event is not timed', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({ mode: 'allDay', startDate: '2026-11-10', timeZone: 'Mars/Base' }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.errors).toEqual({});
+  });
+
+  it('keeps good links, skips empty rows and names a link by its address when it has no name', () => {
+    const result = buildEventFields(
+      values({
+        links: [
+          { label: ' Portal ', url: ' https://example.com/a ' },
+          { label: '', url: 'http://example.org' },
+          { label: '', url: '' },
+        ],
+      }),
+      'UTC',
+      base,
+    );
+    expect(result.fields?.links).toEqual([
+      { label: 'Portal', url: 'https://example.com/a' },
+      { label: 'http://example.org', url: 'http://example.org' },
+    ]);
+  });
+

+    for (const url of ['example.com', 'javascript:alert(1)', '']) {
+      const result = buildEventFields(values({ links: [{ label: 'Site', url }] }), 'UTC', base);
+      expect(result.errors).toEqual({ links: 'linkInvalid' });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('shows one message per field and keeps the rest of the existing item', () => {
+    const existing = createItem({ kind: 'event', title: 'Old', agendaId: 'agenda-1', order: 3 });
+    const ok = buildEventFields(values({ title: 'New' }), 'UTC', { ...base, existing });
+    expect(ok.fields?.title).toBe('New');
+    const bad = buildEventFields(values({ title: '', mode: 'allDay', startDate: '' }), 'UTC', {
+      ...base,
+      existing,
+    });
+    expect(bad.errors).toEqual({ title: 'titleRequired', start: 'startDateRequired' });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('valuesFromItem', () => {
+  it('shows a timed event on the display zone, and an end on the same day without an end date', () => {
+    const item = createItem({
+      kind: 'event',
+      title: 'Class',
+      agendaId: 'a',
+      schedule: {
+        allDay: false,
+        start: '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z',
+        end: '2026-11-10T19:30:00.000Z',
+      },
+    });
+    expect(valuesFromItem(item, SAO_PAULO)).toMatchObject({
+      mode: 'timed',
+      startDate: '2026-11-10',
+      startTime: '14:00',
+      endDate: '',
+      endTime: '16:30',
+      timeZone: '',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('shows a timed event on its own zone', () => {
+    const item = createItem({
+      kind: 'event',
+      title: 'Flight',
+      agendaId: 'a',
+      schedule: { allDay: false, start: '2026-11-10T14:00:00.000Z', timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon' },
+    });
+    expect(valuesFromItem(item, SAO_PAULO)).toMatchObject({
+      startDate: '2026-11-10',
+      startTime: '14:00',
+      timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('round trips every kind of schedule', () => {
+    const schedules = [
+      null,
+      { allDay: true as const, start: '2026-11-12', end: '2026-11-14' },
+      {
+        allDay: false as const,
+        start: '2026-11-10T22:00:00.000Z',
+        end: '2026-11-11T02:00:00.000Z',
+        timeZone: 'Europe/Lisbon',
+      },
+    ];
+    for (const schedule of schedules) {
+      const item = createItem({
+        kind: 'event',
+        title: 'X',
+        agendaId: 'a',
+        schedule,
+        notes: 'n',
+        links: [{ label: 'L', url: 'https://example.com' }],
+      });
+      const result = buildEventFields(valuesFromItem(item, SAO_PAULO), SAO_PAULO, {
+        agendaId: 'a',
+        existing: item,
+      });
+      expect(result.errors).toEqual({});
+      expect(result.fields).toMatchObject({
+        title: 'X',
+        schedule,
+        notes: 'n',
+        links: item.links,
+      });
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+describe('isHttpUrl', () => {
+  it('accepts only http and https', () => {
+    expect(isHttpUrl('https://example.com')).toBe(true);
+    expect(isHttpUrl('http://example.com/x?y=1')).toBe(true);
+    expect(isHttpUrl('ftp://example.com')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isHttpUrl('mailto:a@b.c')).toBe(false);
+    expect(isHttpUrl('not a url')).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('tags in the event form', () => {
+  it('starts with no tags and inheritance on, and reads them back from an item', () => {
+    expect(emptyEventValues()).toMatchObject({ tagIds: [], inheritTags: true });

+      kind: 'event',
+      title: 'Block',
+      agendaId: 'a',
+      tagIds: ['t1'],
+      inheritTags: false,

+      inheritTags: false,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('carries the tags and the switch to the fields, without repeats', () => {

+      'America/Sao_Paulo',
+      { agendaId: 'a' },
+    );
+    expect(result.fields).toMatchObject({ tagIds: ['t1', 't2'], inheritTags: false });
+  });
+});

+import {
+  formatCount,
+  formatDate,
+  formatDateTime,
+  formatDayHeading,
+  formatDue,
+  formatPercent,
+  formatSchedule,
+  formatTime,
+} from '../../src/ui/format';
+
+const pt = { zero: 'Nenhum item', one: '{count} item', other: '{count} itens' };
+const en = { zero: 'No items', one: '{count} item', other: '{count} items' };
+
+describe('formatCount', () => {
+  it('uses the text for zero even where the language treats 0 as singular', () => {
+    expect(formatCount('pt-BR', 0, pt)).toBe('Nenhum item');
+    expect(formatCount('en', 0, en)).toBe('No items');
+  });
+
+  it('picks singular and plural', () => {
+    expect(formatCount('pt-BR', 1, pt)).toBe('1 item');
+    expect(formatCount('pt-BR', 2, pt)).toBe('2 itens');
+    expect(formatCount('en', 1, en)).toBe('1 item');
+    expect(formatCount('en', 5, en)).toBe('5 items');
+  });
+
+  it('formats big numbers for the language', () => {
+    expect(formatCount('en', 1200, en)).toBe('1,200 items');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('dates and times', () => {
+  it('shows a plain date on the same day in any time zone', () => {
+    expect(formatDate('en', '2026-11-07')).toContain('7');
+    expect(formatDate('en', '2026-11-07')).toContain('2026');
+    expect(formatDate('pt-BR', '2026-01-01')).toContain('1');
+  });
+
+  it('shows an instant in the chosen time zone', () => {
+    expect(formatTime('pt-BR', '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z', 'America/Sao_Paulo')).toBe('14:00');
+    expect(formatTime('pt-BR', '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z', 'UTC')).toBe('17:00');
+    expect(formatDateTime('pt-BR', '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z', 'America/Sao_Paulo')).toContain(
+      '14:00',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('follows the device when the zone is auto', () => {
+    expect(formatTime('en', '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z', 'auto')).toMatch(/\d/);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('formatSchedule', () => {
+  const range = '{start} to {end}';
+
+  it('shows a single whole day, and a range of days with the template', () => {
+    expect(formatSchedule('en', { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-12' }, 'UTC', range)).toBe(
+      formatDate('en', '2026-11-12'),
+    );
+    expect(
+      formatSchedule('en', { allDay: true, start: '2026-11-12', end: '2026-11-14' }, 'UTC', range),
+    ).toBe(`${formatDate('en', '2026-11-12')} to ${formatDate('en', '2026-11-14')}`);
+  });
+
+  it('shows only the hour for an end on the same day, in the display zone', () => {
+    const text = formatSchedule(
+      'pt-BR',
+      { allDay: false, start: '2026-11-10T17:00:00.000Z', end: '2026-11-10T19:30:00.000Z' },
+      'America/Sao_Paulo',
+      '{start} até {end}',
+    );
+    expect(text).toContain('14:00');
+    expect(text).toContain(' até 16:30');
+  });
+
+  it('shows the full date for an end on another day', () => {
+    const text = formatSchedule(
+      'en',
+      { allDay: false, start: '2026-11-10T22:00:00.000Z', end: '2026-11-12T02:00:00.000Z' },
+      'UTC',
+      range,
+    );
+    expect(text).toContain('Nov 10');
+    expect(text).toContain('Nov 12');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the same calendar day when the display zone moves the end to another day', () => {
+    const text = formatSchedule(
+      'en',
+      { allDay: false, start: '2026-11-10T22:00:00.000Z', end: '2026-11-11T02:00:00.000Z' },
+      'America/Sao_Paulo',
+      range,
+    );
+    // 19:00 to 23:00 on the 10th in São Paulo, so the end shows only the hour
+    expect(text).toContain('Nov 10');
+    expect(text).not.toContain('Nov 11');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('formatDue and formatPercent', () => {
+  it('shows a whole-day delivery as a date, in any zone', () => {
+    expect(formatDue('en', { allDay: true, date: '2026-11-24' }, 'Asia/Tokyo')).toBe(
+      'Nov 24, 2026',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('shows a timed delivery in the display zone', () => {
+    const text = formatDue(
+      'en',
+      { allDay: false, at: '2026-11-25T02:59:00.000Z' },
+      'America/Sao_Paulo',
+    );
+    expect(text).toContain('Nov 24, 2026');
+    expect(text).toContain('11:59');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a ratio as a percentage for the language', () => {
+    expect(formatPercent('en', 0.6)).toBe('60%');
+    expect(formatPercent('en', 1)).toBe('100%');
+    expect(formatPercent('pt-BR', 0.5)).toBe('50%');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('formatDayHeading', () => {
+  it('writes the weekday, day and month in the language, without shifting the day', () => {
+    expect(formatDayHeading('en', '2026-11-07')).toBe('Saturday, November 7');
+    expect(formatDayHeading('pt-BR', '2026-11-07')).toBe('sábado, 7 de novembro');
+    expect(formatDayHeading('en', '2026-03-01')).toBe('Sunday, March 1');
+  });
+});

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b5fe2ce

+++ b/tests/ui/i18n/messages.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+import { LOCALES, MESSAGES } from '../../../src/ui/i18n/locale';
+
+function collect(value: unknown, path = ''): [string, string][] {
+  if (typeof value === 'string') return [[path, value]];
+  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
+    return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, child]) =>
+      collect(child, path ? `${path}.${key}` : key),
+    );
+  }
+  return [];
+}
+
+const DASHES = new RegExp(`[${String.fromCharCode(0x2013, 0x2014)}]`);
+
+describe('interface messages', () => {
+  it.each(LOCALES)('%s has no em dash or en dash', (locale) => {
+    const offenders = collect(MESSAGES[locale]).filter(([, text]) => DASHES.test(text));
+    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it.each(LOCALES)('%s has the same keys as English and no empty text', (locale) => {
+    const reference = collect(MESSAGES.en).map(([key]) => key);
+    const entries = collect(MESSAGES[locale]);
+    expect(entries.map(([key]) => key)).toEqual(reference);
+    expect(entries.filter(([, text]) => text.trim() === '')).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import { createTag, softDelete } from '../../src/core';
+import { flattenTagTree, possibleParents } from '../../src/ui/tagValues';
+
+const make = (name: string, parentId: string | null = null) =>
+  createTag({ name, color: '#3b5bdb', parentId });
+
+describe('flattenTagTree', () => {
+  it('lists each tag before its sub-tags, siblings by name, with the depth', () => {
+    const work = make('Work');
+    const home = make('Home');
+    const reports = make('Reports', work.id);
+    const ads = make('Ads', work.id);
+    const deep = make('Draft', reports.id);
+    const rows = flattenTagTree([work, deep, reports, home, ads], 'en');
+    expect(rows.map((row) => [row.tag.name, row.depth])).toEqual([
+      ['Home', 0],
+      ['Work', 0],
+      ['Ads', 1],
+      ['Reports', 1],
+      ['Draft', 2],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('sorts by the language of the person', () => {
+    const rows = flattenTagTree([make('Éter'), make('Zebra'), make('Ana')], 'pt-BR');
+    expect(rows.map((row) => row.tag.name)).toEqual(['Ana', 'Éter', 'Zebra']);
+  });
+
+  it('hides deleted tags and shows an orphan at the top level', () => {
+    const parent = make('Parent');
+    const orphan = make('Orphan', parent.id);
+    const rows = flattenTagTree([softDelete(parent), orphan], 'en');
+    expect(rows.map((row) => [row.tag.name, row.depth])).toEqual([['Orphan', 0]]);
+  });
+
+  it('does not loop on corrupted data', () => {
+    const a = make('A');
+    const b = make('B', a.id);
+    expect(() => flattenTagTree([{ ...a, parentId: b.id }, b], 'en')).not.toThrow();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('possibleParents', () => {
+  it('leaves out the tag and everything inside it', () => {
+    const a = make('A');
+    const b = make('B', a.id);
+    const c = make('C', b.id);
+    const d = make('D');
+    expect(possibleParents(a, [a, b, c, d]).map((tag) => tag.name)).toEqual(['D']);
+    expect(possibleParents(c, [a, b, c, d]).map((tag) => tag.name)).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'D']);
+    expect(possibleParents(null, [a, b]).map((tag) => tag.name)).toEqual(['A', 'B']);
+  });
+});

+import {

+  it('accepts the three modes', () => {
+    expect(parseThemeMode('auto')).toBe('auto');
+    expect(parseThemeMode('light')).toBe('light');
+    expect(parseThemeMode('dark')).toBe('dark');
+  });
+
+  it('falls back to auto for anything else', () => {
+    expect(parseThemeMode('sepia')).toBe('auto');
+    expect(parseThemeMode(null)).toBe('auto');
+    expect(parseThemeMode(42)).toBe('auto');
+  });

+describe('applyThemeMode', () => {
+  it('sets the attribute for explicit modes', () => {
+    applyThemeMode('dark');
+    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe('dark');
+    applyThemeMode('light');
+    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBe('light');
+  });
+
+  it('removes the attribute for auto, so the device decides', () => {
+    applyThemeMode('dark');
+    applyThemeMode('auto');
+    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.theme).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('stored mode', () => {
+  it('round-trips through localStorage', () => {
+    storeThemeMode('dark');
+    expect(localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)).toBe('dark');
+    expect(readStoredThemeMode()).toBe('dark');
+  });
+
+  it('ignores a corrupted stored value', () => {
+    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, 'banana');
+    expect(readStoredThemeMode()).toBe('auto');
+  });
+
+  it('survives blocked storage', () => {
+    const spy = vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'getItem').mockImplementation(() => {
+      throw new Error('blocked');
+    });
+    expect(readStoredThemeMode()).toBe('auto');
+    spy.mockRestore();
+  });
+});

+describe('activeFilterCount', () => {
+  it('is zero for an empty filter and for blank text or an invalid limit', () => {
+    expect(activeFilterCount(EMPTY_FILTER)).toBe(0);
+    expect(activeFilterCount({ ...EMPTY_FILTER, text: '   ', dueWithinDays: -2 })).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('counts each sieve once, however many values it holds', () => {
+    expect(
+      activeFilterCount({
+        tagIds: ['a', 'b'],
+        kinds: ['task'],
+        periods: ['morning', 'untimed'],
+        text: 'x',
+        dueWithinDays: 0,
+      }),
+    ).toBe(5);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('PERIOD_CHIPS', () => {
+  it('lists the four periods in day order, then "no set time"', () => {
+    expect(PERIOD_CHIPS).toEqual(['dawn', 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening', 'untimed']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('activeFilterCount with the agenda selection', () => {
+  it('counts a hidden agenda as one more sieve', () => {
+    expect(activeFilterCount(EMPTY_FILTER, true)).toBe(1);
+    expect(activeFilterCount({ ...EMPTY_FILTER, text: 'a' }, true)).toBe(2);
+    expect(activeFilterCount(EMPTY_FILTER)).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
